name: TateCurvesTheta.two_mul_thetaExp
statement: lemma two_mul_thetaExp (n : ℤ) : 2 * thetaExp n = n * (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (2 : ℤ) ∣ n * (n + 1) := (Int.even_mul_succ_self n).two_dvd
  rw [thetaExp, Int.mul_ediv_cancel' h]

name: TateCurvesTheta.thetaExp_nonneg
statement: lemma thetaExp_nonneg (n : ℤ) : 0 ≤ thetaExp n
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : 2 * thetaExp n = n * (n + 1) := two_mul_thetaExp n
  have hnn : 0 ≤ n * (n + 1) := by
    by_cases h : 0 ≤ n
    · exact mul_nonneg h (by omega)
    · have key : (0 : ℤ) ≤ (-n) * (-(n + 1)) := mul_nonneg (by omega) (by omega)
      nlinarith [key]
  omega

name: TateCurvesTheta.thetaExp_cast
statement: lemma thetaExp_cast (n : ℤ) : (thetaExp n : ℝ) = (n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) + 1) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have h : (2 : ℝ) * (thetaExp n : ℝ) = (n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) + 1) := by
    exact_mod_cast two_mul_thetaExp n
  linarith

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.theta_apply
statement:
lemma theta_apply (T : TateParameter K) (u : Kˣ) :
    T.theta u = ∑' n : ℤ, (T.q : K) ^ (thetaExp n) * (u : K) ^ n
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.thetaTerm_summable
statement:
theorem thetaTerm_summable [CompleteSpace K] [IsUltrametricDist K]
    (T : TateParameter K) (u : Kˣ) : Summable (T.thetaTerm u)
proof:
:= by
  apply NonarchimedeanAddGroup.summable_of_tendsto_cofinite_zero
  apply tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero.mpr
  have ha : 0 < ‖(T.q : K)‖ := T.norm_q_pos
  have hb : 0 < ‖(u : K)‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr u.ne_zero
  
  have hnorm : (fun n : ℤ => ‖T.thetaTerm u n‖)
      = fun n : ℤ =>
        Real.exp (Real.log ‖(T.q : K)‖ * (thetaExp n : ℝ) + Real.log ‖(u : K)‖ * (n : ℝ)) := by
    funext n
    rw [thetaTerm, norm_mul, norm_zpow, norm_zpow,
      ← Real.rpow_intCast ‖(T.q : K)‖ (thetaExp n), ← Real.rpow_intCast ‖(u : K)‖ n,
      Real.rpow_def_of_pos ha, Real.rpow_def_of_pos hb, ← Real.exp_add]
  
  have hg : Tendsto
      (fun n : ℤ => Real.log ‖(T.q : K)‖ * (thetaExp n : ℝ) + Real.log ‖(u : K)‖ * (n : ℝ))
      cofinite atBot := by
    have hLa2 : Real.log ‖(T.q : K)‖ / 2 < 0 := by
      have := Real.log_neg ha T.norm_lt_one
      linarith
    have hfac :
        (fun n : ℤ =>
            Real.log ‖(T.q : K)‖ * (thetaExp n : ℝ) + Real.log ‖(u : K)‖ * (n : ℝ))
          = fun n : ℤ =>
            (n : ℝ) * ((Real.log ‖(T.q : K)‖ / 2 + Real.log ‖(u : K)‖)
              + Real.log ‖(T.q : K)‖ / 2 * (n : ℝ)) := by
      funext n
      rw [thetaExp_cast]
      ring
    rw [hfac, Int.cofinite_eq, tendsto_sup]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · exact Tendsto.atBot_mul_atTop₀ (tendsto_intCast_atBot_iff.2 tendsto_id)
        (Tendsto.add_atTop tendsto_const_nhds
          (Tendsto.const_mul_atBot_of_neg hLa2 (tendsto_intCast_atBot_iff.2 tendsto_id)))
    · exact Tendsto.atTop_mul_atBot₀ tendsto_intCast_atTop_atTop
        (Tendsto.add_atBot tendsto_const_nhds
          (Tendsto.const_mul_atTop_of_neg hLa2 tendsto_intCast_atTop_atTop))
  rw [hnorm]
  exact Real.tendsto_exp_atBot.comp hg

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.summable_norm_qpow_mul
statement:
private lemma summable_norm_qpow_mul (c : K) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => ‖(t.q : K) ^ n * c‖)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (fun n : ℕ => ‖(t.q : K) ^ n * c‖) = fun n : ℕ => ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ n * ‖c‖ := by
    funext n; rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
  rw [h]
  exact (summable_geometric_of_lt_one (norm_nonneg _) t.norm_lt_one).mul_right ‖c‖

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.thetaProdFactor_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma thetaProdFactor_eq_zero_iff [CompleteSpace K] (c : K) :
    t.thetaProdFactor c = 0 ↔ ∃ n : ℕ, (1 : K) + (t.q : K) ^ n * c = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsum := t.summable_norm_qpow_mul c
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hcon
    have hcon' : ∀ n : ℕ, (1 : K) + (t.q : K) ^ n * c ≠ 0 := fun n hn => hcon ⟨n, hn⟩
    have hne :=
      tprod_one_add_ne_zero_of_summable (f := fun n : ℕ => (t.q : K) ^ n * c) hcon' hsum
    rw [thetaProdFactor] at h
    exact hne h
  · rintro ⟨m, hm⟩
    have hshift : Multipliable (fun n : ℕ => (1 : K) + (t.q : K) ^ (n + (m + 1)) * c) := by
      have h := t.multipliable_thetaProdFactor ((t.q : K) ^ (m + 1) * c)
      have hfun : (fun n : ℕ => (1 : K) + (t.q : K) ^ (n + (m + 1)) * c)
          = fun n : ℕ => (1 : K) + (t.q : K) ^ n * ((t.q : K) ^ (m + 1) * c) := by
        funext n; rw [pow_add]; ring
      rw [hfun]; exact h
    have hkey := Multipliable.prod_mul_tprod_nat_mul'
      (f := fun n : ℕ => (1 : K) + (t.q : K) ^ n * c) (k := m + 1) hshift
    rw [thetaProdFactor, ← hkey,
      Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_self m)) hm, zero_mul]

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.thetaProdFactor_neg_q_ne_zero
statement:
lemma thetaProdFactor_neg_q_ne_zero [CompleteSpace K] :
    t.thetaProdFactor (-(t.q : K)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ne_eq, t.thetaProdFactor_eq_zero_iff]
  rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
  exact t.thetaProdFactor_neg_q_factor_ne_zero n hn

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.factor2_pointwise
proof:
:= by
  have hqn : (t.q : K) ^ (n + 1) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ t.q.ne_zero
  rw [show (-((n : ℤ) + 1)) = -(((n + 1 : ℕ)) : ℤ) by push_cast; ring, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast]
  constructor
  · intro h; field_simp; linear_combination h
  · intro h; rw [h]; field_simp; ring

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.factor3_pointwise
statement:
private lemma factor3_pointwise (u : Kˣ) (n : ℕ) :
    (1 : K) + (t.q : K) ^ n * (u : K)⁻¹ = 0 ↔ (u : K) = -(t.q : K) ^ (n : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hu : (u : K) ≠ 0 := u.ne_zero
  rw [zpow_natCast]
  constructor
  · intro h; field_simp at h; linear_combination h
  · intro h; rw [h]; field_simp; ring

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.thetaProd_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem thetaProd_eq_zero_iff [CompleteSpace K] (u : Kˣ) :
    t.thetaProd u = 0 ↔ ∃ k : ℤ, (u : K) = -(t.q : K) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [thetaProd_apply, mul_eq_zero, mul_eq_zero, or_iff_right t.thetaProdFactor_neg_q_ne_zero,
    t.thetaProdFactor_eq_zero_iff, t.thetaProdFactor_eq_zero_iff]
  simp only [t.factor2_pointwise u, t.factor3_pointwise u]
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨n, hn⟩ | ⟨n, hn⟩)
    · exact ⟨-((n : ℤ) + 1), hn⟩
    · exact ⟨(n : ℤ), hn⟩
  · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
    by_cases h0 : 0 ≤ k
    · right
      exact ⟨k.toNat, by rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg h0]; exact hk⟩
    · left
      refine ⟨(-k - 1).toNat, ?_⟩
      rw [show (-(((-k - 1).toNat : ℤ) + 1)) = k by
        rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega : (0 : ℤ) ≤ -k - 1)]; ring]
      exact hk

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.thetaProd_zero_orbit
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (t.thetaProd_eq_zero_iff u).mp hu
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := (t.thetaProd_eq_zero_iff v).mp hv
  have hqb : (t.q : K) ^ b ≠ 0 := zpow_ne_zero b t.q.ne_zero
  refine ⟨a - b, ?_⟩
  rw [ha, hb, zpow_sub₀ t.q.ne_zero]
  field_simp

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.theta_eq_zero_iff_of_eq_thetaProd
statement:
theorem theta_eq_zero_iff_of_eq_thetaProd [CompleteSpace K] (u : Kˣ)
    (h : t.theta u = t.thetaProd u) :
    t.theta u = 0 ↔ ∃ k : ℤ, (u : K) = -(t.q : K) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [h]; exact t.thetaProd_eq_zero_iff u

name: TateCurvesTheta.qPoch_eq_prod
statement:
lemma qPoch_eq_prod (q : K) (N : ℕ) :
    qPoch q N = ∏ n ∈ Finset.range N, (1 + q ^ n * (-q))
proof:
:= by
  induction N with
  | zero => simp
  | succ N ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_range_succ, ← ih, qPoch_succ]
    ring

name: TateCurvesTheta.norm_gaussBinom_le_one
statement:
lemma norm_gaussBinom_le_one [IsUltrametricDist K] {q : K} (hq : ‖q‖ ≤ 1) :
    ∀ n k : ℕ, ‖gaussBinom q n k‖ ≤ 1
  | _, 0 => by rw [gaussBinom_zero_right]; simp
  | 0, (_ + 1) => by rw [gaussBinom_zero_succ]; simp
  | (n + 1), (k + 1) => by
      rw [gaussBinom_succ_succ]
      refine (IsUltrametricDist.norm_add_le_max _ _).trans (max_le ?_ ?_)
      · exact norm_gaussBinom_le_one hq n (k + 1)
      · rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
        exact mul_le_one₀ (pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) hq) (norm_nonneg _)
          (norm_gaussBinom_le_one hq n k)

end General

namespace TateParameter

variable {K : Type*} [NormedField K] [CompleteSpace K] [IsUltrametricDist K]
variable (t : TateParameter K)

                                                             

omit [CompleteSpace K] in

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.factorCoeff_mul_qPoch
statement:
lemma factorCoeff_mul_qPoch (k : ℕ) :
    factorCoeff t k * qPoch (t.q : K) k = (t.q : K) ^ (k * (k - 1) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    have hne := t.one_sub_qpow_ne_zero n
    have hexp : n + n * (n - 1) / 2 = (n + 1) * ((n + 1) - 1) / 2 := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_range_id n, ← Finset.sum_range_id (n + 1), Finset.sum_range_succ]
      exact Nat.add_comm _ _
    rw [factorCoeff_succ, qPoch_succ]
    calc
      (t.q : K) ^ n * (1 - (t.q : K) ^ (n + 1))⁻¹ * factorCoeff t n
            * (qPoch (t.q : K) n * (1 - (t.q : K) ^ (n + 1)))
          = (t.q : K) ^ n * (factorCoeff t n * qPoch (t.q : K) n)
            * ((1 - (t.q : K) ^ (n + 1))⁻¹ * (1 - (t.q : K) ^ (n + 1))) := by ring
      _ = (t.q : K) ^ n * (t.q : K) ^ (n * (n - 1) / 2) * 1 := by
            rw [ih, inv_mul_cancel₀ hne]
      _ = (t.q : K) ^ (n + n * (n - 1) / 2) := by rw [mul_one, ← pow_add]
      _ = (t.q : K) ^ ((n + 1) * ((n + 1) - 1) / 2) := by rw [hexp]

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.durfee_exp
statement: private lemma durfee_exp (k : ℕ) : k * (k - 1) / 2 * 2 + k = k * k
proof:
:= by
  have hdvd : 2 ∣ k * (k - 1) := by
    rcases k with _ | m
    · simp
    · rw [Nat.succ_sub_one]
      have : Even ((m + 1) * m) := by rw [Nat.mul_comm]; exact Nat.even_mul_succ_self m
      exact this.two_dvd
  rw [Nat.div_mul_cancel hdvd]
  rcases k with _ | m
  · rfl
  · rw [Nat.succ_sub_one]; ring

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.factorCoeff_sq_mul
statement:
lemma factorCoeff_sq_mul (k : ℕ) :
    factorCoeff t k ^ 2 * (t.q : K) ^ k * qPoch (t.q : K) k ^ 2 = (t.q : K) ^ (k * k)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (factorCoeff t k * qPoch (t.q : K) k) ^ 2 = ((t.q : K) ^ (k * (k - 1) / 2)) ^ 2 := by
    rw [t.factorCoeff_mul_qPoch k]
  rw [mul_pow] at h
  calc
    factorCoeff t k ^ 2 * (t.q : K) ^ k * qPoch (t.q : K) k ^ 2
        = factorCoeff t k ^ 2 * qPoch (t.q : K) k ^ 2 * (t.q : K) ^ k := by ring
    _ = ((t.q : K) ^ (k * (k - 1) / 2)) ^ 2 * (t.q : K) ^ k := by rw [h]
    _ = (t.q : K) ^ (k * (k - 1) / 2 * 2) * (t.q : K) ^ k := by rw [← pow_mul]
    _ = (t.q : K) ^ (k * (k - 1) / 2 * 2 + k) := by rw [← pow_add]
    _ = (t.q : K) ^ (k * k) := by rw [durfee_exp]

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.qPoch_ne_zero'
statement: lemma qPoch_ne_zero' (k : ℕ) : qPoch (t.q : K) k ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  qPoch_ne_zero (t.q : K) t.one_sub_qpow_ne_zero k

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.qPoch_tendsto
statement:
lemma qPoch_tendsto :
    Tendsto (fun N => qPoch (t.q : K) N) atTop (𝓝 (t.thetaProdFactor (-(t.q : K))))
proof:
:= by
  have h := (t.multipliable_thetaProdFactor (-(t.q : K))).hasProd.tendsto_prod_nat
  rw [← thetaProdFactor_apply] at h
  exact h.congr fun N => (qPoch_eq_prod (t.q : K) N).symm

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.tendsto_sub_atTop
statement: private lemma tendsto_sub_atTop (k : ℕ) : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => n - k) atTop atTop
proof:
:=
  tendsto_atTop_atTop.2 fun b => ⟨b + k, fun a ha => by omega⟩

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.tendsto_two_mul_atTop
statement: private lemma tendsto_two_mul_atTop : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 2 * n) atTop atTop
proof:
:=
  tendsto_atTop_atTop.2 fun b => ⟨b, fun a ha => by omega⟩

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.tendsto_durfee_summand
statement:
lemma tendsto_durfee_summand (k : ℕ) :
    Tendsto (fun n => (t.q : K) ^ (k * k) * gaussBinom (t.q : K) n k ^ 2) atTop
      (𝓝 (factorCoeff t k ^ 2 * (t.q : K) ^ k))
proof:
:= by
  set P := t.thetaProdFactor (-(t.q : K)) with hP
  have hPne : P ≠ 0 := t.thetaProdFactor_neg_q_ne_zero
  
  have hgbk : Tendsto (fun n => gaussBinom (t.q : K) n k * qPoch (t.q : K) k) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
    have hnum : Tendsto (fun n => qPoch (t.q : K) n) atTop (𝓝 P) := t.qPoch_tendsto
    have hden : Tendsto (fun n => qPoch (t.q : K) (n - k)) atTop (𝓝 P) :=
      t.qPoch_tendsto.comp (tendsto_sub_atTop k)
    have hlim : Tendsto (fun n => qPoch (t.q : K) n * (qPoch (t.q : K) (n - k))⁻¹) atTop
        (𝓝 (P * P⁻¹)) := hnum.mul (hden.inv₀ hPne)
    rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hPne] at hlim
    refine hlim.congr' ?_
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop k] with n hn
    have hcf := gaussBinom_mul_qPoch (t.q : K) hn
    rw [← hcf, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel_right₀ (t.qPoch_ne_zero' (n - k))]
  
  have hgb : Tendsto (fun n => gaussBinom (t.q : K) n k) atTop (𝓝 ((qPoch (t.q : K) k)⁻¹)) := by
    have h := hgbk.mul_const ((qPoch (t.q : K) k)⁻¹)
    rw [one_mul] at h
    refine h.congr' ?_
    filter_upwards with n
    rw [mul_inv_cancel_right₀ (t.qPoch_ne_zero' k)]
  
  have hlim := (hgb.pow 2).const_mul ((t.q : K) ^ (k * k))
  have heq : (t.q : K) ^ (k * k) * ((qPoch (t.q : K) k)⁻¹) ^ 2
      = factorCoeff t k ^ 2 * (t.q : K) ^ k := by
    rw [inv_pow, ← t.factorCoeff_sq_mul k,
      mul_inv_cancel_right₀ (pow_ne_zero 2 (t.qPoch_ne_zero' k))]
  rwa [heq] at hlim

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.thetaProdNormConst_eq_one
statement: theorem thetaProdNormConst_eq_one : t.thetaProdNormConst = 1
proof:
:= by
  set P := t.thetaProdFactor (-(t.q : K)) with hP
  have hPne : P ≠ 0 := t.thetaProdFactor_neg_q_ne_zero
  have hq0 : (t.q : K) ≠ 0 := t.q.ne_zero
  
  have hbound : Summable (fun k : ℕ => ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ (k * k)) := by
    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun k => pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _) (fun k => ?_)
      (summable_geometric_of_lt_one (norm_nonneg _) t.norm_lt_one)
    refine pow_le_pow_of_le_one (norm_nonneg _) (le_of_lt t.norm_lt_one) ?_
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with rfl | hk
    · simp
    · exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left k hk
  
  have hDCT : Tendsto (fun n => ∑' k : ℕ, (t.q : K) ^ (k * k) * gaussBinom (t.q : K) n k ^ 2)
      atTop (𝓝 (∑' k : ℕ, factorCoeff t k ^ 2 * (t.q : K) ^ k)) := by
    refine tendsto_tsum_of_dominated_convergence hbound (fun k => t.tendsto_durfee_summand k) ?_
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n k => ?_
    rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_pow]
    refine mul_le_of_le_one_right (pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _) ?_
    exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_gaussBinom_le_one (le_of_lt t.norm_lt_one) n k)
  
  have hLHS : ∀ n, (∑' k : ℕ, (t.q : K) ^ (k * k) * gaussBinom (t.q : K) n k ^ 2)
      = gaussBinom (t.q : K) (2 * n) n := by
    intro n
    rw [tsum_eq_sum (s := Finset.range (n + 1)) fun k hk => ?_]
    · exact gaussBinom_two_mul_self hq0 t.one_sub_qpow_ne_zero n
    · rw [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] at hk
      rw [gaussBinom_eq_zero_of_lt (t.q : K) (by omega : n < k)]
      simp
  simp only [hLHS] at hDCT
  
  have hgb2n : Tendsto (fun n => gaussBinom (t.q : K) (2 * n) n) atTop (𝓝 (P⁻¹)) := by
    have key : ∀ n, gaussBinom (t.q : K) (2 * n) n * (qPoch (t.q : K) n * qPoch (t.q : K) n)
        = qPoch (t.q : K) (2 * n) := by
      intro n
      have h := gaussBinom_mul_qPoch (t.q : K) (show n ≤ 2 * n by omega)
      rwa [show 2 * n - n = n by omega] at h
    have hnum : Tendsto (fun n => qPoch (t.q : K) (2 * n)) atTop (𝓝 P) :=
      t.qPoch_tendsto.comp tendsto_two_mul_atTop
    have hden : Tendsto (fun n => qPoch (t.q : K) n * qPoch (t.q : K) n) atTop (𝓝 (P * P)) :=
      t.qPoch_tendsto.mul t.qPoch_tendsto
    have hlim : Tendsto
        (fun n => qPoch (t.q : K) (2 * n) * (qPoch (t.q : K) n * qPoch (t.q : K) n)⁻¹)
        atTop (𝓝 (P * (P * P)⁻¹)) := hnum.mul (hden.inv₀ (mul_ne_zero hPne hPne))
    rw [show P * (P * P)⁻¹ = P⁻¹ by field_simp] at hlim
    refine hlim.congr' ?_
    filter_upwards with n
    rw [← key n, mul_inv_cancel_right₀ (mul_ne_zero (t.qPoch_ne_zero' n) (t.qPoch_ne_zero' n))]
  
  have hsum_eq : (∑' k : ℕ, factorCoeff t k ^ 2 * (t.q : K) ^ k) = P⁻¹ :=
    tendsto_nhds_unique hDCT hgb2n
  rw [thetaProdNormConst, ← hP, hsum_eq, mul_inv_cancel₀ hPne]

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.theta_eq_thetaProd
statement: theorem theta_eq_thetaProd (u : Kˣ) : t.theta u = t.thetaProd u
proof:
:=
  t.theta_eq_thetaProd_of_durfee t.thetaProdNormConst_eq_one u

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.theta_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem theta_eq_zero_iff (u : Kˣ) :
    t.theta u = 0 ↔ ∃ k : ℤ, (u : K) = -(t.q : K) ^ k
proof:
:=
  t.theta_eq_zero_iff_of_eq_thetaProd u (t.theta_eq_thetaProd u)

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.recipCoeff_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma recipCoeff_zero : recipCoeff t 0 = 1
proof: := by rw [recipCoeff]

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.recipCoeff_succ
statement:
lemma recipCoeff_succ (n : ℕ) :
    recipCoeff t (n + 1)
      = -∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), t.factorCoeff (k + 1) * recipCoeff t (n - k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [recipCoeff]

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.norm_recipCoeff_le_one
statement: lemma norm_recipCoeff_le_one [IsUltrametricDist K] (n : ℕ) : ‖recipCoeff t n‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    match n with
    | 0 => simp
    | (m + 1) =>
      rw [recipCoeff_succ, norm_neg]
      refine IsUltrametricDist.norm_sum_le_of_forall_le_of_nonneg (by norm_num) fun k _ => ?_
      rw [norm_mul]
      have h2 : ‖recipCoeff t (m - k)‖ ≤ 1 := ih (m - k) (Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.sub_le m k))
      calc ‖t.factorCoeff (k + 1)‖ * ‖recipCoeff t (m - k)‖
          ≤ 1 * 1 :=
            mul_le_mul (t.norm_factorCoeff_le_one (k + 1)) h2 (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
        _ = 1 := one_mul 1

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.summable_norm_factorCoeff_mul_pow
statement:
lemma summable_norm_factorCoeff_mul_pow [IsUltrametricDist K] {c : K} (hc : ‖c‖ < 1) :
    Summable (fun k : ℕ => ‖factorCoeff t k * c ^ k‖)
proof:
:= by
  refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun k => norm_nonneg _) (fun k => ?_)
    (summable_geometric_of_lt_one (norm_nonneg c) hc)
  rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
  exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg c) k) (t.norm_factorCoeff_le_one k)

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.summable_norm_recipCoeff_mul_pow
statement:
lemma summable_norm_recipCoeff_mul_pow [IsUltrametricDist K] {c : K} (hc : ‖c‖ < 1) :
    Summable (fun k : ℕ => ‖recipCoeff t k * c ^ k‖)
proof:
:= by
  refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun k => norm_nonneg _) (fun k => ?_)
    (summable_geometric_of_lt_one (norm_nonneg c) hc)
  rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
  exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg c) k) (t.norm_recipCoeff_le_one k)

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.recipCoeff_summable
statement:
lemma recipCoeff_summable [CompleteSpace K] [IsUltrametricDist K] {c : K} (hc : ‖c‖ < 1) :
    Summable (fun k : ℕ => recipCoeff t k * c ^ k)
proof:
:=
  (t.summable_norm_recipCoeff_mul_pow hc).of_norm

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.factorCoeff_recipCoeff_convolution
statement:
lemma factorCoeff_recipCoeff_convolution (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), t.factorCoeff k * recipCoeff t (n - k)
      = if n = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  match n with
  | 0 => simp
  | (m + 1) =>
    rw [if_neg (Nat.succ_ne_zero m),
      Finset.sum_range_succ' (fun k => t.factorCoeff k * recipCoeff t (m + 1 - k)) (m + 1)]
    simp only [factorCoeff_zero, one_mul, Nat.sub_zero, Nat.succ_sub_succ]
    rw [recipCoeff_succ]
    exact add_neg_cancel _

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.thetaProdFactor_mul_tsum_recipCoeff
statement:
theorem thetaProdFactor_mul_tsum_recipCoeff [CompleteSpace K] [IsUltrametricDist K]
    {c : K} (hc : ‖c‖ < 1) :
    t.thetaProdFactor c * ∑' k : ℕ, recipCoeff t k * c ^ k = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [t.thetaProdFactor_eq_tsum c,
    tsum_mul_tsum_eq_tsum_sum_range_of_summable_norm
      (t.summable_norm_factorCoeff_mul_pow hc) (t.summable_norm_recipCoeff_mul_pow hc)]
  have hterm : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        factorCoeff t k * c ^ k * (recipCoeff t (n - k) * c ^ (n - k)))
        = (if n = 0 then 1 else 0) * c ^ n := by
    intro n
    rw [← t.factorCoeff_recipCoeff_convolution n, Finset.sum_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk => ?_
    rw [Finset.mem_range, Nat.lt_succ_iff] at hk
    have hpow : c ^ k * c ^ (n - k) = c ^ n := by
      rw [← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_cancel' hk]
    rw [← hpow]; ring
  rw [tsum_congr hterm, tsum_eq_single 0 fun n hn => by rw [if_neg hn]; ring]
  simp

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.factorCoeff_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma factorCoeff_zero : factorCoeff t 0 = 1
proof: := rfl

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.factorCoeff_succ
statement:
lemma factorCoeff_succ (k : ℕ) :
    factorCoeff t (k + 1) = (t.q : K) ^ k * (1 - (t.q : K) ^ (k + 1))⁻¹ * factorCoeff t k
proof: := rfl

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.factorCoeff_rec
statement:
lemma factorCoeff_rec [IsUltrametricDist K] (k : ℕ) :
    (1 - (t.q : K) ^ (k + 1)) * factorCoeff t (k + 1) = (t.q : K) ^ k * factorCoeff t k
proof:
:= by
  have hne := t.one_sub_qpow_ne_zero k
  have key : factorCoeff t (k + 1)
      = (t.q : K) ^ k * factorCoeff t k * (1 - (t.q : K) ^ (k + 1))⁻¹ := by
    rw [factorCoeff_succ]; ring
  rw [key, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm (1 - (t.q : K) ^ (k + 1)) ((t.q : K) ^ k * factorCoeff t k),
    mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hne, mul_one]

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.norm_factorCoeff_succ
statement:
lemma norm_factorCoeff_succ [IsUltrametricDist K] (k : ℕ) :
    ‖factorCoeff t (k + 1)‖ = ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ k * ‖factorCoeff t k‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [factorCoeff_succ, norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_inv, t.norm_one_sub_qpow k, inv_one]
  ring

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.norm_factorCoeff
statement:
lemma norm_factorCoeff [IsUltrametricDist K] (k : ℕ) :
    ‖factorCoeff t k‖ = ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ (k * (k - 1) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    have hexp : n + n * (n - 1) / 2 = (n + 1) * ((n + 1) - 1) / 2 := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_range_id n, ← Finset.sum_range_id (n + 1), Finset.sum_range_succ]
      exact Nat.add_comm _ _
    rw [t.norm_factorCoeff_succ, ih, ← pow_add, hexp]

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.norm_factorCoeff_le_one
statement: lemma norm_factorCoeff_le_one [IsUltrametricDist K] (k : ℕ) : ‖factorCoeff t k‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [t.norm_factorCoeff k]
  exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) (le_of_lt t.norm_lt_one)

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.factorCoeff_summable
statement:
lemma factorCoeff_summable [CompleteSpace K] [IsUltrametricDist K] (c : K) :
    Summable (fun k : ℕ => factorCoeff t k * c ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  refine summable_of_ratio_norm_eventually_le (r := 1 / 2) (by norm_num) ?_
  have htend : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ k * ‖c‖) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa using
      (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (norm_nonneg (t.q : K)) t.norm_lt_one).mul_const ‖c‖
  filter_upwards [htend.eventually_le_const (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2 by norm_num)] with k hk
  have key : ‖factorCoeff t (k + 1) * c ^ (k + 1)‖
      = ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ k * ‖c‖ * ‖factorCoeff t k * c ^ k‖ := by
    rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_pow, t.norm_factorCoeff_succ k]
    ring
  rw [key]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hk (norm_nonneg _)

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.tsum_factorCoeff_eq
statement:
lemma tsum_factorCoeff_eq [CompleteSpace K] [IsUltrametricDist K] (c : K) :
    (∑' k : ℕ, factorCoeff t k * c ^ k)
      = (1 + c) * ∑' k : ℕ, factorCoeff t k * ((t.q : K) * c) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  have hf := t.factorCoeff_summable c
  have hg := t.factorCoeff_summable ((t.q : K) * c)
  have hd : Summable
      (fun k : ℕ => factorCoeff t k * c ^ k - factorCoeff t k * ((t.q : K) * c) ^ k) := hf.sub hg
  
  have hsplit : ∀ k : ℕ, factorCoeff t k * c ^ k
      = factorCoeff t k * ((t.q : K) * c) ^ k
        + (factorCoeff t k * c ^ k - factorCoeff t k * ((t.q : K) * c) ^ k) := by
    intro k; ring
  rw [tsum_congr hsplit, Summable.tsum_add hg hd, add_mul, one_mul]
  congr 1
  
  rw [hd.tsum_eq_zero_add]
  simp only [factorCoeff_zero, pow_zero, mul_one, sub_self, zero_add]
  rw [← tsum_mul_left]
  refine tsum_congr fun k => ?_
  
  have hrec := t.factorCoeff_rec k
  rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, pow_succ ((t.q : K)) k, pow_succ c k]
  linear_combination (c ^ k * c) * hrec

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.tsum_factorCoeff_eq_prod_mul
statement:
lemma tsum_factorCoeff_eq_prod_mul [CompleteSpace K] [IsUltrametricDist K] (c : K) (N : ℕ) :
    (∑' k : ℕ, factorCoeff t k * c ^ k)
      = (∏ n ∈ Finset.range N, (1 + (t.q : K) ^ n * c))
        * ∑' k : ℕ, factorCoeff t k * ((t.q : K) ^ N * c) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  induction N with
  | zero => simp
  | succ N ih =>
    have hq : (t.q : K) * ((t.q : K) ^ N * c) = (t.q : K) ^ (N + 1) * c := by
      rw [pow_succ]; ring
    rw [ih, t.tsum_factorCoeff_eq ((t.q : K) ^ N * c), hq, Finset.prod_range_succ]
    ring

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.norm_tsum_sub_one_le
statement:
lemma norm_tsum_sub_one_le [CompleteSpace K] [IsUltrametricDist K] (x : K) (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖(∑' k : ℕ, factorCoeff t k * x ^ k) - 1‖ ≤ ‖x‖
proof:
:= by
  have hsum := t.factorCoeff_summable x
  rw [hsum.tsum_eq_zero_add]
  simp only [factorCoeff_zero, pow_zero, mul_one, add_sub_cancel_left]
  have hcongr : (∑' k : ℕ, factorCoeff t (k + 1) * x ^ (k + 1))
      = x * ∑' k : ℕ, factorCoeff t (k + 1) * x ^ k := by
    rw [← tsum_mul_left]
    refine tsum_congr fun k => ?_
    rw [pow_succ]; ring
  rw [hcongr, norm_mul]
  refine mul_le_of_le_one_right (norm_nonneg _) ?_
  refine (IsUltrametricDist.norm_tsum_le _).trans (ciSup_le fun k => ?_)
  rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
  exact mul_le_one₀ (t.norm_factorCoeff_le_one _) (pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _)
    (pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) hx)

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.thetaProdFactor_eq_tsum
statement:
theorem thetaProdFactor_eq_tsum [CompleteSpace K] [IsUltrametricDist K] (c : K) :
    t.thetaProdFactor c = ∑' k : ℕ, factorCoeff t k * c ^ k
proof:
:= by
  
  have hprod : Tendsto (fun N => ∏ n ∈ Finset.range N, (1 + (t.q : K) ^ n * c)) atTop
      (𝓝 (t.thetaProdFactor c)) := by
    have h := (t.multipliable_thetaProdFactor c).hasProd.tendsto_prod_nat
    rwa [← thetaProdFactor_apply] at h
  
  have hS : Tendsto (fun N => ∑' k : ℕ, factorCoeff t k * ((t.q : K) ^ N * c) ^ k) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
    have hqc : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (t.q : K) ^ N * c) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      simpa using t.tendsto_pow_atTop_zero.mul_const c
    have hnorm : Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => ‖(t.q : K) ^ N * c‖) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      simpa using hqc.norm
    rw [← tendsto_sub_nhds_zero_iff]
    refine squeeze_zero_norm' ?_ hnorm
    filter_upwards [hnorm.eventually_le_const (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 by norm_num)] with N hN
    exact t.norm_tsum_sub_one_le _ hN
  
  have hcomb : Tendsto (fun N => (∏ n ∈ Finset.range N, (1 + (t.q : K) ^ n * c))
      * ∑' k : ℕ, factorCoeff t k * ((t.q : K) ^ N * c) ^ k) atTop
      (𝓝 (t.thetaProdFactor c * 1)) := hprod.mul hS
  rw [mul_one] at hcomb
  have hconst : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => ∑' k : ℕ, factorCoeff t k * c ^ k) atTop
      (𝓝 (∑' k : ℕ, factorCoeff t k * c ^ k)) := tendsto_const_nhds
  rw [funext fun N => t.tsum_factorCoeff_eq_prod_mul c N] at hconst
  exact (tendsto_nhds_unique hconst hcomb).symm

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.thetaExp_neg_succ
statement: lemma thetaExp_neg_succ (n : ℤ) : thetaExp (-(n + 1)) = thetaExp n
proof:
:= by
  have h : -(n + 1) * (-(n + 1) + 1) = n * (n + 1) := by ring
  simp only [thetaExp, h]

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.thetaTerm_inv_neg_succ
statement:
lemma thetaTerm_inv_neg_succ (u : Kˣ) (n : ℤ) :
    t.thetaTerm u⁻¹ (-(n + 1)) = (u : K) * t.thetaTerm u n
proof:
:= by
  have hu : (u : K) ≠ 0 := Units.ne_zero u
  rw [thetaTerm, thetaTerm, thetaExp_neg_succ, Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val, inv_zpow,
    ← zpow_neg, neg_neg, zpow_add₀ hu, zpow_one]
  ring

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.theta_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem theta_inv (u : Kˣ) : t.theta u⁻¹ = (u : K) * t.theta u
proof:
:= by
  calc t.theta u⁻¹ = ∑' n : ℤ, t.thetaTerm u⁻¹ n := rfl
    _ = ∑' n : ℤ, t.thetaTerm u⁻¹ (-(n + 1)) :=
        (negSuccEquiv.tsum_eq (t.thetaTerm u⁻¹)).symm
    _ = ∑' n : ℤ, (u : K) * t.thetaTerm u n := tsum_congr (t.thetaTerm_inv_neg_succ u)
    _ = (u : K) * t.theta u := tsum_mul_left

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.thetaOdd_apply
statement: lemma thetaOdd_apply (u : Kˣ) : t.thetaOdd u = (u : K) * t.theta (-(u ^ 2))
proof: := rfl

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.thetaOdd_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem thetaOdd_inv (u : Kˣ) : t.thetaOdd u⁻¹ = -t.thetaOdd u
proof:
:= by
  have hu : (u : K) ≠ 0 := Units.ne_zero u
  have hUnit : -(u⁻¹ ^ 2) = (-(u ^ 2))⁻¹ := Units.ext (by
    push_cast [Units.val_neg, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val]
    field_simp)
  rw [thetaOdd, thetaOdd, hUnit, t.theta_inv, Units.val_neg, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val,
    Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val]
  field_simp

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.thetaOdd_q_smul
statement:
theorem thetaOdd_q_smul (u : Kˣ) :
    t.thetaOdd (t.q * u) = ((t.q : K) ^ 2 * (u : K) ^ 4)⁻¹ * t.thetaOdd u
proof:
:= by
  have hq : (t.q : K) ≠ 0 := Units.ne_zero t.q
  have hu : (u : K) ≠ 0 := Units.ne_zero u
  have hUnit : -((t.q * u) ^ 2) = t.q ^ (2 : ℤ) * (-(u ^ 2)) := by
    rw [zpow_two]
    exact Units.ext (by
      push_cast [Units.val_neg, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, Units.val_mul]
      ring)
  have hexp2 : thetaExp 2 = 3 := by decide
  rw [thetaOdd, thetaOdd, hUnit, t.theta_zpow_q_smul (-(u ^ 2)) 2, hexp2,
    Units.val_neg, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, Units.val_mul]
  field_simp

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.thetaOdd_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem thetaOdd_eq_zero_iff (u : Kˣ) :
    t.thetaOdd u = 0 ↔ ∃ k : ℤ, (u : K) ^ 2 = (t.q : K) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  have hu : (u : K) ≠ 0 := Units.ne_zero u
  rw [thetaOdd, mul_eq_zero]
  simp only [hu, false_or]
  rw [t.theta_eq_zero_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
    refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
    rw [Units.val_neg, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val] at hk
    exact neg_injective hk
  · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
    refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
    rw [Units.val_neg, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, hk]

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.norm_one_add_qpow
statement: lemma norm_one_add_qpow (k : ℕ) : ‖(1 : K) + (t.q : K) ^ (k + 1)‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hlt : ‖(t.q : K) ^ (k + 1)‖ < 1 := by
    rw [norm_pow]
    exact pow_lt_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) t.norm_lt_one (Nat.succ_ne_zero k)
  have hne : ‖(1 : K)‖ ≠ ‖(t.q : K) ^ (k + 1)‖ := by
    rw [norm_one]; exact ne_of_gt hlt
  rw [IsUltrametricDist.norm_add_eq_max_of_norm_ne_norm hne, norm_one, max_eq_left hlt.le]

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.one_add_qpow_ne_zero
statement: lemma one_add_qpow_ne_zero (k : ℕ) : (1 : K) + (t.q : K) ^ (k + 1) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := t.norm_one_add_qpow k
  rw [h, norm_zero] at this
  exact one_ne_zero this.symm

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.sphereWitness_val
statement:
@[simp] lemma sphereWitness_val (k : ℕ) :
    (t.sphereWitness k : K) = (1 : K) + (t.q : K) ^ (k + 1)
proof: := rfl

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.sphereWitness_injective
statement: lemma sphereWitness_injective : Function.Injective t.sphereWitness
proof:
:= by
  intro j k h
  have hv : (1 : K) + (t.q : K) ^ (j + 1) = (1 : K) + (t.q : K) ^ (k + 1) := by
    have := congrArg (Units.val) h
    simpa only [sphereWitness_val] using this
  have hq : (t.q : K) ^ (j + 1) = (t.q : K) ^ (k + 1) := add_left_cancel hv
  have hnorm : ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ (j + 1) = ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ (k + 1) := by
    rw [← norm_pow, ← norm_pow, hq]
  have := pow_right_injective₀ t.norm_q_pos (ne_of_lt t.norm_lt_one) hnorm
  omega

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.laurentCoeffUnique_of_sphereZerosFinite
statement:
theorem laurentCoeffUnique_of_sphereZerosFinite (t : TateParameter K)
    (hfin : LaurentSphereZerosFinite K) : LaurentCoeffUnique K
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hsa hsb heq
  by_contra hab
  
  have hcne : (a - b) ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hab
  have hcsum : ∀ u : Kˣ, Summable fun n : ℤ => (a - b) n * (u : K) ^ n := by
    intro u
    refine ((hsa u).sub (hsb u)).congr fun n => ?_
    rw [Pi.sub_apply, sub_mul]
  have hczero : ∀ u : Kˣ, (∑' n : ℤ, (a - b) n * (u : K) ^ n) = 0 := by
    intro u
    have hsplit : (∑' n : ℤ, (a - b) n * (u : K) ^ n)
        = (∑' n : ℤ, a n * (u : K) ^ n) - ∑' n : ℤ, b n * (u : K) ^ n := by
      rw [← (hsa u).tsum_sub (hsb u)]
      exact tsum_congr fun n => by rw [Pi.sub_apply, sub_mul]
    rw [hsplit, heq u, sub_self]
  
  have hZfin := hfin (a - b) hcne hcsum 1
  
  have hmem : ∀ k : ℕ, t.sphereWitness k ∈
      {u : Kˣ | ‖(u : K)‖ = 1 ∧ (∑' n : ℤ, (a - b) n * (u : K) ^ n) = 0} := by
    intro k
    exact ⟨by rw [sphereWitness_val]; exact t.norm_one_add_qpow k, hczero _⟩
  exact (Set.infinite_of_injective_forall_mem t.sphereWitness_injective hmem) hZfin

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.const_of_qinvariant_laurent_of_sphereZerosFinite
statement:
theorem const_of_qinvariant_laurent_of_sphereZerosFinite (hfin : LaurentSphereZerosFinite K)
    (a : ℤ → K) (hsum : ∀ u : Kˣ, Summable fun n : ℤ => a n * (u : K) ^ n)
    (hqinv : ∀ u : Kˣ,
      (∑' n : ℤ, a n * ((t.q : K) * (u : K)) ^ n) = ∑' n : ℤ, a n * (u : K) ^ n) :
    ∀ u : Kˣ, (∑' n : ℤ, a n * (u : K) ^ n) = a 0
proof:
:=
  t.const_of_qinvariant_laurent (t.laurentCoeffUnique_of_sphereZerosFinite hfin) a hsum hqinv

name: TateCurvesTheta.laurentSphereZerosFinite_of_unitSphere
statement:
theorem laurentSphereZerosFinite_of_unitSphere (h : LaurentUnitSphereZerosFinite K) :
    LaurentSphereZerosFinite K
proof:
:= by
  intro c hc hsum ρ
  by_cases hρ : ∃ u₀ : Kˣ, ‖(u₀ : K)‖ = ρ
  · obtain ⟨u₀, hu₀⟩ := hρ
    have hρpos : 0 < ρ := hu₀ ▸ norm_pos_iff.mpr (Units.ne_zero u₀)
    
    set d : ℤ → K := fun n => c n * (u₀ : K) ^ n with hd
    
    have hterm : ∀ (v : Kˣ) (n : ℤ),
        c n * ((u₀ * v : Kˣ) : K) ^ n = d n * (v : K) ^ n := by
      intro v n
      rw [Units.val_mul, mul_zpow, hd]; ring
    
    have hdne : d ≠ 0 := by
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hc
      exact Function.ne_iff.mpr ⟨m, mul_ne_zero hm (zpow_ne_zero m (Units.ne_zero u₀))⟩
    
    have hdsum : ∀ v : Kˣ, Summable fun n : ℤ => d n * (v : K) ^ n := by
      intro v
      exact (hsum (u₀ * v)).congr (hterm v)
    
    have hfin := h d hdne hdsum
    
    refine Set.Finite.subset (hfin.image fun v : Kˣ => u₀ * v) ?_
    rintro u ⟨hnorm, hzero⟩
    refine ⟨u₀⁻¹ * u, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · 
      have hval : (u₀ : K) * ((u₀⁻¹ * u : Kˣ) : K) = (u : K) := by
        rw [← Units.val_mul, mul_inv_cancel_left]
      have hnorms : ‖(u₀ : K)‖ * ‖((u₀⁻¹ * u : Kˣ) : K)‖ = ‖(u : K)‖ := by
        rw [← norm_mul, hval]
      rw [hu₀, hnorm] at hnorms
      exact mul_left_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hρpos) (hnorms.trans (mul_one ρ).symm)
    · 
      have hval : (u₀ * (u₀⁻¹ * u) : Kˣ) = u := by rw [mul_inv_cancel_left]
      calc (∑' n : ℤ, d n * ((u₀⁻¹ * u : Kˣ) : K) ^ n)
          = ∑' n : ℤ, c n * ((u₀ * (u₀⁻¹ * u) : Kˣ) : K) ^ n :=
            (tsum_congr fun n => (hterm (u₀⁻¹ * u) n).symm)
        _ = ∑' n : ℤ, c n * (u : K) ^ n := by rw [hval]
        _ = 0 := hzero
    · 
      exact mul_inv_cancel_left u₀ u
  · 
    convert Set.finite_empty
    ext u
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false, not_and]
    exact fun hnorm _ => hρ ⟨u, hnorm⟩

name: TateCurvesTheta.tsum_ne_zero_of_strictDom
statement:
theorem tsum_ne_zero_of_strictDom (hdom : LaurentStrictDom K) (c : ℤ → K)
    (hsum : ∀ u : Kˣ, Summable fun n : ℤ => c n * (u : K) ^ n) (hc : ∃ m : ℤ, c m ≠ 0) :
    ∃ u : Kˣ, (∑' n : ℤ, c n * (u : K) ^ n) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, n₀, hlt⟩ := hdom c hsum hc
  refine ⟨u, ?_⟩
  
  have hpos : 0 < ‖c n₀ * (u : K) ^ n₀‖ :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (norm_nonneg _) (hlt (n₀ + 1) (by omega))
  have hval : ‖∑' n : ℤ, c n * (u : K) ^ n‖ = ‖c n₀ * (u : K) ^ n₀‖ :=
    IsUltrametricDist.norm_tsum_eq_of_dominant (hsum u) hlt
  rw [← norm_ne_zero_iff, hval]
  exact ne_of_gt hpos

name: TateCurvesTheta.laurentCoeffUnique_of_strictDom
statement: theorem laurentCoeffUnique_of_strictDom (hdom : LaurentStrictDom K) : LaurentCoeffUnique K
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hsa hsb heq
  by_contra hab
  
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hab
  have hcm : a m - b m ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hm
  have hcsum : ∀ u : Kˣ, Summable fun n : ℤ => (a n - b n) * (u : K) ^ n := by
    intro u
    refine ((hsa u).sub (hsb u)).congr fun n => ?_
    rw [sub_mul]
  have hczero : ∀ u : Kˣ, (∑' n : ℤ, (a n - b n) * (u : K) ^ n) = 0 := by
    intro u
    have hsplit : (∑' n : ℤ, (a n - b n) * (u : K) ^ n)
        = (∑' n : ℤ, a n * (u : K) ^ n) - ∑' n : ℤ, b n * (u : K) ^ n := by
      rw [← (hsa u).tsum_sub (hsb u)]
      exact tsum_congr fun n => by rw [sub_mul]
    rw [hsplit, heq u, sub_self]
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := tsum_ne_zero_of_strictDom hdom (fun n => a n - b n) hcsum ⟨m, hcm⟩
  exact hu (hczero u)

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.const_of_qinvariant_laurent_of_strictDom
statement:
theorem const_of_qinvariant_laurent_of_strictDom (hdom : LaurentStrictDom K) (a : ℤ → K)
    (hsum : ∀ u : Kˣ, Summable fun n : ℤ => a n * (u : K) ^ n)
    (hqinv : ∀ u : Kˣ,
      (∑' n : ℤ, a n * ((t.q : K) * (u : K)) ^ n) = ∑' n : ℤ, a n * (u : K) ^ n) :
    ∀ u : Kˣ, (∑' n : ℤ, a n * (u : K) ^ n) = a 0
proof:
:=
  t.const_of_qinvariant_laurent (laurentCoeffUnique_of_strictDom hdom) a hsum hqinv

name: TateCurvesTheta.laurentUnitSphereZerosFinite
statement: theorem laurentUnitSphereZerosFinite : LaurentUnitSphereZerosFinite K
proof:
:= by
  intro c hc0 hsum
  
  have hc : Summable c := by
    have h := hsum 1
    simpa using h
  have hfin := StrassmannSphere.finite_zeros hc hc0
  
  refine Set.Finite.of_finite_image ?_ (fun a _ b _ h => Units.ext h)
  refine hfin.subset ?_
  rintro v ⟨u, ⟨hu1, huz⟩, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨hu1, huz⟩

name: TateCurvesTheta.laurentSphereZerosFinite
statement: theorem laurentSphereZerosFinite : LaurentSphereZerosFinite K
proof:
:=
  laurentSphereZerosFinite_of_unitSphere laurentUnitSphereZerosFinite

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.laurentCoeffUnique
statement: theorem laurentCoeffUnique (t : TateParameter K) : LaurentCoeffUnique K
proof:
:=
  laurentCoeffUnique_of_sphereZerosFinite t laurentSphereZerosFinite

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.const_of_qinvariant_laurent'
statement:
theorem const_of_qinvariant_laurent' (t : TateParameter K) (a : ℤ → K)
    (hsum : ∀ u : Kˣ, Summable fun n : ℤ => a n * (u : K) ^ n)
    (hqinv : ∀ u : Kˣ,
      (∑' n : ℤ, a n * ((t.q : K) * (u : K)) ^ n) = ∑' n : ℤ, a n * (u : K) ^ n) :
    ∀ u : Kˣ, (∑' n : ℤ, a n * (u : K) ^ n) = a 0
proof:
:=
  t.const_of_qinvariant_laurent (laurentCoeffUnique t) a hsum hqinv

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.thetaProdLaurentCoeff_zero_eq
statement:
lemma thetaProdLaurentCoeff_zero_eq :
    t.thetaProdLaurentCoeff 0
      = t.thetaProdFactor (-(t.q : K)) * ∑' k : ℕ, factorCoeff t k ^ 2 * (t.q : K) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [thetaProdLaurentCoeff]
  congr 1
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun k : ℕ => -(k : ℤ)) := fun a b h => by simpa using h
  have hoff : ∀ m : ℤ, m ∉ Set.range (fun k : ℕ => -(k : ℤ)) →
      t.aLaurentCoeff (0 - m) * t.bLaurentCoeff m = 0 := by
    intro m hm
    rw [Set.mem_range] at hm
    have hpos : 0 < m := by
      by_contra h
      exact hm ⟨(-m).toNat, by simp [Int.toNat_of_nonneg (neg_nonneg.mpr (not_lt.mp h))]⟩
    simp [t.bLaurentCoeff_of_pos hpos]
  rw [← hinj.tsum_eq (f := fun m : ℤ => t.aLaurentCoeff (0 - m) * t.bLaurentCoeff m)
    (Function.support_subset_iff'.mpr hoff)]
  refine tsum_congr fun k => ?_
  simp only [zero_sub, neg_neg, aLaurentCoeff_natCast, bLaurentCoeff_negNatCast]
  ring

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.const_eq_thetaProdLaurentCoeff_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hAsum : ∀ u : Kˣ, Summable fun n : ℤ => t.thetaProdLaurentCoeff n * (u : K) ^ n :=
    fun u => (t.thetaProd_hasSum_laurent u).summable
  have hBsum : ∀ u : Kˣ,
      Summable fun n : ℤ => (b₀ * (t.q : K) ^ (thetaExp n)) * (u : K) ^ n := by
    intro u
    refine ((t.thetaTerm_summable u).mul_left b₀).congr fun n => ?_
    rw [thetaTerm]; ring
  have heq : ∀ u : Kˣ,
      (∑' n : ℤ, t.thetaProdLaurentCoeff n * (u : K) ^ n)
        = ∑' n : ℤ, (b₀ * (t.q : K) ^ (thetaExp n)) * (u : K) ^ n := by
    intro u
    rw [(t.thetaProd_hasSum_laurent u).tsum_eq, hb₀ u, theta_apply, ← tsum_mul_left]
    exact tsum_congr fun n => by ring
  have hcoeff := t.laurentCoeffUnique _ _ hAsum hBsum heq
  have h0 := congrFun hcoeff 0
  have hz : thetaExp 0 = 0 := by simp [thetaExp]
  rw [hz, zpow_zero, mul_one] at h0
  exact h0.symm

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.const_eq_thetaProdNormConst
statement:
lemma const_eq_thetaProdNormConst {b₀ : K} (hb₀ : ∀ u : Kˣ, t.thetaProd u = b₀ * t.theta u) :
    b₀ = t.thetaProdNormConst
proof:
:= by
  rw [t.const_eq_thetaProdLaurentCoeff_zero hb₀, t.thetaProdLaurentCoeff_zero_eq,
    thetaProdNormConst]

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.theta_eq_thetaProd_of_durfee
statement:
theorem theta_eq_thetaProd_of_durfee (hnorm : t.thetaProdNormConst = 1) (u : Kˣ) :
    t.theta u = t.thetaProd u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b₀, hb₀⟩ :=
    t.thetaProd_eq_const_mul_theta_of_laurentCoeffUnique t.laurentCoeffUnique
  have hb1 : b₀ = 1 := by rw [t.const_eq_thetaProdNormConst hb₀, hnorm]
  rw [hb₀ u, hb1, one_mul]

name: TateCurvesTheta.thetaExp_add
statement: lemma thetaExp_add (m n : ℤ) : thetaExp (m + n) = thetaExp m + thetaExp n + m * n
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : (2 : ℤ) * thetaExp (m + n) = 2 * (thetaExp m + thetaExp n + m * n) := by
    have h := two_mul_thetaExp (m + n)
    have hm := two_mul_thetaExp m
    have hn := two_mul_thetaExp n
    linear_combination h - hm - hn
  linarith

name: TateCurvesTheta.thetaExp_one
statement: lemma thetaExp_one : thetaExp 1 = 1
proof: := by decide

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.theta_zpow_smul_eq
statement:
theorem theta_zpow_smul_eq (u : Kˣ) (m : ℤ) :
    T.theta u = (T.q : K) ^ thetaExp m * (u : K) ^ m * T.theta (T.q ^ m * u)
proof:
:= by
  have hq : (T.q : K) ≠ 0 := T.q.ne_zero
  have hu : (u : K) ≠ 0 := u.ne_zero
  simp only [theta]
  rw [← Equiv.tsum_eq (Equiv.addRight m) (T.thetaTerm u)]
  rw [← tsum_mul_left]
  refine tsum_congr fun n => ?_
  simp only [thetaTerm, Equiv.coe_addRight, Units.val_mul, Units.val_zpow_eq_zpow_val]
  rw [thetaExp_add n m, mul_zpow, ← zpow_mul, zpow_add₀ hq, zpow_add₀ hq, zpow_add₀ hu,
    mul_comm n m]
  ring

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.theta_zpow_q_smul
statement:
theorem theta_zpow_q_smul (u : Kˣ) (m : ℤ) :
    T.theta (T.q ^ m * u) = ((T.q : K) ^ thetaExp m * (u : K) ^ m)⁻¹ * T.theta u
proof:
:= by
  have hq : (T.q : K) ≠ 0 := T.q.ne_zero
  have hu : (u : K) ≠ 0 := u.ne_zero
  have hC : (T.q : K) ^ thetaExp m * (u : K) ^ m ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (zpow_ne_zero _ hq) (zpow_ne_zero _ hu)
  rw [T.theta_zpow_smul_eq u m, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hC, one_mul]

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.theta_q_smul
statement:
theorem theta_q_smul (u : Kˣ) :
    T.theta (T.q * u) = ((T.q : K) * (u : K))⁻¹ * T.theta u
proof:
:= by
  have h := T.theta_zpow_q_smul u 1
  simpa only [zpow_one, thetaExp_one] using h

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.thetaProdFactor_apply
statement:
lemma thetaProdFactor_apply (c : K) :
    t.thetaProdFactor c = ∏' n : ℕ, (1 + (t.q : K) ^ n * c)
proof: := rfl

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.thetaProd_apply
statement:
lemma thetaProd_apply (u : Kˣ) :
    t.thetaProd u = t.thetaProdFactor (-(t.q : K)) * t.thetaProdFactor ((t.q : K) * (u : K)) *
      t.thetaProdFactor ((u : K)⁻¹)
proof: := rfl

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.multipliable_thetaProdFactor
statement:
lemma multipliable_thetaProdFactor [CompleteSpace K] (c : K) :
    Multipliable (fun n : ℕ => 1 + (t.q : K) ^ n * c)
proof:
:= by
  apply multipliable_one_add_of_summable
  have hnorm : (fun n : ℕ => ‖(t.q : K) ^ n * c‖) = fun n : ℕ => ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ n * ‖c‖ := by
    funext n; rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
  rw [hnorm]
  exact (summable_geometric_of_lt_one (norm_nonneg _) t.norm_lt_one).mul_right ‖c‖

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.multipliable_thetaProd_qpow
statement:
lemma multipliable_thetaProd_qpow [CompleteSpace K] :
    Multipliable (fun n : ℕ => 1 + (t.q : K) ^ n * (-(t.q : K)))
proof:
:=
  t.multipliable_thetaProdFactor _

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.multipliable_thetaProd_u
statement:
lemma multipliable_thetaProd_u [CompleteSpace K] (u : Kˣ) :
    Multipliable (fun n : ℕ => 1 + (t.q : K) ^ n * ((t.q : K) * (u : K)))
proof:
:=
  t.multipliable_thetaProdFactor _

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.multipliable_thetaProd_uinv
statement:
lemma multipliable_thetaProd_uinv [CompleteSpace K] (u : Kˣ) :
    Multipliable (fun n : ℕ => 1 + (t.q : K) ^ n * (u : K)⁻¹)
proof:
:=
  t.multipliable_thetaProdFactor _

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.thetaProdFactor_eq
statement:
lemma thetaProdFactor_eq [CompleteSpace K] (c : K) :
    t.thetaProdFactor c = (1 + c) * t.thetaProdFactor ((t.q : K) * c)
proof:
:= by
  
  
  
  have hshift : Multipliable (fun n : ℕ => 1 + (t.q : K) ^ (n + 1) * c) := by
    have h := t.multipliable_thetaProdFactor ((t.q : K) * c)
    have hfun : (fun n : ℕ => 1 + (t.q : K) ^ (n + 1) * c)
        = fun n : ℕ => 1 + (t.q : K) ^ n * ((t.q : K) * c) := by
      funext n; rw [pow_succ]; ring
    rw [hfun]; exact h
  have key : (∏' n : ℕ, (1 + (t.q : K) ^ n * c))
      = (1 + (t.q : K) ^ 0 * c) * ∏' n : ℕ, (1 + (t.q : K) ^ (n + 1) * c) :=
    tprod_eq_zero_mul' (f := fun n : ℕ => 1 + (t.q : K) ^ n * c) hshift
  rw [thetaProdFactor, key, pow_zero, one_mul]
  congr 1
  rw [thetaProdFactor]
  refine tprod_congr fun n => ?_
  rw [pow_succ]; ring

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.thetaProd_q_smul
statement:
theorem thetaProd_q_smul [CompleteSpace K] (u : Kˣ) :
    t.thetaProd (t.q * u) = ((t.q : K) * (u : K))⁻¹ * t.thetaProd u
proof:
:= by
  set w : K := (t.q : K) * (u : K) with hw
  have hwne : w ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero t.q.ne_zero u.ne_zero
  
  have hA : t.thetaProdFactor w = (1 + w) * t.thetaProdFactor ((t.q : K) * w) :=
    t.thetaProdFactor_eq w
  
  
  have hqw : (t.q : K) * w⁻¹ = (u : K)⁻¹ := by
    rw [hw, mul_inv_rev, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm (t.q : K), mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ t.q.ne_zero,
      mul_one]
  have hB : t.thetaProdFactor w⁻¹ = (1 + w⁻¹) * t.thetaProdFactor ((u : K)⁻¹) := by
    rw [t.thetaProdFactor_eq w⁻¹, hqw]
  
  have hscal : (1 + w⁻¹) = w⁻¹ * (1 + w) := by
    rw [mul_add, mul_one, inv_mul_cancel₀ hwne, add_comm]
  
  rw [thetaProd_apply, thetaProd_apply]
  simp only [Units.val_mul, ← hw]
  rw [hB, hA, hscal]
  ring

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.thetaProdFactor_neg_q_factor_ne_zero
statement:
lemma thetaProdFactor_neg_q_factor_ne_zero (n : ℕ) :
    (1 : K) + (t.q : K) ^ n * (-(t.q : K)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : (1 : K) + (t.q : K) ^ n * (-(t.q : K)) = 1 - (t.q : K) ^ (n + 1) := by
    rw [pow_succ]; ring
  rw [h, sub_ne_zero]
  exact (t.pow_ne_one n.succ_pos).symm

name: TateCurvesTheta.EntireBound.summable_one
statement: lemma EntireBound.summable_one {A : ℤ → ℝ} (hA : EntireBound A) : Summable A
proof:
:= by
  have h := hA.summable 1 one_pos
  exact h.congr fun m => by simp

name: TateCurvesTheta.summable_rconv_slice
statement:
lemma summable_rconv_slice {A B : ℤ → ℝ} (hA : EntireBound A) (hB : EntireBound B) (ℓ : ℤ) :
    Summable fun m : ℤ => A (ℓ - m) * B m
proof:
:= by
  have hprod : Summable fun p : ℤ × ℤ => A p.1 * B p.2 :=
    hA.summable_one.mul_of_nonneg hB.summable_one (fun n => hA.nonneg n) fun m => hB.nonneg m
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun m : ℤ => ((ℓ - m, m) : ℤ × ℤ)) := fun a b hab => by
    simpa using congrArg Prod.snd hab
  have h := hprod.comp_injective hinj
  exact h.congr fun m => rfl

name: TateCurvesTheta.EntireBound.rconv
statement:
lemma EntireBound.rconv {A B : ℤ → ℝ} (hA : EntireBound A) (hB : EntireBound B) :
    EntireBound (rconv A B)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro ℓ
    exact tsum_nonneg fun m => mul_nonneg (hA.nonneg _) (hB.nonneg _)
  · intro r hr
    have hprod := (hA.summable r hr).mul_of_nonneg (hB.summable r hr)
      (fun n => mul_nonneg (hA.nonneg n) (zpow_nonneg hr.le n))
      (fun m => mul_nonneg (hB.nonneg m) (zpow_nonneg hr.le m))
    have hshear : Summable fun p : ℤ × ℤ => A (p.1 - p.2) * B p.2 * r ^ p.1 := by
      have h := (shearZ.summable_iff
        (f := fun p : ℤ × ℤ => (A p.1 * r ^ p.1) * (B p.2 * r ^ p.2))).mpr hprod
      refine h.congr fun p => ?_
      change (A (p.1 - p.2) * r ^ (p.1 - p.2)) * (B p.2 * r ^ p.2)
          = A (p.1 - p.2) * B p.2 * r ^ p.1
      rw [mul_mul_mul_comm, ← zpow_add₀ (ne_of_gt hr), sub_add_cancel]
    have hfib : ∀ ℓ : ℤ, HasSum (fun m : ℤ => A (ℓ - m) * B m * r ^ ℓ)
        (TateCurvesTheta.rconv A B ℓ * r ^ ℓ) := fun ℓ =>
      ((summable_rconv_slice hA hB ℓ).hasSum.mul_right (r ^ ℓ))
    exact (hshear.hasSum.prod_fiberwise hfib).summable

name: TateCurvesTheta.EntireBound.shift
statement:
lemma EntireBound.shift {A : ℤ → ℝ} (hA : EntireBound A) (d : ℤ) :
    EntireBound fun m => A (m - d)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro m; exact hA.nonneg _
  · intro r hr
    refine ((Equiv.addRight d).summable_iff (f := fun m : ℤ => A (m - d) * r ^ m)).mp ?_
    have hfun : ((fun m : ℤ => A (m - d) * r ^ m) ∘ (Equiv.addRight d))
        = fun m : ℤ => A m * r ^ m * r ^ d := by
      funext m
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, Equiv.coe_addRight, add_sub_cancel_right]
      rw [zpow_add₀ (ne_of_gt hr), mul_assoc]
    rw [hfun]
    exact (hA.summable r hr).mul_right _

name: TateCurvesTheta.EntireBound.add
statement:
lemma EntireBound.add {A B : ℤ → ℝ} (hA : EntireBound A) (hB : EntireBound B) :
    EntireBound fun m => A m + B m
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro m; exact add_nonneg (hA.nonneg m) (hB.nonneg m)
  · intro r hr
    exact ((hA.summable r hr).add (hB.summable r hr)).congr fun m => (add_mul _ _ _).symm

name: TateCurvesTheta.norm_lconv_le
statement:
lemma norm_lconv_le {α β : ℤ → K} {A B : ℤ → ℝ} (hA : EntireBound A) (hB : EntireBound B)
    (hα : ∀ k, ‖α k‖ ≤ A k) (hβ : ∀ m, ‖β m‖ ≤ B m) (ℓ : ℤ) :
    ‖lconv α β ℓ‖ ≤ rconv A B ℓ
proof:
:= by
  refine (IsUltrametricDist.norm_tsum_le _).trans (ciSup_le fun m => ?_)
  have h1 : ‖α (ℓ - m) * β m‖ ≤ A (ℓ - m) * B m := by
    rw [norm_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul (hα _) (hβ _) (norm_nonneg _) ((norm_nonneg _).trans (hα _))
  exact h1.trans ((summable_rconv_slice hA hB ℓ).le_tsum m
    fun j _ => mul_nonneg (hA.nonneg _) (hB.nonneg _))

name: TateCurvesTheta.summable_pow_natAbs
statement:
private lemma summable_pow_natAbs {c : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ c) (h1 : c < 1) :
    Summable fun n : ℤ => c ^ n.natAbs
proof:
:= by
  apply Summable.of_nat_of_neg_add_one
  · exact (summable_geometric_of_lt_one h0 h1).congr fun k => by
      simp [Int.natAbs_natCast]
  · refine ((summable_geometric_of_lt_one h0 h1).mul_right c).congr fun k => ?_
    have hk : ((-(↑k + 1) : ℤ)).natAbs = k + 1 := by omega
    rw [hk, pow_succ]

name: TateCurvesTheta.hasSum_int_nonneg_support
proof:
:= by
  have hneg : HasSum (fun k : ℕ => f (-((k : ℤ) + 1))) 0 := by
    have hz : (fun k : ℕ => f (-((k : ℤ) + 1))) = fun _ => (0 : K) :=
      funext fun k => h0 _ (by omega)
    rw [hz]
    exact hasSum_zero
  simpa using h.of_nat_of_neg_add_one hneg

name: TateCurvesTheta.hasSum_int_nonpos_support
proof:
:= by
  have hflip : HasSum (fun n : ℤ => f (-n)) S :=
    hasSum_int_nonneg_support (fun n hn => h0 _ (by omega)) (by simpa using h)
  exact (Equiv.neg ℤ).hasSum_iff.mp hflip

name: TateCurvesTheta.hasSum_mul_zpow_shift
proof:
:= by
  refine ((Equiv.addRight d).hasSum_iff).mp ?_
  have hfun : ((fun m : ℤ => f (m - d) * (u : K) ^ m) ∘ (Equiv.addRight d))
      = fun m : ℤ => f m * (u : K) ^ m * (u : K) ^ d := by
    funext m
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, Equiv.coe_addRight, add_sub_cancel_right]
    rw [zpow_add₀ u.ne_zero, mul_assoc]
  rw [hfun]
  exact h.mul_right _

name: TateCurvesTheta.triangle_succ
statement: private lemma triangle_succ (k : ℕ) : (k + 1) * (k + 1 - 1) / 2 = k * (k - 1) / 2 + k
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.sum_range_id k, ← Finset.sum_range_id (k + 1), Finset.sum_range_succ]

name: TateCurvesTheta.two_mul_triangle
statement: private lemma two_mul_triangle (k : ℕ) : 2 * (k * (k - 1) / 2) = k * (k - 1)
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ j =>
    have h : (2 : ℕ) ∣ (j + 1) * (j + 1 - 1) := by
      simpa [mul_comm] using (Nat.even_mul_succ_self j).two_dvd
    exact Nat.mul_div_cancel' h

name: TateCurvesTheta.triangle_natAbs_le_thetaExp
statement:
private lemma triangle_natAbs_le_thetaExp (m : ℤ) :
    ((m.natAbs * (m.natAbs - 1) / 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ thetaExp m
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : (2 : ℤ) * ((m.natAbs * (m.natAbs - 1) / 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)
      = (m.natAbs : ℤ) * (m.natAbs : ℤ) - (m.natAbs : ℤ) := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m.natAbs with h | h
    · rw [h]; simp
    · have hcast : ((m.natAbs * (m.natAbs - 1) : ℕ) : ℤ)
          = (m.natAbs : ℤ) * (m.natAbs : ℤ) - (m.natAbs : ℤ) := by
        rw [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_sub h]
        ring
      calc (2 : ℤ) * ((m.natAbs * (m.natAbs - 1) / 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)
          = ((2 * (m.natAbs * (m.natAbs - 1) / 2) : ℕ) : ℤ) := by push_cast; ring
        _ = ((m.natAbs * (m.natAbs - 1) : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
            exact_mod_cast congrArg (Nat.cast (R := ℤ)) (two_mul_triangle m.natAbs)
        _ = _ := hcast
  have h3 : 2 * thetaExp m = m * (m + 1) := two_mul_thetaExp m
  have h4 : (m.natAbs : ℤ) * (m.natAbs : ℤ) = m * m := by
    rw [← Int.natCast_mul]
    exact Int.natAbs_mul_self
  have h5 : -(m.natAbs : ℤ) ≤ m := by omega
  nlinarith [h2, h3, h4, h5]

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.pFactorCoeff_zero
statement: lemma pFactorCoeff_zero (k : ℕ) : t.pFactorCoeff 0 k = factorCoeff t k * (t.q : K) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  simp [pFactorCoeff]

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.pFactorCoeff_succ_zero
statement: lemma pFactorCoeff_succ_zero (p : ℕ) : t.pFactorCoeff (p + 1) 0 = t.pFactorCoeff p 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [pFactorCoeff]

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.pFactorCoeff_succ_succ
statement:
lemma pFactorCoeff_succ_succ (p k : ℕ) :
    t.pFactorCoeff (p + 1) (k + 1)
      = (t.q : K) ^ (k + 1) * t.pFactorCoeff p (k + 1) + (t.q : K) ^ k * t.pFactorCoeff p k
proof:
:= by
  simp [pFactorCoeff]

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.norm_pFactorCoeff_le
statement:
lemma norm_pFactorCoeff_le (p k : ℕ) :
    ‖t.pFactorCoeff p k‖ ≤ ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ (k * (k - 1) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  induction p generalizing k with
  | zero =>
    rw [pFactorCoeff_zero, norm_mul, norm_pow, t.norm_factorCoeff k]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (by positivity)
      (pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) t.norm_lt_one.le)
  | succ p ih =>
    cases k with
    | zero => simpa [pFactorCoeff_succ_zero] using ih 0
    | succ k =>
      rw [pFactorCoeff_succ_succ]
      refine (IsUltrametricDist.norm_add_le_max _ _).trans (max_le ?_ ?_)
      · rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
        exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (by positivity)
          (pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) t.norm_lt_one.le) |>.trans'
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ih (k + 1)) (by positivity))
      · rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
        calc ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ k * ‖t.pFactorCoeff p k‖
            ≤ ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ k * ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ (k * (k - 1) / 2) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ih k) (by positivity)
          _ = ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ ((k + 1) * (k + 1 - 1) / 2) := by
              rw [← pow_add, triangle_succ, Nat.add_comm]

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.summable_norm_q_triangle_mul
statement:
private lemma summable_norm_q_triangle_mul (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    Summable fun k : ℕ => ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ (k * (k - 1) / 2) * r ^ k
proof:
:= by
  refine summable_of_ratio_norm_eventually_le (r := 1 / 2) (by norm_num) ?_
  have htend : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ k * r) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa using
      (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (norm_nonneg _) t.norm_lt_one).mul_const r
  filter_upwards [htend.eventually_le_const (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2 by norm_num)] with k hk
  have key : ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ ((k + 1) * (k + 1 - 1) / 2) * r ^ (k + 1)
      = (‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ k * r) * (‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ (k * (k - 1) / 2) * r ^ k) := by
    rw [triangle_succ, pow_add, pow_succ]
    ring
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity),
    abs_of_nonneg (by positivity), key]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hk (by positivity)

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.summable_pFactorCoeff_mul_pow
statement:
lemma summable_pFactorCoeff_mul_pow (p : ℕ) (c : K) :
    Summable fun k : ℕ => t.pFactorCoeff p k * c ^ k
proof:
:= by
  apply NonarchimedeanAddGroup.summable_of_tendsto_cofinite_zero
  rw [Nat.cofinite_eq_atTop]
  apply tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero.mpr
  have hb : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ (k * (k - 1) / 2) * ‖c‖ ^ k) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    (t.summable_norm_q_triangle_mul ‖c‖ (norm_nonneg c)).tendsto_atTop_zero
  refine squeeze_zero (fun k => norm_nonneg _) (fun k => ?_) hb
  rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (t.norm_pFactorCoeff_le p k) (by positivity)

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.pFactorSeries_succ
statement:
lemma pFactorSeries_succ (p : ℕ) (c : K) :
    t.pFactorSeries (p + 1) c = (1 + c) * t.pFactorSeries p ((t.q : K) * c)
proof:
:= by
  have hg := t.summable_pFactorCoeff_mul_pow p ((t.q : K) * c)
  have hd : Summable (fun k : ℕ =>
      t.pFactorCoeff (p + 1) k * c ^ k - t.pFactorCoeff p k * ((t.q : K) * c) ^ k) :=
    (t.summable_pFactorCoeff_mul_pow (p + 1) c).sub hg
  have hsplit : ∀ k : ℕ, t.pFactorCoeff (p + 1) k * c ^ k
      = t.pFactorCoeff p k * ((t.q : K) * c) ^ k
        + (t.pFactorCoeff (p + 1) k * c ^ k - t.pFactorCoeff p k * ((t.q : K) * c) ^ k) :=
    fun k => by ring
  rw [pFactorSeries, pFactorSeries, tsum_congr hsplit, Summable.tsum_add hg hd, add_mul, one_mul]
  congr 1
  rw [hd.tsum_eq_zero_add]
  simp only [pow_zero, mul_one, pFactorCoeff_succ_zero, sub_self, zero_add]
  rw [← tsum_mul_left]
  refine tsum_congr fun k => ?_
  rw [pFactorCoeff_succ_succ, mul_pow, mul_pow]
  ring

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.one_add_qpow_mul_pFactorSeries
statement:
lemma one_add_qpow_mul_pFactorSeries (p : ℕ) (c : K) :
    (1 + (t.q : K) ^ p * c) * t.pFactorSeries p c = t.thetaProdFactor c
proof:
:= by
  induction p generalizing c with
  | zero =>
    have h0 : t.pFactorSeries 0 c = ∑' k : ℕ, factorCoeff t k * ((t.q : K) * c) ^ k := by
      refine tsum_congr fun k => ?_
      rw [pFactorCoeff_zero, mul_pow]
      ring
    rw [pow_zero, one_mul, h0, ← thetaProdFactor_eq_tsum, ← thetaProdFactor_eq]
  | succ p ih =>
    rw [pFactorSeries_succ]
    have hswap : (1 + (t.q : K) ^ (p + 1) * c) * ((1 + c) * t.pFactorSeries p ((t.q : K) * c))
        = (1 + c)
          * ((1 + (t.q : K) ^ p * ((t.q : K) * c)) * t.pFactorSeries p ((t.q : K) * c)) := by
      ring
    rw [hswap, ih ((t.q : K) * c), ← thetaProdFactor_eq]

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.entireBound_triangleBound
statement: private lemma entireBound_triangleBound : EntireBound t.triangleBound
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro m
    exact pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _
  · intro r hr
    apply Summable.of_nat_of_neg_add_one
    · exact (t.summable_norm_q_triangle_mul r hr.le).congr fun k => by
        simp [triangleBound, Int.natAbs_natCast, zpow_natCast]
    · have h := t.summable_norm_q_triangle_mul r⁻¹ (by positivity)
      have h1 : Summable (fun k : ℕ =>
          ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ ((k + 1) * (k + 1 - 1) / 2) * r⁻¹ ^ (k + 1)) :=
        (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mpr h
      refine h1.congr fun k => ?_
      have hk : ((-(↑k + 1) : ℤ)).natAbs = k + 1 := by omega
      have hz : r ^ (-(↑k + 1) : ℤ) = r⁻¹ ^ (k + 1) := by
        rw [zpow_neg, ← inv_zpow, show ((↑k + 1 : ℤ)) = ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by push_cast; ring,
          zpow_natCast]
      rw [triangleBound, hk, hz]

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.hasSum_thetaNegCoeff
statement:
private lemma hasSum_thetaNegCoeff (u : Kˣ) :
    HasSum (fun m : ℤ => t.thetaNegCoeff m * (u : K) ^ m) (t.theta (-u))
proof:
:= by
  have h : HasSum (fun n : ℤ => t.thetaTerm (-u) n) (t.theta (-u)) :=
    (t.thetaTerm_summable (-u)).hasSum
  have hfun : (fun n : ℤ => t.thetaTerm (-u) n)
      = fun m : ℤ => t.thetaNegCoeff m * (u : K) ^ m := by
    funext n
    rw [thetaTerm, thetaNegCoeff, Units.val_neg, show -(u : K) = (-1 : K) * (u : K) by ring,
      mul_zpow]
    ring
  rwa [hfun] at h

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.norm_thetaNegCoeff_le
statement: private lemma norm_thetaNegCoeff_le (m : ℤ) : ‖t.thetaNegCoeff m‖ ≤ t.triangleBound m
proof:
:= by
  rw [thetaNegCoeff, norm_mul, norm_zpow, norm_zpow, norm_neg, norm_one, one_zpow, one_mul]
  have he : (0 : ℤ) ≤ thetaExp m := thetaExp_nonneg m
  rw [show ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ thetaExp m = ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ (thetaExp m).toNat by
    rw [← zpow_natCast, Int.toNat_of_nonneg he]]
  refine pow_le_pow_of_le_one (norm_nonneg _) t.norm_lt_one.le ?_
  have := triangle_natAbs_le_thetaExp m
  omega

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.hasSum_hFam
proof:
:= by
  apply hasSum_int_nonneg_support (fun n hn => by simp [hFam, not_le.mpr hn])
  have hfun : ∀ k : ℕ, t.hFam (k : ℤ) * (u : K) ^ (k : ℤ)
      = factorCoeff t k * (-((t.q : K) * (u : K))) ^ k := by
    intro k
    simp only [hFam, Int.natAbs_natCast, if_pos (Int.natCast_nonneg k), zpow_natCast]
    rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_pow, neg_mul]
  rw [funext hfun, thetaProdFactor_eq_tsum]
  exact (t.factorCoeff_summable _).hasSum

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.hasSum_gFam
statement:
private lemma hasSum_gFam (u : Kˣ) :
    HasSum (fun m : ℤ => t.gFam m * (u : K) ^ m) (t.thetaProdFactor (-((u : K))⁻¹))
proof:
:= by
  apply hasSum_int_nonpos_support (fun n hn => by simp [gFam, not_le.mpr hn])
  have hfun : ∀ k : ℕ, t.gFam (-(k : ℤ)) * (u : K) ^ (-(k : ℤ))
      = factorCoeff t k * (-((u : K))⁻¹) ^ k := by
    intro k
    simp only [gFam, Int.natAbs_neg, Int.natAbs_natCast, if_pos (neg_nonpos.mpr
      (Int.natCast_nonneg k)), zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, ← inv_pow]
    rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_pow, neg_one_mul]
  rw [funext hfun, thetaProdFactor_eq_tsum]
  exact (t.factorCoeff_summable _).hasSum

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.hasSum_aFam
proof:
:= by
  apply hasSum_int_nonneg_support (fun n hn => by simp [aFam, not_le.mpr hn])
  have hfun : ∀ k : ℕ, t.aFam p (k : ℤ) * (u : K) ^ (k : ℤ)
      = t.pFactorCoeff p k * (-((t.q : K) * (u : K))) ^ k := by
    intro k
    simp only [aFam, Int.natAbs_natCast, if_pos (Int.natCast_nonneg k), zpow_natCast]
    rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_pow, neg_mul]
  rw [funext hfun]
  exact (t.summable_pFactorCoeff_mul_pow p _).hasSum

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.hasSum_bFam
proof:
:= by
  apply hasSum_int_nonpos_support (fun n hn => by simp [bFam, not_le.mpr hn])
  have hfun : ∀ k : ℕ, t.bFam p (-(k : ℤ)) * (u : K) ^ (-(k : ℤ))
      = t.pFactorCoeff p k * (-((u : K))⁻¹) ^ k := by
    intro k
    simp only [bFam, Int.natAbs_neg, Int.natAbs_natCast, if_pos (neg_nonpos.mpr
      (Int.natCast_nonneg k)), zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, ← inv_pow]
    rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_pow, neg_one_mul]
  rw [funext hfun]
  exact (t.summable_pFactorCoeff_mul_pow p _).hasSum

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.norm_hFam_le
statement: private lemma norm_hFam_le (k : ℤ) : ‖t.hFam k‖ ≤ t.triangleBound k
proof:
:= by
  rw [hFam]
  split_ifs with hk
  · rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_neg, t.norm_factorCoeff, triangleBound]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (by positivity)
      (pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) t.norm_lt_one.le)
  · rw [norm_zero, triangleBound]
    positivity

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.norm_gFam_le
statement: private lemma norm_gFam_le (m : ℤ) : ‖t.gFam m‖ ≤ t.triangleBound m
proof:
:= by
  rw [gFam]
  split_ifs with hm
  · rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_neg, norm_one, one_pow, mul_one, t.norm_factorCoeff,
      triangleBound]
  · rw [norm_zero, triangleBound]
    positivity

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.norm_aFam_le
statement: private lemma norm_aFam_le (p : ℕ) (k : ℤ) : ‖t.aFam p k‖ ≤ t.triangleBound k
proof:
:= by
  rw [aFam]
  split_ifs with hk
  · rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_neg, triangleBound]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (norm_nonneg _)
      (pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) t.norm_lt_one.le) |>.trans (t.norm_pFactorCoeff_le p _)
  · rw [norm_zero, triangleBound]
    positivity

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.norm_bFam_le
statement: private lemma norm_bFam_le (p : ℕ) (m : ℤ) : ‖t.bFam p m‖ ≤ t.triangleBound m
proof:
:= by
  rw [bFam]
  split_ifs with hm
  · rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_neg, norm_one, one_pow, mul_one, triangleBound]
    exact t.norm_pFactorCoeff_le p _
  · rw [norm_zero, triangleBound]
    positivity

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.norm_constFactor_le_one
statement: private lemma norm_constFactor_le_one : ‖t.thetaProdFactor (-(t.q : K))‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [thetaProdFactor_eq_tsum]
  refine IsUltrametricDist.norm_tsum_le_of_forall_le_of_nonneg zero_le_one fun k => ?_
  rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_neg, t.norm_factorCoeff]
  exact mul_le_one₀ (pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) t.norm_lt_one.le) (by positivity)
    (pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) t.norm_lt_one.le)

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.theta_neg_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [t.theta_eq_thetaProd (-u), thetaProd_apply]
  simp only [Units.val_neg, mul_neg, inv_neg]

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.hasSum_convXPos
statement:
private lemma hasSum_convXPos (p : ℕ) (u : Kˣ) :
    HasSum (fun ℓ : ℤ => t.convXPos p ℓ * (u : K) ^ ℓ)
      ((t.pFactorSeries p (-((t.q : K) * (u : K)))
          * t.pFactorSeries p (-((t.q : K) * (u : K))))
        * (t.thetaProdFactor (-((u : K))⁻¹) * t.thetaProdFactor (-((u : K))⁻¹)))
proof:
:= by
  have hA := t.hasSum_aFam p u
  have hG := t.hasSum_gFam u
  exact hasSum_laurentConvolution u (hasSum_laurentConvolution u hA hA)
    (hasSum_laurentConvolution u hG hG)

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.hasSum_convXNeg
statement:
private lemma hasSum_convXNeg (p : ℕ) (u : Kˣ) :
    HasSum (fun ℓ : ℤ => t.convXNeg p ℓ * (u : K) ^ ℓ)
      ((t.thetaProdFactor (-((t.q : K) * (u : K)))
          * t.thetaProdFactor (-((t.q : K) * (u : K))))
        * (t.pFactorSeries p (-((u : K))⁻¹) * t.pFactorSeries p (-((u : K))⁻¹)))
proof:
:= by
  have hH := t.hasSum_hFam u
  have hB := t.hasSum_bFam p u
  exact hasSum_laurentConvolution u (hasSum_laurentConvolution u hH hH)
    (hasSum_laurentConvolution u hB hB)

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.hasSum_convYPos
statement:
private lemma hasSum_convYPos (p : ℕ) (u : Kˣ) :
    HasSum (fun ℓ : ℤ => t.convYPos p ℓ * (u : K) ^ ℓ)
      (((t.pFactorSeries p (-((t.q : K) * (u : K)))
            * t.pFactorSeries p (-((t.q : K) * (u : K))))
          * t.pFactorSeries p (-((t.q : K) * (u : K))))
        * ((t.thetaProdFactor (-((u : K))⁻¹) * t.thetaProdFactor (-((u : K))⁻¹))
          * t.thetaProdFactor (-((u : K))⁻¹)))
proof:
:= by
  have hA := t.hasSum_aFam p u
  have hG := t.hasSum_gFam u
  exact hasSum_laurentConvolution u
    (hasSum_laurentConvolution u (hasSum_laurentConvolution u hA hA) hA)
    (hasSum_laurentConvolution u (hasSum_laurentConvolution u hG hG) hG)

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.hasSum_convYNeg
statement:
private lemma hasSum_convYNeg (p : ℕ) (u : Kˣ) :
    HasSum (fun ℓ : ℤ => t.convYNeg p ℓ * (u : K) ^ ℓ)
      (((t.thetaProdFactor (-((t.q : K) * (u : K)))
            * t.thetaProdFactor (-((t.q : K) * (u : K))))
          * t.thetaProdFactor (-((t.q : K) * (u : K))))
        * ((t.pFactorSeries p (-((u : K))⁻¹) * t.pFactorSeries p (-((u : K))⁻¹))
          * t.pFactorSeries p (-((u : K))⁻¹)))
proof:
:= by
  have hH := t.hasSum_hFam u
  have hB := t.hasSum_bFam p u
  exact hasSum_laurentConvolution u
    (hasSum_laurentConvolution u (hasSum_laurentConvolution u hH hH) hH)
    (hasSum_laurentConvolution u (hasSum_laurentConvolution u hB hB) hB)

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.entireBound_bound2
statement: private lemma entireBound_bound2 : EntireBound t.bound2
proof:
:=
  t.entireBound_triangleBound.rconv t.entireBound_triangleBound

:=
  t.entireBound_bound2.rconv t.entireBound_bound2

  t.entireBound_bound3.rconv t.entireBound_bound3

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.norm_convXPos_le
statement: private lemma norm_convXPos_le (p : ℕ) (ℓ : ℤ) : ‖t.convXPos p ℓ‖ ≤ t.bound4 ℓ
proof:
:=
  norm_lconv_le t.entireBound_bound2 t.entireBound_bound2
    (norm_lconv_le t.entireBound_triangleBound t.entireBound_triangleBound
      (t.norm_aFam_le p) (t.norm_aFam_le p))
    (norm_lconv_le t.entireBound_triangleBound t.entireBound_triangleBound
      t.norm_gFam_le t.norm_gFam_le) ℓ

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.norm_convXNeg_le
statement: private lemma norm_convXNeg_le (p : ℕ) (ℓ : ℤ) : ‖t.convXNeg p ℓ‖ ≤ t.bound4 ℓ
proof:
:=
  norm_lconv_le t.entireBound_bound2 t.entireBound_bound2
    (norm_lconv_le t.entireBound_triangleBound t.entireBound_triangleBound
      t.norm_hFam_le t.norm_hFam_le)
    (norm_lconv_le t.entireBound_triangleBound t.entireBound_triangleBound
      (t.norm_bFam_le p) (t.norm_bFam_le p)) ℓ

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.norm_convYPos_le
statement: private lemma norm_convYPos_le (p : ℕ) (ℓ : ℤ) : ‖t.convYPos p ℓ‖ ≤ t.bound6 ℓ
proof:
:=
  norm_lconv_le t.entireBound_bound3 t.entireBound_bound3
    (norm_lconv_le t.entireBound_bound2 t.entireBound_triangleBound
      (norm_lconv_le t.entireBound_triangleBound t.entireBound_triangleBound
        (t.norm_aFam_le p) (t.norm_aFam_le p))
      (t.norm_aFam_le p))
    (norm_lconv_le t.entireBound_bound2 t.entireBound_triangleBound
      (norm_lconv_le t.entireBound_triangleBound t.entireBound_triangleBound
        t.norm_gFam_le t.norm_gFam_le)
      t.norm_gFam_le) ℓ

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.norm_convYNeg_le
statement: private lemma norm_convYNeg_le (p : ℕ) (ℓ : ℤ) : ‖t.convYNeg p ℓ‖ ≤ t.bound6 ℓ
proof:
:=
  norm_lconv_le t.entireBound_bound3 t.entireBound_bound3
    (norm_lconv_le t.entireBound_bound2 t.entireBound_triangleBound
      (norm_lconv_le t.entireBound_triangleBound t.entireBound_triangleBound
        t.norm_hFam_le t.norm_hFam_le)
      t.norm_hFam_le)
    (norm_lconv_le t.entireBound_bound2 t.entireBound_triangleBound
      (norm_lconv_le t.entireBound_triangleBound t.entireBound_triangleBound
        (t.norm_bFam_le p) (t.norm_bFam_le p))
      (t.norm_bFam_le p)) ℓ

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.norm_qzpow_natAbs
statement:
private lemma norm_qzpow_natAbs {n : ℤ} (hn : 0 ≤ n) :
    ‖(t.q : K) ^ n‖ = ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ n.natAbs
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_zpow, ← zpow_natCast ‖(t.q : K)‖ n.natAbs, Int.natAbs_of_nonneg hn]

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.norm_qzpow_le_one
statement: private lemma norm_qzpow_le_one {n : ℤ} (hn : 0 ≤ n) : ‖(t.q : K) ^ n‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [t.norm_qzpow_natAbs hn]
  exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) t.norm_lt_one.le

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.norm_xFam_le
statement:
private lemma norm_xFam_le (n m : ℤ) :
    ‖t.xFam n m‖ ≤ ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ n.natAbs * (t.bound4 (m - 1) + t.bound4 (m + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hb4 := t.entireBound_bound4.nonneg
  have hFq : ‖t.thetaProdFactor (-(t.q : K)) ^ 2‖ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [norm_pow]
    exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) t.norm_constFactor_le_one
  rw [xFam]
  split_ifs with hn
  · rw [norm_mul, norm_mul]
    calc ‖(t.q : K) ^ n‖ * ‖t.thetaProdFactor (-(t.q : K)) ^ 2‖ * ‖t.convXPos (n - 1).toNat (m - 1)‖
        ≤ ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ n.natAbs * 1 * t.bound4 (m - 1) := by
          refine mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul (le_of_eq (t.norm_qzpow_natAbs (by omega))) hFq
            (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)) (t.norm_convXPos_le _ _) (norm_nonneg _)
            (by positivity)
      _ ≤ ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ n.natAbs * (t.bound4 (m - 1) + t.bound4 (m + 1)) := by
          rw [mul_one]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_add_of_nonneg_right (hb4 _)) (by positivity)
  · rw [norm_mul, norm_mul]
    have habs : (-n).natAbs = n.natAbs := Int.natAbs_neg n
    calc ‖(t.q : K) ^ (-n)‖ * ‖t.thetaProdFactor (-(t.q : K)) ^ 2‖
          * ‖t.convXNeg (-n).toNat (m + 1)‖
        ≤ ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ n.natAbs * 1 * t.bound4 (m + 1) := by
          refine mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul ?_ hFq (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity))
            (t.norm_convXNeg_le _ _) (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
          rw [t.norm_qzpow_natAbs (by omega), habs]
      _ ≤ ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ n.natAbs * (t.bound4 (m - 1) + t.bound4 (m + 1)) := by
          rw [mul_one]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_add_of_nonneg_left (hb4 _)) (by positivity)

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.norm_yFam_le
statement:
private lemma norm_yFam_le (n m : ℤ) :
    ‖t.yFam n m‖ ≤ ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ n.natAbs * (t.bound6 (m - 2) + t.bound6 (m + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hb6 := t.entireBound_bound6.nonneg
  have hFq : ‖t.thetaProdFactor (-(t.q : K)) ^ 3‖ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [norm_pow]
    exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) t.norm_constFactor_le_one
  rw [yFam]
  split_ifs with hn
  · rw [norm_mul, norm_mul]
    have hq2 : ‖((t.q : K) ^ n) ^ 2‖ ≤ ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ n.natAbs := by
      rw [norm_pow, sq]
      calc ‖(t.q : K) ^ n‖ * ‖(t.q : K) ^ n‖
          ≤ ‖(t.q : K) ^ n‖ * 1 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (t.norm_qzpow_le_one (by omega)) (norm_nonneg _)
        _ = ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ n.natAbs := by rw [mul_one, t.norm_qzpow_natAbs (by omega)]
    calc ‖((t.q : K) ^ n) ^ 2‖ * ‖t.thetaProdFactor (-(t.q : K)) ^ 3‖
          * ‖t.convYPos (n - 1).toNat (m - 2)‖
        ≤ ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ n.natAbs * 1 * t.bound6 (m - 2) :=
          mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul hq2 hFq (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity))
            (t.norm_convYPos_le _ _) (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      _ ≤ ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ n.natAbs * (t.bound6 (m - 2) + t.bound6 (m + 1)) := by
          rw [mul_one]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_add_of_nonneg_right (hb6 _)) (by positivity)
  · rw [norm_neg, norm_mul, norm_mul]
    have habs : (-n).natAbs = n.natAbs := Int.natAbs_neg n
    calc ‖(t.q : K) ^ (-n)‖ * ‖t.thetaProdFactor (-(t.q : K)) ^ 3‖
          * ‖t.convYNeg (-n).toNat (m + 1)‖
        ≤ ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ n.natAbs * 1 * t.bound6 (m + 1) := by
          refine mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul ?_ hFq (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity))
            (t.norm_convYNeg_le _ _) (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
          rw [t.norm_qzpow_natAbs (by omega), habs]
      _ ≤ ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ n.natAbs * (t.bound6 (m - 2) + t.bound6 (m + 1)) := by
          rw [mul_one]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_add_of_nonneg_left (hb6 _)) (by positivity)

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.hasSum_xFam_pos
statement:
private lemma hasSum_xFam_pos (p : ℕ) (u : Kˣ) :

          * t.convXPos p (m - 1)) * (u : K) ^ m)
      ((t.q : K) ^ (p + 1) * (u : K)
        * (t.thetaProdFactor (-(t.q : K)) * t.pFactorSeries p (-((t.q : K) * (u : K)))
            * t.thetaProdFactor (-((u : K))⁻¹)) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.Xterm_mul_theta_neg_sq_pos
statement:
private lemma Xterm_mul_theta_neg_sq_pos (u : Kˣ)
    (hu : ∀ j : ℤ, (t.q : K) ^ j * (u : K) ≠ 1) {n : ℤ} {p : ℕ} (hp : (p : ℤ) + 1 = n) :
    t.Xterm u n * t.theta (-u) ^ 2
      = (t.q : K) ^ (p + 1) * (u : K)
        * (t.thetaProdFactor (-(t.q : K)) * t.pFactorSeries p (-((t.q : K) * (u : K)))
            * t.thetaProdFactor (-((u : K))⁻¹)) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hθ := t.theta_neg_eq u
  have hH := t.one_add_qpow_mul_pFactorSeries p (-((t.q : K) * (u : K)))
  have hfac : (1 : K) + (t.q : K) ^ p * (-((t.q : K) * (u : K)))
      = 1 - (t.q : K) ^ (p + 1) * (u : K) := by
    rw [pow_succ]
    ring
  rw [hfac] at hH
  have hqn : (t.q : K) ^ n = (t.q : K) ^ (p + 1) := by
    rw [← hp, show ((p : ℤ) + 1) = ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by push_cast; ring, zpow_natCast]
  have hne : (1 : K) - (t.q : K) ^ (p + 1) * (u : K) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← hqn]
    exact t.one_sub_qzpow_mul_ne_zero hu n
  rw [Xterm_apply, hθ, ← hH, hqn]
  field_simp

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.Xterm_mul_theta_neg_sq_neg
statement:
private lemma Xterm_mul_theta_neg_sq_neg (u : Kˣ)
    (hu : ∀ j : ℤ, (t.q : K) ^ j * (u : K) ≠ 1) {n : ℤ} {p : ℕ} (hp : (p : ℤ) = -n) :

      = (t.q : K) ^ (p : ℕ) * ((u : K))⁻¹

            * t.pFactorSeries p (-((u : K))⁻¹)) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hθ := t.theta_neg_eq u
  have hG := t.one_add_qpow_mul_pFactorSeries p (-((u : K))⁻¹)
  have hfac : (1 : K) + (t.q : K) ^ p * (-((u : K))⁻¹)
      = 1 - (t.q : K) ^ p * ((u : K))⁻¹ := by
    ring
  rw [hfac] at hG
  have hqn : (t.q : K) ^ n = ((t.q : K) ^ (p : ℕ))⁻¹ := by
    have hn : n = -(p : ℤ) := by omega
    rw [hn, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast]
  have hne : (1 : K) - ((t.q : K) ^ (p : ℕ))⁻¹ * (u : K) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← hqn]
    exact t.one_sub_qzpow_mul_ne_zero hu n
  have hq0 : (t.q : K) ^ (p : ℕ) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ t.q.ne_zero
  have hne' : (t.q : K) ^ (p : ℕ) - (u : K) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0

    have hx : (t.q : K) ^ (p : ℕ) = (u : K) := sub_eq_zero.mp h0
    rw [← hx, inv_mul_cancel₀ hq0, sub_self]
  rw [Xterm_apply, hθ, ← hG, hqn]
  field_simp [hne']
  ring

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.hasSum_xFam
statement:
private lemma hasSum_xFam (u : Kˣ) (hu : ∀ j : ℤ, (t.q : K) ^ j * (u : K) ≠ 1) (n : ℤ) :
    HasSum (fun m : ℤ => t.xFam n m * (u : K) ^ m) (t.Xterm u n * t.theta (-u) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn : 1 ≤ n
  · have hp : (((n - 1).toNat : ℤ)) + 1 = n := by omega
    have h := t.hasSum_xFam_pos (n - 1).toNat u
    have hqn : (t.q : K) ^ n = (t.q : K) ^ ((n - 1).toNat + 1) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← hp]
      rw [show (((n - 1).toNat : ℤ) + 1) = (((n - 1).toNat + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) by push_cast; ring,
        zpow_natCast]
    have hfun : (fun m : ℤ => ((t.q : K) ^ ((n - 1).toNat + 1)
        * t.thetaProdFactor (-(t.q : K)) ^ 2 * t.convXPos (n - 1).toNat (m - 1)) * (u : K) ^ m)
        = fun m : ℤ => t.xFam n m * (u : K) ^ m := by
      funext m
      simp only [xFam, if_pos hn]
      rw [hqn]
    rw [hfun] at h
    rwa [← t.Xterm_mul_theta_neg_sq_pos u hu hp] at h
  · have hp : (((-n).toNat : ℤ)) = -n := by omega
    have h := t.hasSum_xFam_neg (-n).toNat u

        * t.thetaProdFactor (-(t.q : K)) ^ 2 * t.convXNeg (-n).toNat (m + 1)) * (u : K) ^ m)
        = fun m : ℤ => t.xFam n m * (u : K) ^ m := by
      funext m
      simp only [xFam, if_neg hn]
      rw [hqn]
    rw [hfun] at h
    rwa [← t.Xterm_mul_theta_neg_sq_neg u hu hp] at h
