name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.summable_xFam_double
statement:
private lemma summable_xFam_double (u : Kˣ) :
    Summable fun p : ℤ × ℤ => t.xFam p.1 p.2 * (u : K) ^ p.2
proof:
:= by
  have hub : (0 : ℝ) < ‖(u : K)‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr u.ne_zero
  have hDb : EntireBound fun m : ℤ => t.bound4 (m - 1) + t.bound4 (m + 1) := by
    have h1 := t.entireBound_bound4.shift 1
    have h2 := t.entireBound_bound4.shift (-1)
    have h2' : EntireBound fun m : ℤ => t.bound4 (m + 1) := by
      constructor
      · intro m; exact t.entireBound_bound4.nonneg _
      · intro r hr
        exact (h2.summable r hr).congr fun m => by rw [sub_neg_eq_add]
    exact h1.add h2'
  have hgeo : Summable (fun n : ℤ => ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ n.natAbs) :=
    summable_pow_natAbs (norm_nonneg _) t.norm_lt_one
  have hcol : Summable (fun m : ℤ => (t.bound4 (m - 1) + t.bound4 (m + 1)) * ‖(u : K)‖ ^ m) :=
    hDb.summable _ hub
  have hprod := hgeo.mul_of_nonneg hcol (fun n => by positivity)
    (fun m => mul_nonneg (hDb.nonneg m) (zpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) m))
  refine hprod.of_norm_bounded fun p => ?_
  rw [norm_mul, norm_zpow]
  calc ‖t.xFam p.1 p.2‖ * ‖(u : K)‖ ^ p.2
      ≤ (‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ p.1.natAbs * (t.bound4 (p.2 - 1) + t.bound4 (p.2 + 1)))
        * ‖(u : K)‖ ^ p.2 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (t.norm_xFam_le p.1 p.2)
          (zpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _)
    _ = ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ p.1.natAbs
        * ((t.bound4 (p.2 - 1) + t.bound4 (p.2 + 1)) * ‖(u : K)‖ ^ p.2) := by
        rw [mul_assoc]

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.summable_yFam_double
statement:
private lemma summable_yFam_double (u : Kˣ) :
    Summable fun p : ℤ × ℤ => t.yFam p.1 p.2 * (u : K) ^ p.2
proof:
:= by
  have hub : (0 : ℝ) < ‖(u : K)‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr u.ne_zero
  have hDb : EntireBound fun m : ℤ => t.bound6 (m - 2) + t.bound6 (m + 1) := by
    have h1 := t.entireBound_bound6.shift 2
    have h2 := t.entireBound_bound6.shift (-1)
    have h2' : EntireBound fun m : ℤ => t.bound6 (m + 1) := by
      constructor
      · intro m; exact t.entireBound_bound6.nonneg _
      · intro r hr
        exact (h2.summable r hr).congr fun m => by rw [sub_neg_eq_add]
    exact h1.add h2'
  have hgeo : Summable (fun n : ℤ => ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ n.natAbs) :=
    summable_pow_natAbs (norm_nonneg _) t.norm_lt_one
  have hcol : Summable (fun m : ℤ => (t.bound6 (m - 2) + t.bound6 (m + 1)) * ‖(u : K)‖ ^ m) :=
    hDb.summable _ hub
  have hprod := hgeo.mul_of_nonneg hcol (fun n => by positivity)
    (fun m => mul_nonneg (hDb.nonneg m) (zpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) m))
  refine hprod.of_norm_bounded fun p => ?_
  rw [norm_mul, norm_zpow]
  calc ‖t.yFam p.1 p.2‖ * ‖(u : K)‖ ^ p.2
      ≤ (‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ p.1.natAbs * (t.bound6 (p.2 - 2) + t.bound6 (p.2 + 1)))
        * ‖(u : K)‖ ^ p.2 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (t.norm_yFam_le p.1 p.2)
          (zpow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) _)
    _ = ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ p.1.natAbs
        * ((t.bound6 (p.2 - 2) + t.bound6 (p.2 + 1)) * ‖(u : K)‖ ^ p.2) := by
        rw [mul_assoc]

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.summable_xFam_slice
statement:
private lemma summable_xFam_slice (u : Kˣ) (m : ℤ) :
    Summable fun n : ℤ => t.xFam n m * (u : K) ^ m
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun n : ℤ => ((n, m) : ℤ × ℤ)) := fun a b hab => by
    simpa using congrArg Prod.fst hab
  have h := (t.summable_xFam_double u).comp_injective hinj
  exact h.congr fun n => rfl

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.summable_yFam_slice
statement:
private lemma summable_yFam_slice (u : Kˣ) (m : ℤ) :
    Summable fun n : ℤ => t.yFam n m * (u : K) ^ m
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun n : ℤ => ((n, m) : ℤ × ℤ)) := fun a b hab => by
    simpa using congrArg Prod.fst hab
  have h := (t.summable_yFam_double u).comp_injective hinj
  exact h.congr fun n => rfl

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.hasSum_xFam_marginal
proof:
:= by
  have hd := (t.summable_xFam_double u).hasSum
  have hswap : HasSum (fun p : ℤ × ℤ => t.xFam p.2 p.1 * (u : K) ^ p.1)
      (∑' p : ℤ × ℤ, t.xFam p.1 p.2 * (u : K) ^ p.2) :=
    ((Equiv.prodComm ℤ ℤ).hasSum_iff).mpr hd
  have hfib : ∀ m : ℤ, HasSum (fun n : ℤ => t.xFam n m * (u : K) ^ m)
      (∑' n : ℤ, t.xFam n m * (u : K) ^ m) := fun m => (t.summable_xFam_slice u m).hasSum
  have h := hswap.prod_fiberwise hfib
  have hfun : (fun m : ℤ => ∑' n : ℤ, t.xFam n m * (u : K) ^ m)
      = fun m : ℤ => (∑' n : ℤ, t.xFam n m) * (u : K) ^ m := by
    funext m
    exact tsum_mul_right
  rwa [hfun] at h

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.hasSum_yFam_marginal
proof:
:= by
  have hd := (t.summable_yFam_double u).hasSum
  have hswap : HasSum (fun p : ℤ × ℤ => t.yFam p.2 p.1 * (u : K) ^ p.1)
      (∑' p : ℤ × ℤ, t.yFam p.1 p.2 * (u : K) ^ p.2) :=
    ((Equiv.prodComm ℤ ℤ).hasSum_iff).mpr hd
  have hfib : ∀ m : ℤ, HasSum (fun n : ℤ => t.yFam n m * (u : K) ^ m)
      (∑' n : ℤ, t.yFam n m * (u : K) ^ m) := fun m => (t.summable_yFam_slice u m).hasSum
  have h := hswap.prod_fiberwise hfib
  have hfun : (fun m : ℤ => ∑' n : ℤ, t.yFam n m * (u : K) ^ m)
      = fun m : ℤ => (∑' n : ℤ, t.yFam n m) * (u : K) ^ m := by
    funext m
    exact tsum_mul_right
  rwa [hfun] at h

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.hasSum_thetaNegSq
proof:
:=
  hasSum_laurentConvolution u (t.hasSum_thetaNegCoeff u) (t.hasSum_thetaNegCoeff u)

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.hasSum_thetaNegCube
statement:
private lemma hasSum_thetaNegCube (u : Kˣ) :
    HasSum (fun m : ℤ =>
        lconv (lconv t.thetaNegCoeff t.thetaNegCoeff) t.thetaNegCoeff m * (u : K) ^ m)
      (t.theta (-u) * t.theta (-u) * t.theta (-u))
proof:
:=
  hasSum_laurentConvolution u (t.hasSum_thetaNegSq u) (t.hasSum_thetaNegCoeff u)

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.summable_XThetaSqCoeff_mul_zpow
statement:
lemma summable_XThetaSqCoeff_mul_zpow (u : Kˣ) :
    Summable fun n : ℤ => t.XThetaSqCoeff n * (u : K) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := (t.hasSum_xFam_marginal u).summable
  have h2 := ((t.hasSum_thetaNegSq u).mul_left (2 * t.eisenstein 1)).summable
  refine (h1.sub h2).congr fun m => ?_
  rw [XThetaSqCoeff]
  ring

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.summable_YThetaCubeCoeff_mul_zpow
statement:
lemma summable_YThetaCubeCoeff_mul_zpow (u : Kˣ) :
    Summable fun n : ℤ => t.YThetaCubeCoeff n * (u : K) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := (t.hasSum_yFam_marginal u).summable
  have h2 := ((t.hasSum_thetaNegCube u).mul_left (t.eisenstein 1)).summable
  refine (h1.add h2).congr fun m => ?_
  rw [YThetaCubeCoeff]
  ring

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.hasSum_XThetaSqCoeff
statement:
theorem hasSum_XThetaSqCoeff {u : Kˣ} (hu : ∀ n : ℤ, (t.q : K) ^ n * (u : K) ≠ 1) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℤ => t.XThetaSqCoeff n * (u : K) ^ n)
      (t.X u * t.theta (-u) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hd := (t.summable_xFam_double u).hasSum
  have hcol : HasSum (fun n : ℤ => t.Xterm u n * t.theta (-u) ^ 2)
      (∑' p : ℤ × ℤ, t.xFam p.1 p.2 * (u : K) ^ p.2) :=
    hd.prod_fiberwise fun n => t.hasSum_xFam u hu n
  have hXsum : HasSum (fun n : ℤ => t.Xterm u n * t.theta (-u) ^ 2)
      ((∑' n : ℤ, t.Xterm u n) * t.theta (-u) ^ 2) :=
    (t.Xterm_summable u).hasSum.mul_right _
  have hT : (∑' p : ℤ × ℤ, t.xFam p.1 p.2 * (u : K) ^ p.2)
      = (∑' n : ℤ, t.Xterm u n) * t.theta (-u) ^ 2 := hcol.unique hXsum
  have h1 : HasSum (fun m : ℤ => (∑' n : ℤ, t.xFam n m) * (u : K) ^ m)
      ((∑' n : ℤ, t.Xterm u n) * t.theta (-u) ^ 2) := hT ▸ t.hasSum_xFam_marginal u
  have h2 := (t.hasSum_thetaNegSq u).mul_left (-(2 * t.eisenstein 1))
  have h := h1.add h2
  have hfun : (fun m : ℤ => (∑' n : ℤ, t.xFam n m) * (u : K) ^ m
      + -(2 * t.eisenstein 1) * (lconv t.thetaNegCoeff t.thetaNegCoeff m * (u : K) ^ m))
      = fun m : ℤ => t.XThetaSqCoeff m * (u : K) ^ m := by
    funext m
    rw [XThetaSqCoeff]
    ring
  have hval : (∑' n : ℤ, t.Xterm u n) * t.theta (-u) ^ 2
      + -(2 * t.eisenstein 1) * (t.theta (-u) * t.theta (-u))
      = t.X u * t.theta (-u) ^ 2 := by
    rw [X_apply]
    ring
  rwa [hfun, hval] at h

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.hasSum_YThetaCubeCoeff
statement:
theorem hasSum_YThetaCubeCoeff {u : Kˣ} (hu : ∀ n : ℤ, (t.q : K) ^ n * (u : K) ≠ 1) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℤ => t.YThetaCubeCoeff n * (u : K) ^ n)
      (t.Y u * t.theta (-u) ^ 3)
proof:
:= by
  have hd := (t.summable_yFam_double u).hasSum
  have hcol : HasSum (fun n : ℤ => t.Yterm u n * t.theta (-u) ^ 3)
      (∑' p : ℤ × ℤ, t.yFam p.1 p.2 * (u : K) ^ p.2) :=
    hd.prod_fiberwise fun n => t.hasSum_yFam u hu n
  have hYsum : HasSum (fun n : ℤ => t.Yterm u n * t.theta (-u) ^ 3)
      ((∑' n : ℤ, t.Yterm u n) * t.theta (-u) ^ 3) :=
    (t.Yterm_summable u).hasSum.mul_right _
  have hT : (∑' p : ℤ × ℤ, t.yFam p.1 p.2 * (u : K) ^ p.2)
      = (∑' n : ℤ, t.Yterm u n) * t.theta (-u) ^ 3 := hcol.unique hYsum
  have h1 : HasSum (fun m : ℤ => (∑' n : ℤ, t.yFam n m) * (u : K) ^ m)
      ((∑' n : ℤ, t.Yterm u n) * t.theta (-u) ^ 3) := hT ▸ t.hasSum_yFam_marginal u
  have h2 := (t.hasSum_thetaNegCube u).mul_left (t.eisenstein 1)
  have h := h1.add h2
  have hfun : (fun m : ℤ => (∑' n : ℤ, t.yFam n m) * (u : K) ^ m
      + t.eisenstein 1
        * (lconv (lconv t.thetaNegCoeff t.thetaNegCoeff) t.thetaNegCoeff m * (u : K) ^ m))
      = fun m : ℤ => t.YThetaCubeCoeff m * (u : K) ^ m := by
    funext m
    rw [YThetaCubeCoeff]
    ring
  have hval : (∑' n : ℤ, t.Yterm u n) * t.theta (-u) ^ 3
      + t.eisenstein 1 * (t.theta (-u) * t.theta (-u) * t.theta (-u))
      = t.Y u * t.theta (-u) ^ 3 := by
    rw [Y_apply]
    ring
  rwa [hfun, hval] at h

name: TateCurvesTheta.qPoch_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma qPoch_zero : qPoch q 0 = 1
proof: := rfl

name: TateCurvesTheta.qPoch_succ
statement: lemma qPoch_succ (k : ℕ) : qPoch q (k + 1) = qPoch q k * (1 - q ^ (k + 1))
proof: := rfl

name: TateCurvesTheta.gaussBinom_zero_right
statement: @[simp] lemma gaussBinom_zero_right (n : ℕ) : gaussBinom q n 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  cases n <;> rfl

name: TateCurvesTheta.gaussBinom_zero_succ
statement: @[simp] lemma gaussBinom_zero_succ (k : ℕ) : gaussBinom q 0 (k + 1) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: TateCurvesTheta.gaussBinom_succ_succ
statement:
lemma gaussBinom_succ_succ (n k : ℕ) :
    gaussBinom q (n + 1) (k + 1) = gaussBinom q n (k + 1) + q ^ (n - k) * gaussBinom q n k
proof: := rfl

name: TateCurvesTheta.gaussBinom_eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
lemma gaussBinom_eq_zero_of_lt : ∀ {n k : ℕ}, n < k → gaussBinom q n k = 0
  | 0, 0, h => absurd h (by omega)
  | 0, (_ + 1), _ => rfl
  | (_ + 1), 0, h => absurd h (by omega)
  | (n + 1), (k + 1), h => by
      rw [gaussBinom_succ_succ, gaussBinom_eq_zero_of_lt (by omega : n < k + 1),
        gaussBinom_eq_zero_of_lt (by omega : n < k)]
      ring

                                                                 
@[simp] lemma gaussBinom_self : ∀ n : ℕ, gaussBinom q n n = 1
  | 0 => rfl
  | (n + 1) => by
      rw [gaussBinom_succ_succ, gaussBinom_eq_zero_of_lt q (by omega : n < n + 1),
        gaussBinom_self n]
      simp

name: TateCurvesTheta.gaussBinom_self
statement:
@[simp] lemma gaussBinom_self : ∀ n : ℕ, gaussBinom q n n = 1
  | 0 => rfl
  | (n + 1) => by
      rw [gaussBinom_succ_succ, gaussBinom_eq_zero_of_lt q (by omega : n < n + 1),
        gaussBinom_self n]
      simp

name: TateCurvesTheta.gaussBinom_mul_qPoch
statement:
lemma gaussBinom_mul_qPoch {n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n) :
    gaussBinom q n k * (qPoch q k * qPoch q (n - k)) = qPoch q n
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing k with
  | zero => obtain rfl : k = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hk; simp
  | succ n ih =>
    match k, hk with
    | 0, _ => simp
    | k + 1, hk =>
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k n with hkn | hkn
      · 
        have ihk := ih (show k ≤ n by omega)
        have ihk1 := ih (show k + 1 ≤ n by omega)
        have hsub : qPoch q (n - k) = qPoch q (n - (k + 1)) * (1 - q ^ (n - k)) := by
          have he : n - k = (n - (k + 1)) + 1 := by omega
          rw [he, qPoch_succ]
        have hn1 : q ^ (n + 1) = q ^ (n - k) * q ^ (k + 1) := by
          rw [← pow_add]; congr 1; omega
        rw [qPoch_succ q k] at ihk1
        rw [Nat.succ_sub_succ, gaussBinom_succ_succ, qPoch_succ q k, qPoch_succ q n, hn1]
        rw [hsub] at ihk ⊢
        linear_combination (1 - q ^ (n - k)) * ihk1 + q ^ (n - k) * (1 - q ^ (k + 1)) * ihk
      · 
        obtain rfl : k = n := by omega
        simp

name: TateCurvesTheta.qPoch_ne_zero
statement:
lemma qPoch_ne_zero (hq : ∀ j : ℕ, (1 : K) - q ^ (j + 1) ≠ 0) : ∀ k : ℕ, qPoch q k ≠ 0
  | 0 => by simp
  | (k + 1) => by
      rw [qPoch_succ]
      exact mul_ne_zero (qPoch_ne_zero hq k) (hq k)

name: TateCurvesTheta.gaussBinom_symm
statement:
lemma gaussBinom_symm (hq : ∀ j : ℕ, (1 : K) - q ^ (j + 1) ≠ 0) {n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n) :
    gaussBinom q n k = gaussBinom q n (n - k)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := gaussBinom_mul_qPoch q hk
  have h2 := gaussBinom_mul_qPoch q (Nat.sub_le n k)
  rw [show n - (n - k) = k by omega] at h2
  have hne : qPoch q k * qPoch q (n - k) ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (qPoch_ne_zero q hq k) (qPoch_ne_zero q hq (n - k))
  apply mul_right_cancel₀ hne
  rw [h1, ← h2]; ring

name: TateCurvesTheta.qbtPoly_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma qbtPoly_zero : qbtPoly q c 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [qbtPoly, Finset.prod_range_zero]

name: TateCurvesTheta.qbtPoly_succ
statement:
lemma qbtPoly_succ (N : ℕ) :
    qbtPoly q c (N + 1) = qbtPoly q c N * (C (c * q ^ N) * X + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [qbtPoly, Finset.prod_range_succ, ← qbtPoly]

name: TateCurvesTheta.choose_two_succ
statement: private lemma choose_two_succ (m : ℕ) : (m + 1).choose 2 = m.choose 2 + m
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.choose_succ_succ, Nat.choose_one_right, Nat.add_comm]

name: TateCurvesTheta.qbtPoly_coeff
statement:
lemma qbtPoly_coeff (N k : ℕ) :
    (qbtPoly q c N).coeff k = c ^ k * q ^ (k.choose 2) * gaussBinom q N k
proof:
:= by
  induction N generalizing k with
  | zero =>
      cases k with
      | zero => simp
      | succ k => rw [qbtPoly_zero, Polynomial.coeff_one, gaussBinom_zero_succ]; simp
  | succ N ih =>
      rw [qbtPoly_succ]
      cases k with
      | zero =>
          rw [Polynomial.mul_coeff_zero, ih 0]
          simp
      | succ m =>
          have hcoeff : (qbtPoly q c N * (C (c * q ^ N) * X + 1)).coeff (m + 1)
              = (c * q ^ N) * (qbtPoly q c N).coeff m + (qbtPoly q c N).coeff (m + 1) := by
            have hcomm : qbtPoly q c N * (C (c * q ^ N) * X)
                = C (c * q ^ N) * (qbtPoly q c N * X) := by ring
            rw [mul_add, mul_one, Polynomial.coeff_add, hcomm,
              Polynomial.coeff_C_mul, Polynomial.coeff_mul_X]
          rw [hcoeff, ih m, ih (m + 1), gaussBinom_succ_succ]
          have key : q ^ N * q ^ (m.choose 2) * gaussBinom q N m
              = q ^ ((m + 1).choose 2) * q ^ (N - m) * gaussBinom q N m := by
            rcases Nat.lt_or_ge N m with hmN | hmN
            · rw [gaussBinom_eq_zero_of_lt q hmN, mul_zero, mul_zero]
            · rw [← pow_add, ← pow_add]
              congr 2
              rw [choose_two_succ]; omega
          linear_combination c ^ (m + 1) * key

name: TateCurvesTheta.qbtPoly_add
statement:
lemma qbtPoly_add (n m : ℕ) :
    qbtPoly q c (n + m) = qbtPoly q c n * qbtPoly q (c * q ^ n) m
proof:
:= by
  rw [qbtPoly, qbtPoly, Finset.prod_range_add]
  congr 1
  rw [qbtPoly]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [show c * q ^ (n + i) = c * q ^ n * q ^ i by rw [pow_add]; ring]

name: TateCurvesTheta.choose_two_add
statement: private lemma choose_two_add (k a : ℕ) : (k + a).choose 2 = k.choose 2 + a.choose 2 + k * a
proof:
:= by
  induction a with
  | zero => simp
  | succ a ih =>
      have h1 : k + (a + 1) = (k + a) + 1 := by ring
      rw [h1, choose_two_succ, ih, choose_two_succ]; ring

name: TateCurvesTheta.exp_durfee
statement:
private lemma exp_durfee {n k : ℕ} (h : k ≤ n) :
    k.choose 2 + (n - k).choose 2 + n * (n - k) = (n - k) * (n - k) + n.choose 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ : ∃ a, n = k + a := ⟨n - k, by omega⟩
  simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
  rw [choose_two_add]
  ring

name: TateCurvesTheta.gaussBinom_two_mul_self
statement:
theorem gaussBinom_two_mul_self (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hq : ∀ j : ℕ, (1 : K) - q ^ (j + 1) ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), q ^ (k * k) * gaussBinom q n k ^ 2 = gaussBinom q (2 * n) n
proof:
:= by
  
  have hdirect : (qbtPoly q 1 (n + n)).coeff n = q ^ (n.choose 2) * gaussBinom q (2 * n) n := by
    rw [qbtPoly_coeff, one_pow, one_mul, two_mul]
  
  have hsplit : (qbtPoly q 1 (n + n)).coeff n
      = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          q ^ (k.choose 2) * gaussBinom q n k
            * ((q ^ n) ^ (n - k) * q ^ ((n - k).choose 2) * gaussBinom q n (n - k)) := by
    rw [qbtPoly_add, one_mul, Polynomial.coeff_mul,
      Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ_mk]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k _
    rw [qbtPoly_coeff, qbtPoly_coeff, one_pow, one_mul]
  
  rw [hdirect] at hsplit
  
  have hstep : q ^ (n.choose 2) * gaussBinom q (2 * n) n
      = q ^ (n.choose 2)
        * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
            q ^ ((n - k) * (n - k)) * (gaussBinom q n k * gaussBinom q n (n - k)) := by
    rw [hsplit, Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k hk
    rw [Finset.mem_range, Nat.lt_succ_iff] at hk
    have hpow : q ^ (k.choose 2) * gaussBinom q n k
          * ((q ^ n) ^ (n - k) * q ^ ((n - k).choose 2) * gaussBinom q n (n - k))
        = q ^ (k.choose 2 + (n - k).choose 2 + n * (n - k))
          * (gaussBinom q n k * gaussBinom q n (n - k)) := by
      rw [← pow_mul, pow_add, pow_add]; ring
    rw [hpow, exp_durfee hk, pow_add]
    ring
  
  have hcancel := mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero (n.choose 2) hq0) hstep
  
  rw [hcancel, ← Finset.sum_range_reflect]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  rw [Finset.mem_range, Nat.lt_succ_iff] at hk
  simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  rw [← gaussBinom_symm q hq hk]
  ring

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.thetaProd_mul_thetaProdRecip
statement:
theorem thetaProd_mul_thetaProdRecip (u : Kˣ)
    (hqu : ‖(t.q : K) * (u : K)‖ < 1) (huinv : ‖((u : K)⁻¹)‖ < 1) :
    t.thetaProd u * t.thetaProdRecip u = 1
proof:
:= by
  have ha : t.thetaProdFactor (-(t.q : K)) * (t.thetaProdFactor (-(t.q : K)))⁻¹ = 1 :=
    mul_inv_cancel₀ t.thetaProdFactor_neg_q_ne_zero
  have hb : t.thetaProdFactor ((t.q : K) * (u : K))
      * (∑' k : ℕ, t.recipCoeff k * ((t.q : K) * (u : K)) ^ k) = 1 :=
    t.thetaProdFactor_mul_tsum_recipCoeff hqu
  have hc : t.thetaProdFactor ((u : K)⁻¹)
      * (∑' k : ℕ, t.recipCoeff k * ((u : K)⁻¹) ^ k) = 1 :=
    t.thetaProdFactor_mul_tsum_recipCoeff huinv
  rw [thetaProd_apply, thetaProdRecip]
  calc
    t.thetaProdFactor (-(t.q : K)) * t.thetaProdFactor ((t.q : K) * (u : K))
          * t.thetaProdFactor ((u : K)⁻¹)
        * ((t.thetaProdFactor (-(t.q : K)))⁻¹
            * (∑' k : ℕ, t.recipCoeff k * ((t.q : K) * (u : K)) ^ k)
            * (∑' k : ℕ, t.recipCoeff k * ((u : K)⁻¹) ^ k))
        = (t.thetaProdFactor (-(t.q : K)) * (t.thetaProdFactor (-(t.q : K)))⁻¹)
            * (t.thetaProdFactor ((t.q : K) * (u : K))
                * (∑' k : ℕ, t.recipCoeff k * ((t.q : K) * (u : K)) ^ k))
            * (t.thetaProdFactor ((u : K)⁻¹)
                * (∑' k : ℕ, t.recipCoeff k * ((u : K)⁻¹) ^ k)) := by ring
    _ = 1 * 1 * 1 := by rw [ha, hb, hc]
    _ = 1 := by ring

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.thetaProdRecip_mul_thetaProd
statement:
theorem thetaProdRecip_mul_thetaProd (u : Kˣ)
    (hqu : ‖(t.q : K) * (u : K)‖ < 1) (huinv : ‖((u : K)⁻¹)‖ < 1) :
    t.thetaProdRecip u * t.thetaProd u = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm]; exact t.thetaProd_mul_thetaProdRecip u hqu huinv

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.thetaProd_ne_zero_of_annulus
statement:
theorem thetaProd_ne_zero_of_annulus (u : Kˣ)
    (hqu : ‖(t.q : K) * (u : K)‖ < 1) (huinv : ‖((u : K)⁻¹)‖ < 1) :
    t.thetaProd u ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hone := t.thetaProd_mul_thetaProdRecip u hqu huinv
  rw [h, zero_mul] at hone
  exact one_ne_zero hone.symm

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.inv_thetaProd_eq_thetaProdRecip
statement:
theorem inv_thetaProd_eq_thetaProdRecip (u : Kˣ)
    (hqu : ‖(t.q : K) * (u : K)‖ < 1) (huinv : ‖((u : K)⁻¹)‖ < 1) :
    (t.thetaProd u)⁻¹ = t.thetaProdRecip u
proof:
:=
  inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_right (t.thetaProd_mul_thetaProdRecip u hqu huinv)

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.thetaProd_mul_thetaProdRecip_of_annulus
statement:
theorem thetaProd_mul_thetaProdRecip_of_annulus (u : Kˣ)
    (hlo : 1 < ‖(u : K)‖) (hhi : ‖(t.q : K)‖ * ‖(u : K)‖ < 1) :
    t.thetaProd u * t.thetaProdRecip u = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine t.thetaProd_mul_thetaProdRecip u ?_ ?_
  · rw [norm_mul]; exact hhi
  · rw [norm_inv]; exact inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ hlo

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.thetaExp_neg_add_one
statement: private lemma thetaExp_neg_add_one (n : ℤ) : thetaExp (-(n + 1)) = thetaExp n
proof:
:= by
  have hAB : 2 * thetaExp (-(n + 1)) = 2 * thetaExp n := by
    rw [two_mul_thetaExp, two_mul_thetaExp]; ring
  omega

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.theta_neg_one_eq_zero
statement: theorem theta_neg_one_eq_zero (h2 : (2 : K) ≠ 0) : T.theta (-1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  
  have hinv : Function.Involutive (fun n : ℤ => -(n + 1)) := by
    intro n; change -(-(n + 1) + 1) = n; ring
  set σ : Equiv.Perm ℤ := hinv.toPerm with hσ
  have hσ_apply : ∀ n : ℤ, σ n = -(n + 1) := fun n => rfl
  
  have hkey : ∀ n : ℤ, T.thetaTerm (-1) (σ n) = -T.thetaTerm (-1) n := by
    intro n
    simp only [thetaTerm, Units.coe_neg_one, hσ_apply, thetaExp_neg_add_one]
    have hpow : (-1 : K) ^ (-(n + 1)) = -((-1 : K) ^ n) := by
      rcases Int.even_or_odd n with he | ho
      · rw [((he.add_one).neg).neg_one_zpow, he.neg_one_zpow]
      · rw [((ho.add_one).neg).neg_one_zpow, ho.neg_one_zpow, neg_neg]
    rw [hpow]; ring
  
  have hself : T.theta (-1) = -T.theta (-1) := by
    have e1 : (∑' n : ℤ, T.thetaTerm (-1) (σ n)) = T.theta (-1) :=
      Equiv.tsum_eq σ (T.thetaTerm (-1))
    calc
      T.theta (-1) = ∑' n : ℤ, T.thetaTerm (-1) (σ n) := e1.symm
      _ = ∑' n : ℤ, -T.thetaTerm (-1) n := tsum_congr hkey
      _ = -∑' n : ℤ, T.thetaTerm (-1) n := tsum_neg
      _ = -T.theta (-1) := rfl
  
  have h2S : (2 : K) * T.theta (-1) = 0 := by
    rw [two_mul]; nth_rewrite 2 [hself]; ring
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h2S with h | h
  · exact absurd h h2
  · exact h

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.theta_eq_zero_of_neg_qzpow
statement:
theorem theta_eq_zero_of_neg_qzpow (h2 : (2 : K) ≠ 0) (k : ℤ) {u : Kˣ}
    (hu : (u : K) = -(T.q : K) ^ k) : T.theta u = 0
proof:
:= by
  have huu : u = T.q ^ k * (-1 : Kˣ) := by
    apply Units.ext
    rw [hu, Units.val_mul, Units.coe_neg_one, Units.val_zpow_eq_zpow_val]
    ring
  rw [huu, T.theta_zpow_q_smul (-1) k, T.theta_neg_one_eq_zero h2, mul_zero]

name: TateCurvesTheta.exists_Ioo_subset_compl_of_finite
statement:
theorem exists_Ioo_subset_compl_of_finite {B : Set ℝ} (hB : B.Finite) {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b) :
    ∃ a' b' : ℝ, a ≤ a' ∧ a' < b' ∧ b' ≤ b ∧ ∀ x, a' < x → x < b' → x ∉ B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set S : Finset ℝ := hB.toFinset.filter (fun x => a < x ∧ x < b) with hS
  by_cases hSne : S.Nonempty
  · set p : ℝ := S.min' hSne with hp
    have hpS : p ∈ S := S.min'_mem hSne
    rw [hS, Finset.mem_filter] at hpS
    obtain ⟨-, hpa, hpb⟩ := hpS
    refine ⟨a, p, le_refl a, hpa, le_of_lt hpb, ?_⟩
    intro x hx1 hx2 hxB
    have hxS : x ∈ S := by
      rw [hS, Finset.mem_filter, hB.mem_toFinset]
      exact ⟨hxB, hx1, lt_of_lt_of_le hx2 (le_of_lt hpb)⟩
    have hpx : p ≤ x := S.min'_le x hxS
    linarith
  · refine ⟨a, b, le_refl a, hab, le_refl b, ?_⟩
    intro x hx1 hx2 hxB
    exact hSne ⟨x, by rw [hS, Finset.mem_filter, hB.mem_toFinset]; exact ⟨hxB, hx1, hx2⟩⟩

name: TateCurvesTheta.zpow_le_add_zpow
statement:
theorem zpow_le_add_zpow {a b ρ : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (haρ : a ≤ ρ) (hρb : ρ ≤ b) (n : ℤ) :
    ρ ^ n ≤ a ^ n + b ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ := le_trans ha.le haρ
  have hb0 : 0 < b := lt_of_lt_of_le ha (le_trans haρ hρb)
  obtain hn | hn : 0 ≤ n ∨ n < 0 := by omega
  · have h1 : ρ ^ n ≤ b ^ n := zpow_le_zpow_left₀ hn hρ0 hρb
    have h2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ a ^ n := zpow_nonneg ha.le n
    linarith
  · have h1 : a ^ (-n) ≤ ρ ^ (-n) := zpow_le_zpow_left₀ (by omega) ha.le haρ
    have en : ρ ^ n = (ρ ^ (-n))⁻¹ := by rw [← zpow_neg, neg_neg]
    have ea : a ^ n = (a ^ (-n))⁻¹ := by rw [← zpow_neg, neg_neg]
    have han : (0 : ℝ) < a ^ (-n) := zpow_pos ha _
    have h2 : ρ ^ n ≤ a ^ n := by rw [en, ea]; gcongr
    have h3 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ b ^ n := zpow_nonneg hb0.le n
    linarith

name: TateCurvesTheta.min_zpow_le_zpow
statement:
theorem min_zpow_le_zpow {a b ρ : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (haρ : a ≤ ρ) (hρb : ρ ≤ b) (n : ℤ) :
    min (a ^ n) (b ^ n) ≤ ρ ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ := le_trans ha.le haρ
  have hb0 : 0 < b := lt_of_lt_of_le ha (le_trans haρ hρb)
  obtain hn | hn : 0 ≤ n ∨ n < 0 := by omega
  · have h1 : a ^ n ≤ ρ ^ n := zpow_le_zpow_left₀ hn ha.le haρ
    exact le_trans (min_le_left _ _) h1
  · have h1 : ρ ^ (-n) ≤ b ^ (-n) := zpow_le_zpow_left₀ (by omega) hρ0 hρb
    have en : ρ ^ n = (ρ ^ (-n))⁻¹ := by rw [← zpow_neg, neg_neg]
    have eb : b ^ n = (b ^ (-n))⁻¹ := by rw [← zpow_neg, neg_neg]
    have hρn : (0 : ℝ) < ρ ^ (-n) := zpow_pos (lt_of_lt_of_le ha haρ) _
    have h2 : b ^ n ≤ ρ ^ n := by rw [en, eb]; gcongr
    exact le_trans (min_le_right _ _) h2

name: TateCurvesTheta.laurentStrictDom_of_denselyNormed
statement: theorem laurentStrictDom_of_denselyNormed : LaurentStrictDom K
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rintro c hsum ⟨m, hm⟩
  
  obtain ⟨xa, hxa1, hxa2⟩ :=
    NormedField.exists_lt_norm_lt (α := K) (r₁ := (1 : ℝ)) (r₂ := 2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨xb, hxb1, hxb2⟩ :=
    NormedField.exists_lt_norm_lt (α := K) (r₁ := (2 : ℝ)) (r₂ := 3) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have hxa0 : xa ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; rw [norm_zero] at hxa1; linarith
  have hxb0 : xb ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; rw [norm_zero] at hxb1; linarith
  set Ua : Kˣ := Units.mk0 xa hxa0 with hUa
  set Ub : Kˣ := Units.mk0 xb hxb0 with hUb
  set a : ℝ := ‖xa‖ with ha_def
  set b : ℝ := ‖xb‖ with hb_def
  have ha0 : 0 < a := by linarith
  have hb0 : 0 < b := by linarith
  have hab : a < b := by linarith
  have hUav : (Ua : K) = xa := by rw [hUa]; exact Units.val_mk0 hxa0
  have hUbv : (Ub : K) = xb := by rw [hUb]; exact Units.val_mk0 hxb0
  
  have norm_term : ∀ (v : Kˣ) (k : ℤ), ‖c k * (v : K) ^ k‖ = ‖c k‖ * ‖(v : K)‖ ^ k := by
    intro v k; rw [norm_mul, norm_zpow]
  
  have hta : Tendsto (fun n : ℤ => ‖c n‖ * a ^ n) cofinite (𝓝 0) := by
    have := (hsum Ua).tendsto_cofinite_zero.norm
    simp only [norm_zero] at this
    refine this.congr ?_
    intro n; rw [norm_term Ua n, hUav, ← ha_def]
  have htb : Tendsto (fun n : ℤ => ‖c n‖ * b ^ n) cofinite (𝓝 0) := by
    have := (hsum Ub).tendsto_cofinite_zero.norm
    simp only [norm_zero] at this
    refine this.congr ?_
    intro n; rw [norm_term Ub n, hUbv, ← hb_def]
  set h : ℤ → ℝ := fun n => ‖c n‖ * a ^ n + ‖c n‖ * b ^ n with hh
  have hth : Tendsto h cofinite (𝓝 0) := by simpa [hh] using hta.add htb
  
  set M₀ : ℝ := ‖c m‖ * min (a ^ m) (b ^ m) with hM₀
  have hcm : 0 < ‖c m‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hm
  have hM₀pos : 0 < M₀ := by
    rw [hM₀]; exact mul_pos hcm (lt_min (zpow_pos ha0 m) (zpow_pos hb0 m))
  
  have hFfin : {n : ℤ | M₀ ≤ h n}.Finite := by
    have hev : ∀ᶠ n in cofinite, h n < M₀ := hth.eventually (Iio_mem_nhds hM₀pos)
    refine (eventually_cofinite.mp hev).subset ?_
    intro n hn
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, not_lt]
    simpa only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] using hn
  set F : Finset ℤ := hFfin.toFinset with hF
  
  have hmF : m ∈ F := by
    rw [hF, hFfin.mem_toFinset]
    change M₀ ≤ h m
    have h1 : min (a ^ m) (b ^ m) ≤ a ^ m := min_le_left _ _
    have h2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ‖c m‖ * b ^ m := mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (zpow_nonneg hb0.le m)
    have h3 : ‖c m‖ * min (a ^ m) (b ^ m) ≤ ‖c m‖ * a ^ m :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (norm_nonneg (c m))
    simp only [hM₀, hh]
    linarith
  have hFne : F.Nonempty := ⟨m, hmF⟩
  
  have hFcne : ∀ n ∈ F, c n ≠ 0 := by
    intro n hnF hcn
    rw [hF, hFfin.mem_toFinset] at hnF
    have hn' : M₀ ≤ h n := hnF
    simp only [hh, hcn, norm_zero, zero_mul, add_zero] at hn'
    linarith
  
  set Bad : Set ℝ :=
    {ρ : ℝ | 0 < ρ ∧ ∃ n₁ ∈ F, ∃ n₂ ∈ F, n₁ ≠ n₂ ∧ ‖c n₁‖ * ρ ^ n₁ = ‖c n₂‖ * ρ ^ n₂} with hBad
  have hBadfin : Bad.Finite := by
    have hfin : (↑F.offDiag : Set (ℤ × ℤ)).Finite := F.offDiag.finite_toSet
    have hbi : (⋃ p ∈ (↑F.offDiag : Set (ℤ × ℤ)),
        {ρ : ℝ | 0 < ρ ∧ ‖c p.1‖ * ρ ^ p.1 = ‖c p.2‖ * ρ ^ p.2}).Finite := by
      refine hfin.biUnion ?_
      intro p hp
      rw [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_offDiag] at hp
      obtain ⟨hp1, _, hpne⟩ := hp
      have hc1 : (0 : ℝ) < ‖c p.1‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (hFcne p.1 hp1)
      have hd : p.1 - p.2 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hpne
      apply Set.Subsingleton.finite
      intro ρ hρ ρ' hρ'
      obtain ⟨hρ0, heqρ⟩ := hρ
      obtain ⟨hρ'0, heqρ'⟩ := hρ'
      
      have key : ∀ σ : ℝ, 0 < σ → ‖c p.1‖ * σ ^ p.1 = ‖c p.2‖ * σ ^ p.2 →
          ‖c p.1‖ * σ ^ (p.1 - p.2) = ‖c p.2‖ := by
        intro σ hσ0 heq
        have hσne : σ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hσ0
        have expand : σ ^ p.1 = σ ^ (p.1 - p.2) * σ ^ p.2 := by
          rw [← zpow_add₀ hσne]; congr 1; ring
        have e2 : (‖c p.1‖ * σ ^ (p.1 - p.2)) * σ ^ p.2 = ‖c p.2‖ * σ ^ p.2 := by
          rw [mul_assoc, ← expand]; exact heq
        exact mul_right_cancel₀ (zpow_ne_zero _ hσne) e2
      have hkρ := key ρ hρ0 heqρ
      have hkρ' := key ρ' hρ'0 heqρ'
      have hpow : ρ ^ (p.1 - p.2) = ρ' ^ (p.1 - p.2) :=
        mul_left_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hc1) (hkρ.trans hkρ'.symm)
      exact (zpow_left_inj₀ hρ0.le hρ'0.le hd).mp hpow
    refine hbi.subset ?_
    intro ρ hρ
    rw [hBad] at hρ
    obtain ⟨hρ0, n₁, hn₁, n₂, hn₂, hne, heq⟩ := hρ
    rw [Set.mem_iUnion₂]
    exact ⟨(n₁, n₂), Finset.mem_offDiag.mpr ⟨hn₁, hn₂, hne⟩, hρ0, heq⟩
  
  obtain ⟨a', b', haa', ha'b', hb'b, hcompl⟩ := exists_Ioo_subset_compl_of_finite hBadfin hab
  have ha'0 : 0 < a' := lt_of_lt_of_le ha0 haa'
  obtain ⟨x, hx1, hx2⟩ :=
    NormedField.exists_lt_norm_lt (α := K) (r₁ := a') (r₂ := b') ha'0.le ha'b'
  have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; rw [norm_zero] at hx1; linarith
  set U : Kˣ := Units.mk0 x hx0 with hU
  set ρ : ℝ := ‖x‖ with hρ
  have hUv : (U : K) = x := rfl
  have hρa : a ≤ ρ := le_trans haa' (le_of_lt hx1)
  have hρb : ρ ≤ b := le_trans (le_of_lt hx2) hb'b
  have hρ0 : 0 < ρ := lt_of_lt_of_le ha0 hρa
  have hρBad : ρ ∉ Bad := hcompl ρ hx1 hx2
  
  obtain ⟨n₀, hn₀F, hn₀max⟩ := F.exists_max_image (fun n => ‖c n‖ * ρ ^ n) hFne
  refine ⟨U, n₀, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  rw [norm_term U n, norm_term U n₀, hUv, ← hρ]
  by_cases hnF : n ∈ F
  · 
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (hn₀max n hnF) with hlt | heq
    · exact hlt
    · exfalso
      exact hρBad (by rw [hBad]; exact ⟨hρ0, n, hnF, n₀, hn₀F, hn, heq⟩)
  · 
    have hchain1 : ‖c n‖ * ρ ^ n ≤ h n := by
      have hb := zpow_le_add_zpow ha0 hρa hρb n
      have h' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (norm_nonneg (c n))
      rw [mul_add] at h'
      exact h'
    have hchain2 : h n < M₀ := by
      by_contra hcon
      exact hnF (by rw [hF, hFfin.mem_toFinset]; exact not_lt.mp hcon)
    have hchain3 : M₀ ≤ ‖c m‖ * ρ ^ m := by
      rw [hM₀]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (min_zpow_le_zpow ha0 hρa hρb m) (norm_nonneg _)
    have hchain4 : ‖c m‖ * ρ ^ m ≤ ‖c n₀‖ * ρ ^ n₀ := hn₀max m hmF
    linarith

name: TateCurvesTheta.laurentCoeffUnique_of_denselyNormed
statement: theorem laurentCoeffUnique_of_denselyNormed : LaurentCoeffUnique K
proof:
:=
  laurentCoeffUnique_of_strictDom laurentStrictDom_of_denselyNormed

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.const_of_qinvariant_laurent_of_denselyNormed
statement:
theorem const_of_qinvariant_laurent_of_denselyNormed (a : ℤ → K)

    (hqinv : ∀ u : Kˣ,
      (∑' n : ℤ, a n * ((t.q : K) * (u : K)) ^ n) = ∑' n : ℤ, a n * (u : K) ^ n) :
    ∀ u : Kˣ, (∑' n : ℤ, a n * (u : K) ^ n) = a 0

  t.const_of_qinvariant_laurent laurentCoeffUnique_of_denselyNormed a hsum hqinv
