name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.summable_aLaurentCoeff
statement: lemma summable_aLaurentCoeff : Summable t.aLaurentCoeff
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (Nat.cast_injective (R := ℤ)).summable_iff (f := t.aLaurentCoeff) (fun n hn => ?_)]
  · exact (t.factorCoeff_summable (t.q : K)).congr fun k => by simp
  · rw [Set.mem_range] at hn
    have hneg : n < 0 := by
      by_contra h
      exact hn ⟨n.toNat, by simp [Int.toNat_of_nonneg (not_lt.mp h)]⟩
    exact t.aLaurentCoeff_of_neg hneg

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.summable_bLaurentCoeff
statement: lemma summable_bLaurentCoeff : Summable t.bLaurentCoeff
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun k : ℕ => -(k : ℤ)) := fun a b h => by simpa using h
  rw [← hinj.summable_iff (f := t.bLaurentCoeff) (fun m hm => ?_)]
  · exact (t.factorCoeff_summable (1 : K)).congr fun k => by simp
  · rw [Set.mem_range] at hm
    have hpos : 0 < m := by
      by_contra h
      exact hm ⟨(-m).toNat, by simp [Int.toNat_of_nonneg (neg_nonneg.mpr (not_lt.mp h))]⟩
    exact t.bLaurentCoeff_of_pos hpos

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.aLaurentCoeff_hasSum
statement:
lemma aLaurentCoeff_hasSum (u : Kˣ) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℤ => t.aLaurentCoeff n * (u : K) ^ n)
      (t.thetaProdFactor ((t.q : K) * (u : K)))
proof:
:= by
  have hnat : HasSum (fun k : ℕ => factorCoeff t k * ((t.q : K) * (u : K)) ^ k)
      (t.thetaProdFactor ((t.q : K) * (u : K))) := by
    rw [thetaProdFactor_eq_tsum]; exact (t.factorCoeff_summable _).hasSum
  have hoff : ∀ n : ℤ, n ∉ Set.range ((↑) : ℕ → ℤ) →
      t.aLaurentCoeff n * (u : K) ^ n = 0 := by
    intro n hn
    rw [Set.mem_range] at hn
    have hneg : n < 0 := by
      by_contra h
      exact hn ⟨n.toNat, by simp [Int.toNat_of_nonneg (not_lt.mp h)]⟩
    simp [t.aLaurentCoeff_of_neg hneg]
  have hcomp : ((fun n : ℤ => t.aLaurentCoeff n * (u : K) ^ n) ∘ ((↑) : ℕ → ℤ))
      = fun k : ℕ => factorCoeff t k * ((t.q : K) * (u : K)) ^ k := by
    funext k
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, aLaurentCoeff_natCast, zpow_natCast, mul_pow]
    ring
  rw [← (Nat.cast_injective (R := ℤ)).hasSum_iff
      (f := fun n : ℤ => t.aLaurentCoeff n * (u : K) ^ n) hoff, hcomp]
  exact hnat

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.bLaurentCoeff_hasSum
statement:
lemma bLaurentCoeff_hasSum (u : Kˣ) :
    HasSum (fun m : ℤ => t.bLaurentCoeff m * (u : K) ^ m)
      (t.thetaProdFactor ((u : K)⁻¹))
proof:
:= by
  have hnat : HasSum (fun k : ℕ => factorCoeff t k * ((u : K)⁻¹) ^ k)
      (t.thetaProdFactor ((u : K)⁻¹)) := by
    rw [thetaProdFactor_eq_tsum]; exact (t.factorCoeff_summable _).hasSum
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun k : ℕ => -(k : ℤ)) := fun a b h => by simpa using h
  have hoff : ∀ m : ℤ, m ∉ Set.range (fun k : ℕ => -(k : ℤ)) →
      t.bLaurentCoeff m * (u : K) ^ m = 0 := by
    intro m hm
    rw [Set.mem_range] at hm
    have hpos : 0 < m := by
      by_contra h
      exact hm ⟨(-m).toNat, by simp [Int.toNat_of_nonneg (neg_nonneg.mpr (not_lt.mp h))]⟩
    simp [t.bLaurentCoeff_of_pos hpos]
  have hcomp : ((fun m : ℤ => t.bLaurentCoeff m * (u : K) ^ m) ∘ (fun k : ℕ => -(k : ℤ)))
      = fun k : ℕ => factorCoeff t k * ((u : K)⁻¹) ^ k := by
    funext k
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, bLaurentCoeff_negNatCast, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, inv_pow]
  rw [← hinj.hasSum_iff (f := fun m : ℤ => t.bLaurentCoeff m * (u : K) ^ m) hoff, hcomp]
  exact hnat

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.hasSum_laurentConvolution
statement:
lemma hasSum_laurentConvolution {α β : ℤ → K} {A B : K} (u : Kˣ)
    (hA : HasSum (fun n : ℤ => α n * (u : K) ^ n) A)
    (hB : HasSum (fun m : ℤ => β m * (u : K) ^ m) B) :
    HasSum (fun ℓ : ℤ => (∑' m : ℤ, α (ℓ - m) * β m) * (u : K) ^ ℓ) (A * B)
proof:
:= by
  have hAB := hA.mul_of_nonarchimedean hB
  
  let e : ℤ × ℤ ≃ ℤ × ℤ :=
    { toFun := fun p => (p.1 - p.2, p.2)
      invFun := fun p => (p.1 + p.2, p.2)
      left_inv := fun p => by simp
      right_inv := fun p => by simp }
  have hshear : HasSum
      (fun p : ℤ × ℤ => (α (p.1 - p.2) * (u : K) ^ (p.1 - p.2)) * (β p.2 * (u : K) ^ p.2))
      (A * B) :=
    (e.hasSum_iff (f := fun p : ℤ × ℤ =>
      (α p.1 * (u : K) ^ p.1) * (β p.2 * (u : K) ^ p.2))).mpr hAB
  refine hshear.prod_fiberwise (fun ℓ => ?_)
  
  have hfun : (fun m : ℤ => (α (ℓ - m) * (u : K) ^ (ℓ - m)) * (β m * (u : K) ^ m))
      = fun m : ℤ => (α (ℓ - m) * β m) * (u : K) ^ ℓ := by
    funext m
    have hexp : ℓ - m + m = ℓ := by ring
    rw [mul_mul_mul_comm, ← zpow_add₀ u.ne_zero, hexp]
  
  have hslice : Summable (fun m : ℤ =>
      (α (ℓ - m) * (u : K) ^ (ℓ - m)) * (β m * (u : K) ^ m)) := by
    have hinj : Function.Injective (fun m : ℤ => ((ℓ, m) : ℤ × ℤ)) :=
      fun a b h => by simpa using congrArg Prod.snd h
    simpa only [Function.comp_def] using hshear.summable.comp_injective hinj
  have hconv : Summable (fun m : ℤ => α (ℓ - m) * β m) := by
    refine ((hfun ▸ hslice).mul_right ((u : K) ^ ℓ)⁻¹).congr fun m => ?_
    rw [mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ (zpow_ne_zero ℓ u.ne_zero), mul_one]
  have hfiber := hconv.hasSum.mul_right ((u : K) ^ ℓ)
  rwa [← hfun] at hfiber

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.thetaProd_hasSum_laurent
statement:
lemma thetaProd_hasSum_laurent (u : Kˣ) :
    HasSum (fun ℓ : ℤ => t.thetaProdLaurentCoeff ℓ * (u : K) ^ ℓ) (t.thetaProd u)
proof:
:= by
  have h := hasSum_laurentConvolution u (t.aLaurentCoeff_hasSum u) (t.bLaurentCoeff_hasSum u)
  have hval : t.thetaProdFactor (-(t.q : K)) *
      (t.thetaProdFactor ((t.q : K) * (u : K)) * t.thetaProdFactor ((u : K)⁻¹))
      = t.thetaProd u := by
    rw [thetaProd_apply]; ring
  have hfinal := h.mul_left (t.thetaProdFactor (-(t.q : K)))
  rw [hval] at hfinal
  have hcoeffun : (fun ℓ : ℤ => t.thetaProdLaurentCoeff ℓ * (u : K) ^ ℓ)
      = fun ℓ : ℤ => t.thetaProdFactor (-(t.q : K)) *
          ((∑' m : ℤ, t.aLaurentCoeff (ℓ - m) * t.bLaurentCoeff m) * (u : K) ^ ℓ) := by
    funext ℓ; rw [thetaProdLaurentCoeff]; ring
  rw [hcoeffun]
  exact hfinal

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.thetaProdLaurentRepr
statement: theorem thetaProdLaurentRepr : t.ThetaProdLaurentRepr
proof:
:=
  ⟨t.thetaProdLaurentCoeff,
    fun u => (t.thetaProd_hasSum_laurent u).summable,
    fun u => (t.thetaProd_hasSum_laurent u).tsum_eq.symm⟩

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.thetaProd_eq_const_mul_theta_of_laurentCoeffUnique
statement:
theorem thetaProd_eq_const_mul_theta_of_laurentCoeffUnique (huniq : LaurentCoeffUnique K) :
    ∃ b₀ : K, ∀ u : Kˣ, t.thetaProd u = b₀ * t.theta u
proof:
:=
  t.thetaProd_eq_const_mul_theta huniq t.thetaProdLaurentRepr

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.theta_eq_thetaProd_of_laurentCoeffUnique
proof:
:=
  t.theta_eq_thetaProd_of_thetaProdLaurent huniq t.thetaProdLaurentRepr hu₀ hnorm u

name: TateCurvesTheta.thetaExp_succ
statement: lemma thetaExp_succ (n : ℤ) : thetaExp (n + 1) = thetaExp n + (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : 2 * thetaExp (n + 1) = 2 * thetaExp n + 2 * (n + 1) := by
    rw [two_mul_thetaExp, two_mul_thetaExp]; ring
  omega

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.thetaProd_eq_const_mul_theta
statement:
theorem thetaProd_eq_const_mul_theta (huniq : LaurentCoeffUnique K)
    (hrepr : t.ThetaProdLaurentRepr) :
    ∃ b₀ : K, ∀ u : Kˣ, t.thetaProd u = b₀ * t.theta u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hsum, hfact⟩ := hrepr
  have hqne : (t.q : K) ≠ 0 := t.q.ne_zero
  
  
  
  have hAsum : ∀ v : Kˣ, Summable fun n : ℤ => (b n * (t.q : K) ^ n) * (v : K) ^ n := by
    intro v
    refine (hsum (t.q * v)).congr fun n => ?_
    rw [Units.val_mul, mul_zpow]; ring
  
  have hBsum : ∀ v : Kˣ, Summable fun n : ℤ => (b (n + 1) * (t.q : K)⁻¹) * (v : K) ^ n := by
    intro v
    have h1 : Summable fun n : ℤ => b (n + 1) * (v : K) ^ (n + 1) :=
      (hsum v).comp_injective (i := fun n : ℤ => n + 1) fun a c h => by simpa using h
    have h2 : Summable fun n : ℤ => b (n + 1) * (v : K) ^ n := by
      refine (h1.mul_right (v : K)⁻¹).congr fun n => ?_
      rw [mul_assoc, zpow_add_one₀ v.ne_zero, mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ v.ne_zero, mul_one]
    refine (h2.mul_left (t.q : K)⁻¹).congr fun n => ?_
    ring
  
  have hAeq : ∀ v : Kˣ,
      (∑' n : ℤ, (b n * (t.q : K) ^ n) * (v : K) ^ n) = t.thetaProd (t.q * v) := by
    intro v
    rw [hfact (t.q * v)]
    refine tsum_congr fun n => ?_
    rw [Units.val_mul, mul_zpow]; ring
  
  have hshift : ∀ v : Kˣ,
      (∑' n : ℤ, b (n + 1) * (v : K) ^ n) = (v : K)⁻¹ * t.thetaProd v := by
    intro v
    have key : (∑' n : ℤ, b (n + 1) * (v : K) ^ n)
        = ∑' m : ℤ, b m * (v : K) ^ m * (v : K)⁻¹ := by
      rw [← Equiv.tsum_eq (Equiv.addRight (1 : ℤ)) fun m => b m * (v : K) ^ m * (v : K)⁻¹]
      refine tsum_congr fun n => ?_
      simp only [Equiv.coe_addRight]
      rw [mul_assoc]
      congr 1
      rw [zpow_add_one₀ v.ne_zero, mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ v.ne_zero, mul_one]
    rw [key, tsum_mul_right, ← hfact v, mul_comm]
  
  have hBeq : ∀ v : Kˣ,
      (∑' n : ℤ, (b (n + 1) * (t.q : K)⁻¹) * (v : K) ^ n) = t.thetaProd (t.q * v) := by
    intro v
    have hpull : (∑' n : ℤ, (b (n + 1) * (t.q : K)⁻¹) * (v : K) ^ n)
        = (t.q : K)⁻¹ * ∑' n : ℤ, b (n + 1) * (v : K) ^ n := by
      rw [← tsum_mul_left]; exact tsum_congr fun n => by ring
    rw [hpull, hshift v, thetaProd_q_smul, mul_inv]; ring
  
  have hAB : (fun n : ℤ => b n * (t.q : K) ^ n) = fun n : ℤ => b (n + 1) * (t.q : K)⁻¹ :=
    huniq _ _ hAsum hBsum fun v => by rw [hAeq v, hBeq v]
  
  have hrec : ∀ n : ℤ, b (n + 1) = (t.q : K) ^ (n + 1) * b n := by
    intro n
    have hABn : b n * (t.q : K) ^ n = b (n + 1) * (t.q : K)⁻¹ := congrFun hAB n
    calc b (n + 1)
        = b (n + 1) * (t.q : K)⁻¹ * (t.q : K) := by
          rw [mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hqne, mul_one]
      _ = b n * (t.q : K) ^ n * (t.q : K) := by rw [← hABn]
      _ = b n * ((t.q : K) ^ n * (t.q : K)) := by ring
      _ = b n * (t.q : K) ^ (n + 1) := by rw [← zpow_add_one₀ hqne]
      _ = (t.q : K) ^ (n + 1) * b n := by ring
  
  have hclosed : ∀ n : ℤ, b n = b 0 * (t.q : K) ^ thetaExp n := by
    intro n
    induction n using Int.induction_on with
    | zero => simp [thetaExp]
    | succ i ih =>
        have hts : thetaExp ((i : ℤ) + 1) = thetaExp (i : ℤ) + ((i : ℤ) + 1) :=
          thetaExp_succ (i : ℤ)
        rw [hrec (i : ℤ), ih, hts, zpow_add₀ hqne (thetaExp (i : ℤ)) ((i : ℤ) + 1)]; ring
    | pred i ih =>
        
        have hr : b (-(i : ℤ)) = (t.q : K) ^ (-(i : ℤ)) * b (-(i : ℤ) - 1) := by
          have h := hrec (-(i : ℤ) - 1); simpa using h
        have hstep : b (-(i : ℤ) - 1) = (t.q : K) ^ (i : ℤ) * b (-(i : ℤ)) := by
          rw [hr, ← mul_assoc, ← zpow_add₀ hqne]; simp
        have hts : thetaExp (-(i : ℤ) - 1) = thetaExp (-(i : ℤ)) + (i : ℤ) := by
          have h := thetaExp_succ (-(i : ℤ) - 1); simp only [sub_add_cancel] at h; omega
        rw [hstep, ih, hts, zpow_add₀ hqne (thetaExp (-(i : ℤ))) (i : ℤ)]; ring
  
  refine ⟨b 0, fun u => ?_⟩
  rw [hfact u, theta_apply, ← tsum_mul_left]
  refine tsum_congr fun n => ?_
  rw [hclosed n]; ring

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.theta_eq_thetaProd_of_thetaProdLaurent
statement:
theorem theta_eq_thetaProd_of_thetaProdLaurent (huniq : LaurentCoeffUnique K)
    (hrepr : t.ThetaProdLaurentRepr) {u₀ : Kˣ} (hu₀ : t.theta u₀ ≠ 0)
    (hnorm : t.theta u₀ = t.thetaProd u₀) (u : Kˣ) :
    t.theta u = t.thetaProd u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b₀, hb₀⟩ := t.thetaProd_eq_const_mul_theta huniq hrepr
  
  have hb1 : b₀ = 1 := by
    have h := hb₀ u₀
    rw [← hnorm] at h
    have h' : (b₀ - 1) * t.theta u₀ = 0 := by ring_nf; linear_combination -h
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h' with h'' | h''
    · exact sub_eq_zero.mp h''
    · exact absurd h'' hu₀
  rw [hb₀ u, hb1, one_mul]

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.theta_eq_zero_iff_of_thetaProdLaurent
statement:
theorem theta_eq_zero_iff_of_thetaProdLaurent (huniq : LaurentCoeffUnique K)
    (hrepr : t.ThetaProdLaurentRepr) {u₀ : Kˣ} (hu₀ : t.theta u₀ ≠ 0)
    (hnorm : t.theta u₀ = t.thetaProd u₀) (u : Kˣ) :
    t.theta u = 0 ↔ ∃ k : ℤ, (u : K) = -(t.q : K) ^ k
proof:
:=
  t.theta_eq_zero_iff_of_eq_thetaProd u
    (t.theta_eq_thetaProd_of_thetaProdLaurent huniq hrepr hu₀ hnorm u)

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.theta_eq_const_mul_thetaProd
statement:
theorem theta_eq_const_mul_thetaProd (huniq : LaurentCoeffUnique K) (hrepr : t.RatioLaurentRepr) :
    ∃ c₀ : K, ∀ u : Kˣ, t.theta u = c₀ * t.thetaProd u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hsum, hid, hqinv⟩ := hrepr
  
  have hconst : ∀ u : Kˣ, (∑' n : ℤ, c n * (u : K) ^ n) = c 0 :=
    t.const_of_qinvariant_laurent huniq c hsum hqinv
  refine ⟨c 0, fun u => ?_⟩
  rw [hid u, hconst u]

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.theta_eq_thetaProd_of_ratioLaurent
statement:
theorem theta_eq_thetaProd_of_ratioLaurent (huniq : LaurentCoeffUnique K)
    (hrepr : t.RatioLaurentRepr)
    {u₀ : Kˣ} (hu₀ : t.thetaProd u₀ ≠ 0) (hnorm : t.theta u₀ = t.thetaProd u₀) (u : Kˣ) :
    t.theta u = t.thetaProd u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c₀, hc₀⟩ := t.theta_eq_const_mul_thetaProd huniq hrepr
  
  have hc1 : c₀ = 1 := by
    have h := hc₀ u₀
    rw [hnorm] at h
    have h' : (c₀ - 1) * t.thetaProd u₀ = 0 := by ring_nf; linear_combination -h
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h' with h'' | h''
    · exact sub_eq_zero.mp h''
    · exact absurd h'' hu₀
  rw [hc₀ u, hc1, one_mul]

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.theta_eq_zero_iff_of_ratioLaurent
statement:
theorem theta_eq_zero_iff_of_ratioLaurent [CompleteSpace K] (huniq : LaurentCoeffUnique K)
    (hrepr : t.RatioLaurentRepr) {u₀ : Kˣ} (hu₀ : t.thetaProd u₀ ≠ 0)
    (hnorm : t.theta u₀ = t.thetaProd u₀) (u : Kˣ) :
    t.theta u = 0 ↔ ∃ k : ℤ, (u : K) = -(t.q : K) ^ k
proof:
:=
  t.theta_eq_zero_iff_of_eq_thetaProd u
    (t.theta_eq_thetaProd_of_ratioLaurent huniq hrepr hu₀ hnorm u)

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.zpow_ne_one
statement: lemma zpow_ne_one {n : ℤ} (hn : n ≠ 0) : (t.q : K) ^ n ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hn with hneg | hpos
  · intro h
    have h' : (t.q : K) ^ (-n) = 1 := by
      rw [zpow_neg, h, inv_one]
    have hnat : (t.q : K) ^ (-n).toNat = 1 := by
      rw [← zpow_natCast, Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega : (0 : ℤ) ≤ -n)]; exact h'
    exact t.pow_ne_one (by omega : 0 < (-n).toNat) hnat
  · intro h
    have hnat : (t.q : K) ^ n.toNat = 1 := by
      rw [← zpow_natCast, Int.toNat_of_nonneg hpos.le]; exact h
    exact t.pow_ne_one (by omega : 0 < n.toNat) hnat

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.tsum_eq_coeff_zero_of_qinv
statement:
theorem tsum_eq_coeff_zero_of_qinv (a : ℤ → K) (hcoeff : ∀ n : ℤ, a n * (t.q : K) ^ n = a n)
    (u : Kˣ) : (∑' n : ℤ, a n * (u : K) ^ n) = a 0
proof:
:= by
  have haz : ∀ n : ℤ, n ≠ 0 → a n = 0 := by
    intro n hn
    have h1 : a n * ((t.q : K) ^ n - 1) = 0 := by
      rw [mul_sub, mul_one, hcoeff n, sub_self]
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h1 with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd (sub_eq_zero.mp h) (t.zpow_ne_one hn)
  rw [tsum_eq_single (0 : ℤ) fun n hn => by rw [haz n hn, zero_mul], zpow_zero, mul_one]

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.const_of_qinvariant_laurent
statement:
theorem const_of_qinvariant_laurent (huniq : LaurentCoeffUnique K) (a : ℤ → K)
    (hsum : ∀ u : Kˣ, Summable fun n : ℤ => a n * (u : K) ^ n)
    (hqinv : ∀ u : Kˣ,
      (∑' n : ℤ, a n * ((t.q : K) * (u : K)) ^ n) = ∑' n : ℤ, a n * (u : K) ^ n) :
    ∀ u : Kˣ, (∑' n : ℤ, a n * (u : K) ^ n) = a 0
proof:
:= by
  
  have hpt : ∀ (v : Kˣ) (n : ℤ),
      a n * ((t.q : K) * (v : K)) ^ n = (a n * (t.q : K) ^ n) * (v : K) ^ n := by
    intro v n; rw [mul_zpow]; ring
  
  have hbsum : ∀ v : Kˣ, Summable fun n : ℤ => (a n * (t.q : K) ^ n) * (v : K) ^ n := by
    intro v
    refine (hsum (t.q * v)).congr fun n => ?_
    rw [Units.val_mul, hpt v n]
  
  have heq : ∀ v : Kˣ,
      (∑' n : ℤ, (a n * (t.q : K) ^ n) * (v : K) ^ n) = ∑' n : ℤ, a n * (v : K) ^ n := by
    intro v
    rw [tsum_congr fun n => (hpt v n).symm]
    exact hqinv v
  
  have hcoeff : (fun n : ℤ => a n * (t.q : K) ^ n) = a := huniq _ a hbsum hsum heq
  exact t.tsum_eq_coeff_zero_of_qinv a fun n => congrFun hcoeff n

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.thetaDiv_q_smul
statement:
theorem thetaDiv_q_smul [CompleteSpace K] (u : Kˣ) :
    t.theta (t.q * u) * (t.thetaProd (t.q * u))⁻¹ = t.theta u * (t.thetaProd u)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have wne : (t.q : K) * (u : K) ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero t.q.ne_zero u.ne_zero
  
  have h2 : (t.thetaProd (t.q * u))⁻¹ = ((t.q : K) * (u : K)) * (t.thetaProd u)⁻¹ := by
    rw [thetaProd_q_smul, mul_inv, inv_inv]
  rw [theta_q_smul, h2, mul_mul_mul_comm, inv_mul_cancel₀ wne, one_mul]

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.IsWeightFamily.zero
statement: lemma zero : t.IsWeightFamily k A (fun _ => 0)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun u => by simp, fun n => by simp⟩

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.IsWeightFamily.add
statement:
lemma add (hc : t.IsWeightFamily k A c) (hd : t.IsWeightFamily k A d) :
    t.IsWeightFamily k A (c + d)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun u => ?_, fun n => ?_⟩
  · refine ((hc.summable u).add (hd.summable u)).congr fun n => ?_
    simp [add_mul]
  · have h1 := hc.step n
    have h2 := hd.step n
    simp only [Pi.add_apply]
    linear_combination h1 + h2

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.IsWeightFamily.smul
statement: lemma smul (a : K) (hc : t.IsWeightFamily k A c) : t.IsWeightFamily k A (a • c)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun u => ?_, fun n => ?_⟩
  · refine ((hc.summable u).mul_left a).congr fun n => ?_
    simp [mul_assoc]
  · have h1 := hc.step n
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    linear_combination a * h1

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.IsWeightFamily.tsum_q_smul
statement:
theorem tsum_q_smul (hc : t.IsWeightFamily k A c) (u : Kˣ) :
    (∑' n : ℤ, c n * ((t.q : K) * (u : K)) ^ n)
      = (A : K) * (u : K) ^ (-(k : ℤ)) * ∑' n : ℤ, c n * (u : K) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (∑' n : ℤ, c n * ((t.q : K) * (u : K)) ^ n)
      = ∑' n : ℤ, (A : K) * c (n + k) * (u : K) ^ n := by
    refine tsum_congr fun n => ?_
    rw [mul_zpow]
    calc c n * ((t.q : K) ^ n * (u : K) ^ n)
        = ((t.q : K) ^ n * c n) * (u : K) ^ n := by ring
      _ = ((A : K) * c (n + k)) * (u : K) ^ n := by rw [hc.step n]
  rw [h1]
  have hshift : Summable fun n : ℤ => c (n + k) * (u : K) ^ (n + k) :=
    (hc.summable u).comp_injective (add_left_injective (k : ℤ))
  have h2 : (∑' n : ℤ, (A : K) * c (n + k) * (u : K) ^ n)
      = (A : K) * (u : K) ^ (-(k : ℤ)) * ∑' n : ℤ, c (n + k) * (u : K) ^ (n + k) := by
    rw [← tsum_mul_left]
    refine tsum_congr fun n => ?_
    rw [zpow_add₀ (Units.ne_zero u), zpow_neg]
    field_simp
  rw [h2]
  congr 1
  rw [← (Equiv.addRight (k : ℤ)).tsum_eq fun n => c n * (u : K) ^ n]
  exact tsum_congr fun n => rfl

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.IsWeightFamily.of_tsum_q_smul
statement:
theorem of_tsum_q_smul (hsum : ∀ u : Kˣ, Summable fun n : ℤ => c n * (u : K) ^ n)
    (h : ∀ u : Kˣ, (∑' n : ℤ, c n * ((t.q : K) * (u : K)) ^ n)
      = (A : K) * (u : K) ^ (-(k : ℤ)) * ∑' n : ℤ, c n * (u : K) ^ n) :
    t.IsWeightFamily k A c
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hsum, fun n => ?_⟩
  have huniq := t.laurentCoeffUnique
  have hsumA : ∀ u : Kˣ, Summable fun n : ℤ => ((t.q : K) ^ n * c n) * (u : K) ^ n := by
    intro u
    refine (hsum (t.q * u)).congr fun n => ?_
    rw [Units.val_mul, mul_zpow]
    ring
  have hsumB : ∀ u : Kˣ, Summable fun n : ℤ => ((A : K) * c (n + k)) * (u : K) ^ n := by
    intro u
    have hshift : Summable fun n : ℤ => c (n + k) * (u : K) ^ n := by
      have h1 : Summable fun n : ℤ => c (n + k) * (u : K) ^ (n + k) :=
        (hsum u).comp_injective (add_left_injective (k : ℤ))
      have h2 := h1.mul_right ((u : K) ^ (-(k : ℤ)))
      refine h2.congr fun n => ?_
      rw [mul_assoc, ← zpow_add₀ (Units.ne_zero u)]
      congr 2
      omega
    refine (hshift.mul_left (A : K)).congr fun n => ?_
    ring
  have key : (fun n : ℤ => (t.q : K) ^ n * c n) = fun n : ℤ => (A : K) * c (n + k) := by
    refine huniq _ _ hsumA hsumB fun u => ?_
    have hL : (∑' n : ℤ, ((t.q : K) ^ n * c n) * (u : K) ^ n)
        = ∑' n : ℤ, c n * ((t.q : K) * (u : K)) ^ n := by
      refine tsum_congr fun n => ?_
      rw [mul_zpow]
      ring
    have hR : (∑' n : ℤ, ((A : K) * c (n + k)) * (u : K) ^ n)
        = (A : K) * (u : K) ^ (-(k : ℤ)) * ∑' n : ℤ, c n * (u : K) ^ n := by
      have h2 : (∑' n : ℤ, c (n + k) * (u : K) ^ (n + k))
          = ∑' n : ℤ, c n * (u : K) ^ n := by
        rw [← (Equiv.addRight (k : ℤ)).tsum_eq fun n => c n * (u : K) ^ n]
        exact tsum_congr fun n => rfl
      rw [← h2, ← tsum_mul_left]
      refine tsum_congr fun n => ?_
      rw [zpow_add₀ (Units.ne_zero u), zpow_neg]
      field_simp
    rw [hL, hR, h u]
  have hkey := congrFun key n
  linear_combination -hkey

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.IsWeightFamily.ext_initial
statement:
theorem ext_initial (hk : 0 < k) (hc : t.IsWeightFamily k A c) (hd : t.IsWeightFamily k A d)
    (h : ∀ i : ℕ, i < k → c i = d i) : c = d
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : (t.q : K) ≠ 0 := t.q.ne_zero
  have hA0 : (A : K) ≠ 0 := Units.ne_zero A
  
  have key : ∀ m : ℤ, ∀ i : ℕ, i < k → c (i + k * m) = d (i + k * m) := by
    intro m
    induction m using Int.induction_on with
    | zero => intro i hi; simpa using h i hi
    | succ m ih =>
      intro i hi
      have hstep_c := hc.step (i + k * m)
      have hstep_d := hd.step (i + k * m)
      have hprev := ih i hi
      have harg : (i : ℤ) + k * m + k = i + k * (m + 1) := by ring
      rw [harg] at hstep_c hstep_d
      have : (A : K) * c (i + k * (m + 1)) = (A : K) * d (i + k * (m + 1)) := by
        rw [hstep_c, hstep_d, hprev]
      exact mul_left_cancel₀ hA0 this
    | pred m ih =>
      intro i hi
      have hstep_c := hc.step (i + k * (-m - 1))
      have hstep_d := hd.step (i + k * (-m - 1))
      have hnext := ih i hi
      have harg : (i : ℤ) + k * (-m - 1) + k = i + k * (-(m : ℤ)) := by ring
      rw [harg] at hstep_c hstep_d
      have hpow : ((t.q : K) ^ ((i : ℤ) + k * (-m - 1))) ≠ 0 := zpow_ne_zero _ hq0
      have : (t.q : K) ^ ((i : ℤ) + k * (-m - 1)) * c (i + k * (-m - 1))
          = (t.q : K) ^ ((i : ℤ) + k * (-m - 1)) * d (i + k * (-m - 1)) := by
        rw [← hstep_c, ← hstep_d, hnext]
      exact mul_left_cancel₀ hpow this
  funext n
  have hik : (0 : ℤ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hmod : n % k + k * (n / k) = n := by
    rw [Int.emod_def]
    ring
  have hi0 : 0 ≤ n % k := Int.emod_nonneg n (by omega)
  have hik' : n % k < k := Int.emod_lt_of_pos n hik
  have := key (n / k) (n % k).toNat (by omega)
  rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg hi0] at this
  rwa [hmod] at this

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.IsWeightFamily.conv
statement:
theorem conv (hc : t.IsWeightFamily k A c) (hd : t.IsWeightFamily l B d) :
    t.IsWeightFamily (k + l) (A * B) fun n => ∑' m : ℤ, c (n - m) * d m
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : (t.q : K) ≠ 0 := t.q.ne_zero
  constructor
  · intro u
    exact (hasSum_laurentConvolution u (hc.summable u).hasSum (hd.summable u).hasSum).summable
  · intro n
    calc ((A * B : Kˣ) : K) * ∑' m : ℤ, c (n + (k + l : ℕ) - m) * d m
        = ∑' m : ℤ, ((A : K) * (B : K)) * (c (n + (k + l : ℕ) - m) * d m) := by
          rw [tsum_mul_left, Units.val_mul]
      _ = ∑' m : ℤ, ((A : K) * (B : K)) * (c (n + (k + l : ℕ) - (m + l)) * d (m + l)) := by
          rw [← (Equiv.addRight (l : ℤ)).tsum_eq fun m =>
            ((A : K) * (B : K)) * (c (n + (k + l : ℕ) - m) * d m)]
          exact tsum_congr fun m => rfl
      _ = ∑' m : ℤ, (t.q : K) ^ n * (c (n - m) * d m) := by
          refine tsum_congr fun m => ?_
          have h1 : n + ((k : ℤ) + l) - (m + l) = (n - m) + k := by ring
          rw [Nat.cast_add, h1]
          calc ((A : K) * (B : K)) * (c ((n - m) + k) * d (m + l))
              = ((A : K) * c ((n - m) + k)) * ((B : K) * d (m + l)) := by ring
            _ = ((t.q : K) ^ (n - m) * c (n - m)) * ((t.q : K) ^ m * d m) := by
                rw [hc.step (n - m), hd.step m]
            _ = (t.q : K) ^ n * (c (n - m) * d m) := by
                rw [show (t.q : K) ^ (n - m) * c (n - m) * ((t.q : K) ^ m * d m)
                    = ((t.q : K) ^ (n - m) * (t.q : K) ^ m) * (c (n - m) * d m) by ring,
                  ← zpow_add₀ hq0]
                congr 2
                omega
      _ = (t.q : K) ^ n * ∑' m : ℤ, c (n - m) * d m := by rw [tsum_mul_left]

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.IsWeightFamily.conv_hasSum
statement:
theorem conv_hasSum (hc : t.IsWeightFamily k A c) (hd : t.IsWeightFamily l B d) (u : Kˣ) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℤ => (∑' m : ℤ, c (n - m) * d m) * (u : K) ^ n)
      ((∑' n : ℤ, c n * (u : K) ^ n) * ∑' n : ℤ, d n * (u : K) ^ n)
proof:
:=
  hasSum_laurentConvolution u (hc.summable u).hasSum (hd.summable u).hasSum

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.emod_fiber
statement:
private lemma emod_fiber (hk : 0 < k) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < k) (m : ℤ) :
    ((i : ℤ) + k * m) % k = i ∧ ((i : ℤ) + k * m) / k = m
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [Int.add_mul_emod_self_left]
    exact Int.emod_eq_of_lt (by positivity) (by exact_mod_cast hi)
  · rw [Int.add_mul_ediv_left _ _ (by positivity : (k : ℤ) ≠ 0),
      Int.ediv_eq_zero_of_lt (by positivity) (by exact_mod_cast hi), zero_add]

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.weightExtend_fiber
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := emod_fiber hk i hi m
  rw [weightExtend]
  congr 1
  · rw [h1, h2]
  · congr 1
    simp [h1]

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.weightExtend_initial
statement:
lemma weightExtend_initial (hk : 0 < k) (v : Fin k → K) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < k) :
    weightExtend (t := t) hk A v i = v ⟨i, hi⟩
proof:
:= by
  have h := weightExtend_fiber (t := t) (A := A) hk v i hi 0
  have hth : thetaExp (0 - 1) = 0 := by norm_num [thetaExp]
  simp only [mul_zero, add_zero, zero_mul, zpow_zero, one_mul, hth] at h
  simpa using h

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.weightExtend_step
statement:
lemma weightExtend_step (hk : 0 < k) (v : Fin k → K) (n : ℤ) :
    (A : K) * weightExtend (t := t) hk A v (n + k)
      = (t.q : K) ^ n * weightExtend (t := t) hk A v n
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : (t.q : K) ≠ 0 := t.q.ne_zero
  have hA0 : (A : K) ≠ 0 := Units.ne_zero A
  set i : ℤ := n % k with hidef
  set m : ℤ := n / k with hmdef
  have h1 : 0 ≤ i := Int.emod_nonneg n (by positivity)
  have h2 : i < k := Int.emod_lt_of_pos n (by exact_mod_cast hk)
  have hn : n = (i.toNat : ℤ) + k * m := by
    rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg h1, hidef, hmdef, Int.emod_def]
    ring
  have hnk : n + k = (i.toNat : ℤ) + k * (m + 1) := by rw [hn]; ring
  rw [hnk, hn, weightExtend_fiber hk v i.toNat (by omega) (m + 1),
    weightExtend_fiber hk v i.toNat (by omega) m]
  have hAz : ((A⁻¹ : Kˣ) : K) = (A : K)⁻¹ := Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val A
  rw [hAz, zpow_add₀ (inv_ne_zero hA0), zpow_one]
  have hexp : (m + 1) * (i.toNat : ℤ) + k * thetaExp (m + 1 - 1)
      = ((i.toNat : ℤ) + k * m) + (m * i.toNat + k * thetaExp (m - 1)) := by
    have hth : thetaExp m = thetaExp (m - 1) + m := by
      have h1 := two_mul_thetaExp m
      have h2 := two_mul_thetaExp (m - 1)
      have h3 : m * (m + 1) = (m - 1) * m + 2 * m := by ring
      linarith
    have : (m + 1 - 1) = m := by ring
    rw [this, hth]
    ring
  rw [hexp, zpow_add₀ hq0]
  field_simp

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.summable_pow_thetaExp_mul
statement:
private lemma summable_pow_thetaExp_mul (t : TateParameter K) (j : ℕ) (hj : 0 < j) (W : Kˣ) :
    Summable fun m : ℤ => (t.q : K) ^ ((j : ℤ) * thetaExp (m - 1)) * (W : K) ^ m
proof:
:= by
  apply NonarchimedeanAddGroup.summable_of_tendsto_cofinite_zero
  apply tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero.mpr
  have ha : 0 < ‖(t.q : K)‖ := t.norm_q_pos
  have hb : 0 < ‖(W : K)‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr W.ne_zero
  have hnorm : (fun m : ℤ => ‖(t.q : K) ^ ((j : ℤ) * thetaExp (m - 1)) * (W : K) ^ m‖)
      = fun m : ℤ => Real.exp (Real.log ‖(t.q : K)‖ * (((j : ℤ) * thetaExp (m - 1) : ℤ) : ℝ)
          + Real.log ‖(W : K)‖ * (m : ℝ)) := by
    funext m
    rw [norm_mul, norm_zpow, norm_zpow,
      ← Real.rpow_intCast ‖(t.q : K)‖ _, ← Real.rpow_intCast ‖(W : K)‖ m,
      Real.rpow_def_of_pos ha, Real.rpow_def_of_pos hb, ← Real.exp_add]
  rw [hnorm]
  refine Real.tendsto_exp_atBot.comp ?_
  have hLa2 : (j : ℝ) * Real.log ‖(t.q : K)‖ / 2 < 0 := by
    have hlog := Real.log_neg ha t.norm_lt_one
    have hj' : (0 : ℝ) < j := by exact_mod_cast hj
    nlinarith
  have hfac : (fun m : ℤ => Real.log ‖(t.q : K)‖ * (((j : ℤ) * thetaExp (m - 1) : ℤ) : ℝ)
      + Real.log ‖(W : K)‖ * (m : ℝ))
      = fun m : ℤ => (m : ℝ) * ((Real.log ‖(W : K)‖ - (j : ℝ) * Real.log ‖(t.q : K)‖ / 2)
          + (j : ℝ) * Real.log ‖(t.q : K)‖ / 2 * (m : ℝ)) := by
    funext m
    push_cast [thetaExp_cast]
    ring
  rw [hfac, Int.cofinite_eq, tendsto_sup]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · exact Tendsto.atBot_mul_atTop₀ (tendsto_intCast_atBot_iff.2 tendsto_id)
      (Tendsto.add_atTop tendsto_const_nhds
        (Tendsto.const_mul_atBot_of_neg hLa2 (tendsto_intCast_atBot_iff.2 tendsto_id)))
  · exact Tendsto.atTop_mul_atBot₀ tendsto_intCast_atTop_atTop
      (Tendsto.add_atBot tendsto_const_nhds
        (Tendsto.const_mul_atTop_of_neg hLa2 tendsto_intCast_atTop_atTop))

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.summable_weightExtend_fiber
statement:
private lemma summable_weightExtend_fiber (hk : 0 < k) (v : Fin k → K) (u : Kˣ)
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i < k) :
    Summable fun m : ℤ =>
      weightExtend (t := t) hk A v ((i : ℤ) + k * m) * (u : K) ^ ((i : ℤ) + k * m)
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : (t.q : K) ≠ 0 := t.q.ne_zero
  set W : Kˣ := A⁻¹ * t.q ^ i * u ^ k with hW
  have h := (summable_pow_thetaExp_mul t k hk W).mul_left (v ⟨i, hi⟩ * (u : K) ^ (i : ℤ))
  refine h.congr fun m => ?_
  have hWm : ((W : Kˣ) : K) ^ m
      = ((A⁻¹ : Kˣ) : K) ^ m * (t.q : K) ^ ((i : ℤ) * m) * (u : K) ^ ((k : ℤ) * m) := by
    rw [hW]
    push_cast [Units.val_mul, mul_zpow, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val]
    rw [← zpow_natCast ((t.q : K)) i, ← zpow_natCast ((u : K)) k, zpow_mul, zpow_mul]
  rw [weightExtend_fiber hk v i hi m, hWm,
    zpow_add₀ (Units.ne_zero u) (i : ℤ) ((k : ℤ) * m),
    zpow_add₀ hq0 (m * (i : ℤ)) ((k : ℤ) * thetaExp (m - 1)),
    show m * (i : ℤ) = (i : ℤ) * m from mul_comm _ _]
  ring

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.summable_weightExtend
statement:
private lemma summable_weightExtend (hk : 0 < k) (v : Fin k → K) (u : Kˣ) :
    Summable fun n : ℤ => weightExtend (t := t) hk A v n * (u : K) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set f : ℤ → K := fun n => weightExtend (t := t) hk A v n * (u : K) ^ n with hf
  have hsplit : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range k,
      Summable fun n : ℤ => if n % k = i then f n else 0 := by
    intro i hi
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hi
    have hinj : Function.Injective fun m : ℤ => (i : ℤ) + k * m := by
      intro a b hab
      simp only at hab
      have hk0 : (k : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have h2 : (k : ℤ) * a = (k : ℤ) * b := by linarith
      exact mul_left_cancel₀ hk0 h2
    apply (hinj.summable_iff ?_).mp
    · refine (summable_weightExtend_fiber (t := t) (A := A) hk v u i hi).congr fun m => ?_
      have := (emod_fiber hk i hi m).1
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, hf, this, if_true]
    · intro n hn
      have hne : ¬(n % k = i) := by
        intro hcontra
        refine hn ⟨n / k, ?_⟩
        simp only
        have hdef := Int.emod_def n k
        rw [hcontra] at hdef
        linarith
      simp [hne]
  have hsum := summable_sum hsplit
  refine hsum.congr fun n => ?_
  have h1 : 0 ≤ n % k := Int.emod_nonneg n (by positivity)
  have h2 : n % k < k := Int.emod_lt_of_pos n (by exact_mod_cast hk)
  have hmem : (n % k).toNat ∈ Finset.range k := Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
  calc (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, if n % k = (i : ℤ) then f n else 0)
      = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, if i = (n % k).toNat then f n else 0 := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
        by_cases hcase : n % k = (i : ℤ)
        · rw [if_pos hcase, if_pos (by omega)]
        · rw [if_neg hcase, if_neg (by omega)]
    _ = f n := by
        rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' (Finset.range k) ((n % k).toNat) fun _ => f n, if_pos hmem]

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.isWeightFamily_weightExtend
statement:
lemma isWeightFamily_weightExtend (hk : 0 < k) (v : Fin k → K) :
    t.IsWeightFamily k A (weightExtend (t := t) hk A v)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun u => summable_weightExtend (t := t) (A := A) hk v u, weightExtend_step hk v⟩

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.mem_weightSpace
statement:
@[simp] lemma mem_weightSpace {c : ℤ → K} :
    c ∈ t.weightSpace k A ↔ t.IsWeightFamily k A c
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.finrank_weightSpace
statement:
lemma finrank_weightSpace (hk : 0 < k) :
    Module.finrank K (t.weightSpace k A) = k
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearEquiv.finrank_eq (weightEquiv (t := t) (A := A) hk)]
  simp [Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card]

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.finiteDimensional_weightSpace
statement:
lemma finiteDimensional_weightSpace (hk : 0 < k) :
    FiniteDimensional K (t.weightSpace k A)
proof:
:=
  Module.Finite.equiv (weightEquiv (t := t) (A := A) hk).symm

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.thetaBlock_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma thetaBlock_apply (e : Kˣ) (n : ℤ) :
    t.thetaBlock e n = (t.q : K) ^ thetaExp n * (e : K) ^ n
proof: := rfl

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.summable_thetaBlock
statement:
lemma summable_thetaBlock (e u : Kˣ) :
    Summable fun n : ℤ => t.thetaBlock e n * (u : K) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  refine (t.thetaTerm_summable (e * u)).congr fun n => ?_
  rw [thetaTerm, thetaBlock_apply, Units.val_mul, mul_zpow]
  ring

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.tsum_thetaBlock
statement:
lemma tsum_thetaBlock (e u : Kˣ) :
    (∑' n : ℤ, t.thetaBlock e n * (u : K) ^ n) = t.theta (e * u)
proof:
:= by
  rw [theta_apply]
  refine tsum_congr fun n => ?_
  rw [thetaBlock_apply, Units.val_mul, mul_zpow]
  ring

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.isWeightFamily_thetaBlock
statement:
lemma isWeightFamily_thetaBlock (e : Kˣ) :
    t.IsWeightFamily 1 (t.q * e)⁻¹ (t.thetaBlock e)
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : (t.q : K) ≠ 0 := t.q.ne_zero
  have he0 : (e : K) ≠ 0 := Units.ne_zero e
  refine ⟨summable_thetaBlock e, fun n => ?_⟩
  have hth : thetaExp (n + 1) = thetaExp n + (n + 1) := by
    have h1 := two_mul_thetaExp (n + 1)
    have h2 := two_mul_thetaExp n
    have h3 : (n + 1) * (n + 1 + 1) = n * (n + 1) + 2 * (n + 1) := by ring
    linarith
  rw [Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val, Units.val_mul]
  simp only [thetaBlock_apply, Nat.cast_one]
  rw [hth, zpow_add₀ hq0, zpow_add₀ he0, zpow_add₀ hq0, zpow_one, zpow_one]
  field_simp

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.summable_mul_pointwise'
statement:
private lemma summable_mul_pointwise' {f g : ℤ → K} (hf : Summable f) (hg : Summable g) :
    Summable fun m : ℤ => f m * g m
proof:
:= by
  have h := hf.tendsto_cofinite_zero.mul hg.tendsto_cofinite_zero
  rw [mul_zero] at h
  exact NonarchimedeanAddGroup.summable_of_tendsto_cofinite_zero h

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.IsWeightFamily.summable_coeff
statement:
lemma IsWeightFamily.summable_coeff {c : ℤ → K} (hc : t.IsWeightFamily k A c) :
    Summable c
proof:
:= by
  have h := hc.summable 1
  refine h.congr fun n => ?_
  simp

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.evalAt_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma evalAt_apply (x : Kˣ) (c : t.weightSpace k A) :
    evalAt x k A c = ∑' n : ℤ, (c : ℤ → K) n * (x : K) ^ n
proof: := rfl

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.convBlock_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma convBlock_apply (e : Kˣ) (c : t.weightSpace k A) (n : ℤ) :
    (convBlock (t := t) e k A c : ℤ → K) n
      = ∑' m : ℤ, t.thetaBlock e (n - m) * (c : ℤ → K) m
proof: := rfl

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.evalAt_convBlock
statement:
lemma evalAt_convBlock (e : Kˣ) (c : t.weightSpace k A) (u : Kˣ) :
    evalAt u (1 + k) ((t.q * e)⁻¹ * A) (convBlock (t := t) e k A c)
      = t.theta (e * u) * evalAt u k A c
proof:
:= by
  have hsc : Summable fun n : ℤ => (c : ℤ → K) n * (u : K) ^ n := c.2.summable u
  have h : HasSum
      (fun ℓ : ℤ => (∑' m : ℤ, t.thetaBlock e (ℓ - m) * (c : ℤ → K) m) * (u : K) ^ ℓ)
      ((∑' n : ℤ, t.thetaBlock e n * (u : K) ^ n)
        * ∑' n : ℤ, (c : ℤ → K) n * (u : K) ^ n) :=
    hasSum_laurentConvolution u (summable_thetaBlock (t := t) e u).hasSum hsc.hasSum
  rw [tsum_thetaBlock e u] at h
  exact h.tsum_eq

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.convBlock_injective
statement:
theorem convBlock_injective (e : Kˣ) (k : ℕ) (A : Kˣ) :
    Function.Injective (convBlock (t := t) e k A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro c hc0
  by_contra hne
  have hcfam : (c : ℤ → K) ≠ 0 := fun h => hne (Subtype.ext h)
  have hfin := TateCurvesTheta.StrassmannSphere.finite_zeros
    (c := (c : ℤ → K)) c.2.summable_coeff hcfam
  
  have hzero : ∀ u : Kˣ, t.theta (e * u) ≠ 0 → (∑' n : ℤ, (c : ℤ → K) n * (u : K) ^ n) = 0 := by
    intro u hθ
    have hval := evalAt_convBlock (t := t) e c u
    rw [hc0, map_zero] at hval
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hval.symm with h | h
    · exact absurd h hθ
    · simpa using h
  
  have hbad : ∀ j₁ j₂ : ℕ, t.theta (e * t.sphereWitness j₁) = 0 →
      t.theta (e * t.sphereWitness j₂) = 0 → j₁ = j₂ := by
    intro j₁ j₂ h₁ h₂
    obtain ⟨k₁, hk₁⟩ := (t.theta_eq_zero_iff _).mp h₁
    obtain ⟨k₂, hk₂⟩ := (t.theta_eq_zero_iff _).mp h₂
    have hn₁ : ‖((e * t.sphereWitness j₁ : Kˣ) : K)‖ = ‖(e : K)‖ := by
      rw [Units.val_mul, norm_mul, t.sphereWitness_val, t.norm_one_add_qpow, mul_one]
    have hn₂ : ‖((e * t.sphereWitness j₂ : Kˣ) : K)‖ = ‖(e : K)‖ := by
      rw [Units.val_mul, norm_mul, t.sphereWitness_val, t.norm_one_add_qpow, mul_one]
    have hkk : k₁ = k₂ := by
      have h₁' := congrArg norm hk₁
      have h₂' := congrArg norm hk₂
      rw [hn₁, norm_neg, norm_zpow] at h₁'
      rw [hn₂, norm_neg, norm_zpow] at h₂'
      have hq1 : ‖(t.q : K)‖ < 1 := t.norm_lt_one
      have hq0 : 0 < ‖(t.q : K)‖ := t.norm_q_pos
      by_contra hne'
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne' with h | h
      · have := zpow_lt_zpow_right_of_lt_one₀ hq0 hq1 h
        rw [← h₁', ← h₂'] at this
        exact lt_irrefl _ this
      · have := zpow_lt_zpow_right_of_lt_one₀ hq0 hq1 h
        rw [← h₁', ← h₂'] at this
        exact lt_irrefl _ this
    rw [hkk] at hk₁
    have : ((t.sphereWitness j₁ : Kˣ) : K) = ((t.sphereWitness j₂ : Kˣ) : K) := by
      have := hk₁.trans hk₂.symm
      rw [Units.val_mul, Units.val_mul] at this
      exact mul_left_cancel₀ (Units.ne_zero e) this
    exact t.sphereWitness_injective (Units.ext this)
  
  have hmem : ∀ j : ℕ, t.theta (e * t.sphereWitness j) ≠ 0 →
      ((t.sphereWitness j : Kˣ) : K) ∈
        {v : K | ‖v‖ = 1 ∧ (∑' n : ℤ, (c : ℤ → K) n * v ^ n) = 0} := by
    intro j hj
    refine ⟨by rw [t.sphereWitness_val]; exact t.norm_one_add_qpow j, ?_⟩
    exact hzero (t.sphereWitness j) hj
  classical
  by_cases hex : ∃ j₀ : ℕ, t.theta (e * t.sphereWitness j₀) = 0
  · obtain ⟨j₀, hj₀⟩ := hex
    have hinj : Function.Injective fun j : ℕ => ((t.sphereWitness (j + j₀ + 1) : Kˣ) : K) :=
      fun a b hab => by
        have := t.sphereWitness_injective (Units.ext hab)
        omega
    refine Set.infinite_of_injective_forall_mem hinj (fun j => hmem _ fun hz => ?_) hfin
    have := hbad _ _ hz hj₀
    omega
  · rw [not_exists] at hex
    have hinj : Function.Injective fun j : ℕ => ((t.sphereWitness j : Kˣ) : K) :=
      fun a b hab => t.sphereWitness_injective (Units.ext hab)
    exact Set.infinite_of_injective_forall_mem hinj (fun j => hmem j (hex j)) hfin

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.exists_convBlock_eq
statement:
theorem exists_convBlock_eq (hk : 0 < k) (e : Kˣ) {x₀ : Kˣ}
    (hx₀ : t.theta (e * x₀) = 0)
    (g : t.weightSpace (1 + k) ((t.q * e)⁻¹ * A))
    (hg : evalAt x₀ (1 + k) ((t.q * e)⁻¹ * A) g ≠ 0)
    (F : t.weightSpace (1 + k) ((t.q * e)⁻¹ * A))
    (hF : evalAt x₀ (1 + k) ((t.q * e)⁻¹ * A) F = 0) :
    ∃ c : t.weightSpace k A, convBlock (t := t) e k A c = F
proof:
:= by
  haveI : FiniteDimensional K (t.weightSpace (1 + k) ((t.q * e)⁻¹ * A)) :=
    finiteDimensional_weightSpace (by omega)
  haveI : FiniteDimensional K (t.weightSpace k A) := finiteDimensional_weightSpace hk
  set ev := evalAt (t := t) x₀ (1 + k) ((t.q * e)⁻¹ * A) with hev
  set Φ := convBlock (t := t) e k A with hΦ
  
  have himle : LinearMap.range Φ ≤ LinearMap.ker ev := by
    rintro _ ⟨c, rfl⟩
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, hev, hΦ, evalAt_convBlock, hx₀, zero_mul]
  
  have hrange : Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range Φ) = k := by
    rw [LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj (convBlock_injective e k A)]
    exact finrank_weightSpace hk
  have hker : Module.finrank K (LinearMap.ker ev) = k := by
    have hspace : Module.finrank K (t.weightSpace (1 + k) ((t.q * e)⁻¹ * A)) = 1 + k :=
      finrank_weightSpace (by omega)
    have hrn := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker ev
    have hr1 : Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range ev) = 1 := by
      have hle : Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range ev) ≤ 1 := by
        have h := Submodule.finrank_le (LinearMap.range ev)
        simpa using h
      have hne : LinearMap.range ev ≠ ⊥ := by
        intro h0
        have h1 : ev = 0 := LinearMap.range_eq_bot.mp h0
        rw [h1] at hg
        simp at hg
      have hge : 1 ≤ Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range ev) := by
        by_contra hlt
        have h0 : Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range ev) = 0 := by omega
        exact hne (Submodule.finrank_eq_zero.mp h0)
      omega
    rw [hspace, hr1] at hrn
    omega
  have heq : LinearMap.range Φ = LinearMap.ker ev :=
    Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_le himle (by rw [hker, hrange])
  have hFmem : F ∈ LinearMap.range Φ := by
    rw [heq, LinearMap.mem_ker]
    exact hF
  exact hFmem

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.exists_convBlock_eq'
statement:
theorem exists_convBlock_eq' (hk : 0 < k) (e : Kˣ) {M : Kˣ} (hM : (t.q * e)⁻¹ * A = M)
    {x₀ : Kˣ} (hx₀ : t.theta (e * x₀) = 0)
    (g : t.weightSpace (1 + k) M) (hg : evalAt x₀ (1 + k) M g ≠ 0)
    (F : t.weightSpace (1 + k) M) (hF : evalAt x₀ (1 + k) M F = 0) :
    ∃ c : t.weightSpace k A,
      ∀ n : ℤ, (∑' m : ℤ, t.thetaBlock e (n - m) * (c : ℤ → K) m) = (F : ℤ → K) n
proof:
:= by
  subst hM
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_convBlock_eq hk e hx₀ g hg F hF
  exact ⟨c, fun n => by rw [← hc]; rfl⟩

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.w1_eq_smul_thetaBlock
proof:
:= by
  have hblock := isWeightFamily_thetaBlock (t := t) ((t.q * A)⁻¹)
  have hmul : (t.q * (t.q * A)⁻¹)⁻¹ = A := by
    rw [mul_inv, inv_inv, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel, one_mul]
  rw [hmul] at hblock
  refine IsWeightFamily.ext_initial Nat.one_pos hc (hblock.smul (c 0)) fun i hi => ?_
  interval_cases i
  simp [thetaBlock_apply, thetaExp]

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.laurent_ext_off_orbit
statement:
theorem laurent_ext_off_orbit {a b : ℤ → K}
    (ha : ∀ u : Kˣ, Summable fun n : ℤ => a n * (u : K) ^ n)
    (hb : ∀ u : Kˣ, Summable fun n : ℤ => b n * (u : K) ^ n)
    (h : ∀ u : Kˣ, (∀ n : ℤ, (t.q : K) ^ n * (u : K) ≠ 1) →
      (∑' n : ℤ, a n * (u : K) ^ n) = ∑' n : ℤ, b n * (u : K) ^ n) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  have hd0 : (fun n : ℤ => a n - b n) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    exact hne (funext fun n => sub_eq_zero.mp (congrFun h0 n))
  have hdsum : Summable fun n : ℤ => a n - b n := by
    refine ((ha 1).sub (hb 1)).congr fun n => ?_
    simp
  have hfin := TateCurvesTheta.StrassmannSphere.finite_zeros hdsum hd0
  have hmem : ∀ j : ℕ, ((t.sphereWitness j : Kˣ) : K) ∈
      {v : K | ‖v‖ = 1 ∧ (∑' n : ℤ, (a n - b n) * v ^ n) = 0} := by
    intro j
    have hnorm : ‖((t.sphereWitness j : Kˣ) : K)‖ = 1 := by
      rw [t.sphereWitness_val]
      exact t.norm_one_add_qpow j
    refine ⟨hnorm, ?_⟩
    have hoff : ∀ n : ℤ, (t.q : K) ^ n * ((t.sphereWitness j : Kˣ) : K) ≠ 1 := by
      intro n hcontra
      have h1 := congrArg norm hcontra
      rw [norm_mul, norm_zpow, hnorm, mul_one, norm_one] at h1
      have hq1 : ‖(t.q : K)‖ < 1 := t.norm_lt_one
      have hq0 : 0 < ‖(t.q : K)‖ := t.norm_q_pos
      have hn0 : n = 0 := by
        by_contra hn
        rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hn with hlt | hgt
        · have hmono := zpow_lt_zpow_right_of_lt_one₀ hq0 hq1 hlt
          rw [zpow_zero, h1] at hmono
          exact lt_irrefl _ hmono
        · have hmono := zpow_lt_zpow_right_of_lt_one₀ hq0 hq1 hgt
          rw [zpow_zero, h1] at hmono
          exact lt_irrefl _ hmono
      rw [hn0, zpow_zero, one_mul, t.sphereWitness_val] at hcontra
      have hz : (t.q : K) ^ (j + 1) = 0 := by linear_combination hcontra
      exact pow_ne_zero (j + 1) t.q.ne_zero hz
    have heq := h (t.sphereWitness j) hoff
    calc (∑' n : ℤ, (a n - b n) * ((t.sphereWitness j : Kˣ) : K) ^ n)
        = ∑' n : ℤ, (a n * ((t.sphereWitness j : Kˣ) : K) ^ n
            - b n * ((t.sphereWitness j : Kˣ) : K) ^ n) := by
          refine tsum_congr fun n => ?_
          ring
      _ = (∑' n : ℤ, a n * ((t.sphereWitness j : Kˣ) : K) ^ n)
            - ∑' n : ℤ, b n * ((t.sphereWitness j : Kˣ) : K) ^ n :=
          Summable.tsum_sub (ha _) (hb _)
      _ = 0 := by rw [heq, sub_self]
  have hinj : Function.Injective fun j : ℕ => ((t.sphereWitness j : Kˣ) : K) :=
    fun x y hxy => t.sphereWitness_injective (Units.ext hxy)
  exact Set.infinite_of_injective_forall_mem hinj hmem hfin

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.isWeightFamily_of_tsum_q_smul_off_orbit
statement:
theorem isWeightFamily_of_tsum_q_smul_off_orbit {k : ℕ} {A : Kˣ} {c : ℤ → K}
    (hsum : ∀ u : Kˣ, Summable fun n : ℤ => c n * (u : K) ^ n)
    (h : ∀ u : Kˣ, (∀ n : ℤ, (t.q : K) ^ n * (u : K) ≠ 1) →
      (∑' n : ℤ, c n * ((t.q : K) * (u : K)) ^ n)
        = (A : K) * (u : K) ^ (-(k : ℤ)) * ∑' n : ℤ, c n * (u : K) ^ n) :
    t.IsWeightFamily k A c
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hsum, fun n => ?_⟩
  have hsumA : ∀ u : Kˣ, Summable fun n : ℤ => ((t.q : K) ^ n * c n) * (u : K) ^ n := by
    intro u
    refine (hsum (t.q * u)).congr fun n => ?_
    rw [Units.val_mul, mul_zpow]
    ring
  have hsumB : ∀ u : Kˣ, Summable fun n : ℤ => ((A : K) * c (n + k)) * (u : K) ^ n := by
    intro u
    have h1 : Summable fun n : ℤ => c (n + k) * (u : K) ^ (n + k) :=
      (hsum u).comp_injective (add_left_injective (k : ℤ))
    have h2 := h1.mul_right ((u : K) ^ (-(k : ℤ)))
    have h3 : Summable fun n : ℤ => c (n + k) * (u : K) ^ n := by
      refine h2.congr fun n => ?_
      rw [mul_assoc, ← zpow_add₀ (Units.ne_zero u)]
      congr 2
      omega
    refine (h3.mul_left (A : K)).congr fun n => ?_
    ring
  have key : (fun n : ℤ => (t.q : K) ^ n * c n) = fun n : ℤ => (A : K) * c (n + k) := by
    refine laurent_ext_off_orbit (t := t) hsumA hsumB fun u hu => ?_
    have hL : (∑' n : ℤ, ((t.q : K) ^ n * c n) * (u : K) ^ n)
        = ∑' n : ℤ, c n * ((t.q : K) * (u : K)) ^ n := by
      refine tsum_congr fun n => ?_
      rw [mul_zpow]
      ring
    have hR : (∑' n : ℤ, ((A : K) * c (n + k)) * (u : K) ^ n)
        = (A : K) * (u : K) ^ (-(k : ℤ)) * ∑' n : ℤ, c n * (u : K) ^ n := by
      have h2 : (∑' n : ℤ, c (n + k) * (u : K) ^ (n + k))
          = ∑' n : ℤ, c n * (u : K) ^ n := by
        rw [← (Equiv.addRight (k : ℤ)).tsum_eq fun n => c n * (u : K) ^ n]
        exact tsum_congr fun n => rfl
      rw [← h2, ← tsum_mul_left]
      refine tsum_congr fun n => ?_
      rw [zpow_add₀ (Units.ne_zero u), zpow_neg]
      field_simp
    rw [hL, hR, h u hu]
  have hkey := congrFun key n
  linear_combination -hkey

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.exists_unit_avoiding
statement:
theorem exists_unit_avoiding (S : Finset Kˣ) :
    ∃ s : Kˣ, ∀ y ∈ S, ∀ n : ℤ, (s : K) ≠ (t.q : K) ^ n * (y : K)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcontra
  rw [not_exists] at hcontra
  have hchoice : ∀ j : ℕ, ∃ y ∈ S, ∃ n : ℤ,
      ((t.sphereWitness j : Kˣ) : K) = (t.q : K) ^ n * (y : K) := by
    intro j
    by_contra hj
    exact hcontra (t.sphereWitness j) fun y hy n hn => hj ⟨y, hy, n, hn⟩
  choose f hfS g hfg using hchoice
  have hSfin : Set.Finite (Set.range f) := (S.finite_toSet.subset (by
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    exact hfS j))
  have hinjW : Function.Injective t.sphereWitness := t.sphereWitness_injective
  
  have hkey : ∀ j₁ j₂ : ℕ, f j₁ = f j₂ → j₁ = j₂ := by
    intro j₁ j₂ hf12
    have h₁ := hfg j₁
    have h₂ := hfg j₂
    rw [hf12] at h₁
    have hnorm₁ : ‖((t.sphereWitness j₁ : Kˣ) : K)‖ = 1 := by
      rw [t.sphereWitness_val]; exact t.norm_one_add_qpow j₁
    have hnorm₂ : ‖((t.sphereWitness j₂ : Kˣ) : K)‖ = 1 := by
      rw [t.sphereWitness_val]; exact t.norm_one_add_qpow j₂
    have hq1 : ‖(t.q : K)‖ < 1 := t.norm_lt_one
    have hq0 : 0 < ‖(t.q : K)‖ := t.norm_q_pos
    have hnn : g j₁ = g j₂ := by
      have e₁ := congrArg norm h₁
      have e₂ := congrArg norm h₂
      rw [norm_mul, norm_zpow, hnorm₁] at e₁
      rw [norm_mul, norm_zpow, hnorm₂] at e₂
      have hy0 : 0 < ‖((f j₂ : Kˣ) : K)‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (Units.ne_zero _)
      have heq : ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ g j₁ = ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ g j₂ :=
        mul_right_cancel₀ hy0.ne' (e₁.symm.trans e₂)
      by_contra hne'
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne' with hlt | hgt
      · have := zpow_lt_zpow_right_of_lt_one₀ hq0 hq1 hlt
        rw [heq] at this
        exact lt_irrefl _ this
      · have := zpow_lt_zpow_right_of_lt_one₀ hq0 hq1 hgt
        rw [heq] at this
        exact lt_irrefl _ this
    rw [hnn] at h₁
    have : ((t.sphereWitness j₁ : Kˣ) : K) = ((t.sphereWitness j₂ : Kˣ) : K) :=
      h₁.trans h₂.symm
    exact hinjW (Units.ext this)
  have hinjf : Function.Injective f := fun a b hab => hkey a b hab
  exact Set.infinite_range_of_injective hinjf hSfin

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.witness_class_unique
proof:
:= by
  have hq1 : ‖(t.q : K)‖ < 1 := t.norm_lt_one
  have hq0 : 0 < ‖(t.q : K)‖ := t.norm_q_pos
  have hnorm₁ : ‖((t.sphereWitness j₁ : Kˣ) : K)‖ = 1 := by
    rw [t.sphereWitness_val]; exact t.norm_one_add_qpow j₁
  have hnorm₂ : ‖((t.sphereWitness j₂ : Kˣ) : K)‖ = 1 := by
    rw [t.sphereWitness_val]; exact t.norm_one_add_qpow j₂
  have hy0 : (0 : ℝ) < ‖(y : K)‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (Units.ne_zero y)
  have e₁ := congrArg norm h₁
  have e₂ := congrArg norm h₂
  rw [norm_mul, norm_zpow, hnorm₁] at e₁
  rw [norm_mul, norm_zpow, hnorm₂] at e₂
  have heq : ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ n₁ = ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ n₂ :=
    mul_right_cancel₀ hy0.ne' (e₁.symm.trans e₂)
  have hnn : n₁ = n₂ := by
    by_contra hne'
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne' with hlt | hgt
    · exact lt_irrefl _ (heq ▸ zpow_lt_zpow_right_of_lt_one₀ hq0 hq1 hlt)
    · exact lt_irrefl _ (heq ▸ zpow_lt_zpow_right_of_lt_one₀ hq0 hq1 hgt)
  rw [hnn] at h₁
  exact t.sphereWitness_injective (Units.ext (h₁.trans h₂.symm))

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.witness_sq_class_unique
proof:
:= by
  have hq1 : ‖(t.q : K)‖ < 1 := t.norm_lt_one
  have hq0 : 0 < ‖(t.q : K)‖ := t.norm_q_pos
  have hnorm₁ : ‖((t.sphereWitness j₁ : Kˣ) : K)‖ = 1 := by
    rw [t.sphereWitness_val]; exact t.norm_one_add_qpow j₁
  have hnorm₂ : ‖((t.sphereWitness j₂ : Kˣ) : K)‖ = 1 := by
    rw [t.sphereWitness_val]; exact t.norm_one_add_qpow j₂
  have hy0 : (0 : ℝ) < ‖(y : K)‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (Units.ne_zero y)
  have e₁ := congrArg norm h₁
  have e₂ := congrArg norm h₂
  rw [norm_mul, norm_zpow, norm_pow, hnorm₁, one_pow] at e₁
  rw [norm_mul, norm_zpow, norm_pow, hnorm₂, one_pow] at e₂
  have heq : ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ n₁ = ‖(t.q : K)‖ ^ n₂ :=
    mul_right_cancel₀ hy0.ne' (e₁.symm.trans e₂)
  have hnn : n₁ = n₂ := by
    by_contra hne'
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne' with hlt | hgt
    · exact lt_irrefl _ (heq ▸ zpow_lt_zpow_right_of_lt_one₀ hq0 hq1 hlt)
    · exact lt_irrefl _ (heq ▸ zpow_lt_zpow_right_of_lt_one₀ hq0 hq1 hgt)
  rw [hnn] at h₁
  have hsq : ((t.sphereWitness j₁ : Kˣ) : K) ^ 2 = ((t.sphereWitness j₂ : Kˣ) : K) ^ 2 :=
    h₁.trans h₂.symm
  have hfac : (((t.sphereWitness j₁ : Kˣ) : K) - ((t.sphereWitness j₂ : Kˣ) : K))
      * (((t.sphereWitness j₁ : Kˣ) : K) + ((t.sphereWitness j₂ : Kˣ) : K)) = 0 := by
    linear_combination hsq
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hfac with h | h
  · exact t.sphereWitness_injective (Units.ext (sub_eq_zero.mp h))
  · exfalso
    have hsum : ((t.sphereWitness j₁ : Kˣ) : K) + ((t.sphereWitness j₂ : Kˣ) : K)
        = 2 + ((t.q : K) ^ (j₁ + 1) + (t.q : K) ^ (j₂ + 1)) := by
      rw [t.sphereWitness_val, t.sphereWitness_val]
      ring
    have hqsmall : ‖(t.q : K) ^ (j₁ + 1) + (t.q : K) ^ (j₂ + 1)‖ < 1 := by
      refine lt_of_le_of_lt (IsUltrametricDist.norm_add_le_max _ _) ?_
      rw [max_lt_iff]
      constructor <;>
        · rw [norm_pow]
          exact pow_lt_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) t.norm_lt_one (Nat.succ_ne_zero _)
    have hne : ‖(2 : K)‖ ≠ ‖(t.q : K) ^ (j₁ + 1) + (t.q : K) ^ (j₂ + 1)‖ := by
      rw [h2]
      exact fun hcon => lt_irrefl _ (hcon ▸ hqsmall)
    have hnorm : ‖(2 : K) + ((t.q : K) ^ (j₁ + 1) + (t.q : K) ^ (j₂ + 1))‖ = 1 := by
      rw [IsUltrametricDist.norm_add_eq_max_of_norm_ne_norm hne, h2]
      exact max_eq_left (le_of_lt (h2 ▸ hqsmall))
    rw [hsum] at h
    have hc := congrArg norm h
    rw [hnorm, norm_zero] at hc
    exact one_ne_zero hc

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateParameter.exists_unit_avoiding_sq
statement:
theorem exists_unit_avoiding_sq (h2 : ‖(2 : K)‖ = 1) (S T : Finset Kˣ) :
    ∃ s : Kˣ, (∀ y ∈ S, ∀ n : ℤ, (s : K) ≠ (t.q : K) ^ n * (y : K)) ∧
      ∀ y ∈ T, ∀ n : ℤ, ((s : K)) ^ 2 ≠ (t.q : K) ^ n * (y : K)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hcontra
  rw [not_exists] at hcontra
  have hchoice : ∀ j : ℕ,
      (∃ y ∈ S, ∃ n : ℤ, ((t.sphereWitness j : Kˣ) : K) = (t.q : K) ^ n * (y : K))
        ∨ ∃ y ∈ T, ∃ n : ℤ, ((t.sphereWitness j : Kˣ) : K) ^ 2 = (t.q : K) ^ n * (y : K) := by
    intro j
    by_contra hj
    rw [not_or] at hj
    refine hcontra (t.sphereWitness j) ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro y hy n hn
      exact hj.1 ⟨y, hy, n, hn⟩
    · intro y hy n hn
      exact hj.2 ⟨y, hy, n, hn⟩
  set F : ℕ → Kˣ × Bool := fun j =>
    if h : ∃ y ∈ S, ∃ n : ℤ, ((t.sphereWitness j : Kˣ) : K) = (t.q : K) ^ n * (y : K) then
      (h.choose, true)
    else (((hchoice j).resolve_left h).choose, false)
    with hF
  have hinjF : Function.Injective F := by
    intro j₁ j₂ heq
    by_cases h₁ : ∃ y ∈ S, ∃ n : ℤ,
        ((t.sphereWitness j₁ : Kˣ) : K) = (t.q : K) ^ n * (y : K) <;>
      by_cases h₂ : ∃ y ∈ S, ∃ n : ℤ,
        ((t.sphereWitness j₂ : Kˣ) : K) = (t.q : K) ^ n * (y : K)
    · rw [hF] at heq
      simp only [dif_pos h₁, dif_pos h₂, Prod.mk.injEq] at heq
      obtain ⟨_, n₁, hn₁⟩ := h₁.choose_spec
      obtain ⟨_, n₂, hn₂⟩ := h₂.choose_spec
      rw [heq.1] at hn₁
      exact t.witness_class_unique hn₁ hn₂
    · rw [hF] at heq
      simp only [dif_pos h₁, dif_neg h₂, Prod.mk.injEq] at heq
      exact absurd heq.2 (by simp)
    · rw [hF] at heq
      simp only [dif_neg h₁, dif_pos h₂, Prod.mk.injEq] at heq
      exact absurd heq.2 (by simp)
    · rw [hF] at heq
      simp only [dif_neg h₁, dif_neg h₂, Prod.mk.injEq] at heq
      obtain ⟨_, n₁, hn₁⟩ := ((hchoice j₁).resolve_left h₁).choose_spec
      obtain ⟨_, n₂, hn₂⟩ := ((hchoice j₂).resolve_left h₂).choose_spec
      rw [heq.1] at hn₁
      exact t.witness_sq_class_unique h2 hn₁ hn₂
  have hrange : Set.range F ⊆ ((S : Set Kˣ) ∪ (T : Set Kˣ)) ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set Bool) := by
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    by_cases h₁ : ∃ y ∈ S, ∃ n : ℤ,
        ((t.sphereWitness j : Kˣ) : K) = (t.q : K) ^ n * (y : K)
    · rw [hF]
      simp only [dif_pos h₁]
      exact ⟨Or.inl h₁.choose_spec.1, trivial⟩
    · rw [hF]
      simp only [dif_neg h₁]
      exact ⟨Or.inr ((hchoice j).resolve_left h₁).choose_spec.1, trivial⟩
  have hfin : (((S : Set Kˣ) ∪ (T : Set Kˣ)) ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set Bool)).Finite :=
    ((S.finite_toSet.union T.finite_toSet).prod (Set.finite_univ))
  exact Set.infinite_range_of_injective hinjF (hfin.subset hrange)

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateDatum.toAnalyticQuotient_surjective
statement: lemma toAnalyticQuotient_surjective : Function.Surjective T.toAnalyticQuotient
proof:
:=
  QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective T.qpowers

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateDatum.ker_toAnalyticQuotient
statement: @[simp] lemma ker_toAnalyticQuotient : T.toAnalyticQuotient.ker = T.qpowers
proof:
:=
  QuotientGroup.ker_mk' T.qpowers

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateDatum.toAnalyticQuotient_eq_one_iff
statement:
lemma toAnalyticQuotient_eq_one_iff {x : Kˣ} :
    T.toAnalyticQuotient x = 1 ↔ x ∈ T.qpowers
proof:
:= by
  rw [QuotientGroup.mk'_apply, QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff]

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateDatum.toAnalyticQuotient_eq_iff
statement:
lemma toAnalyticQuotient_eq_iff {x y : Kˣ} :
    T.toAnalyticQuotient x = T.toAnalyticQuotient y ↔ x⁻¹ * y ∈ T.qpowers
proof:
:= by
  rw [QuotientGroup.mk'_apply, QuotientGroup.mk'_apply, QuotientGroup.eq]

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateDatum.baseChange_q_coe
statement:
@[simp] lemma baseChange_q_coe :
    ((T.baseChange L).q : L) = algebraMap K L (T.q : K)
proof:
:=
  Units.coe_map _ _

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateDatum.qpowers_le_comap
statement:
lemma qpowers_le_comap :
    T.qpowers ≤
      Subgroup.comap (Units.map (algebraMap K L).toMonoidHom) (T.baseChange L).qpowers
proof:
:= by
  rw [qpowers, Subgroup.zpowers_le, Subgroup.mem_comap]
  exact (T.baseChange L).q_mem_qpowers

name: TateCurvesTheta.TateDatum.mapAnalyticQuotient_comp_toAnalyticQuotient
statement:
@[simp] lemma mapAnalyticQuotient_comp_toAnalyticQuotient (x : Kˣ) :
    T.mapAnalyticQuotient L (T.toAnalyticQuotient x) =
      (T.baseChange L).toAnalyticQuotient (Units.map (algebraMap K L).toMonoidHom x)
proof:
:=
  QuotientGroup.map_mk' _ _ _ _ x
